0d62aae7.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Strategic programs, PRISM, Last Mile Delivery Tech
0d62aae7.description:
**Description**
 How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
   

  

 If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer\-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world\-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Speed is one of the most customer\-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
   

  

 As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end\-to\-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross\-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross\-functional teams, making trade\-offs to optimize time\-to\-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high\-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done


 The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra\-large projects, and a well\-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross\-functional dependencies, and make trade\-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
   

  

**About The Team**
 PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 4\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 3\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience building and evaluating system\-level technical design
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Company Description** 




 Bildwell — Construction Simplified is a cloud\-based construction operating platform designed for architects, contractors, and design\-build teams. It connects the entire contracting workflow, from lead management and project planning to site execution, BoQs, procurement, inventory, invoicing, payment tracking, and reporting. The platform replaces fragmented tools such as spreadsheets, messaging apps, and manual follow\-ups with structured workflows, real\-time visibility, and accountable execution. Bildwell serves a wide range of construction businesses, including interior contractors, design\-and\-build firms, turnkey contractors, commercial fit\-out contractors, residential builders, MEP and civil contractors, EPC subcontractors, industrial contractors, and multi\-city and large regional construction companies. The company focuses on transforming construction operations through intuitive technology and data\-driven insights.

 The Solution Consultant – SaaS \| ConstructionTech / PropTech role at Bildwell is a full\-time, on\-site position based in New Delhi. The Solution Consultant will conduct product demonstrations, lead presales conversations, prepare solution proposals, and collaborate closely with sales teams to drive adoption and deal closures. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing customer requirements, configuring and showcasing relevant product modules, supporting pilots and onboarding, and providing feedback to product and engineering teams for enhancements. The role also involves maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders, documenting use cases, and contributing to continuous improvement of sales and implementation processes.

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret business workflows, assess customer requirements, and translate them into effective SaaS solutions.

* Candidates should possess Presales skills, including discovery, solutioning, product demonstrations, proposal creation, and collaboration with sales teams.
* Candidates should possess Sales\-related capabilities, such as stakeholder management, negotiation support, and driving customer value and conversion.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills to coordinate pilots, onboarding, and implementation activities across internal and customer teams.
* Relevant experience in ConstructionTech, PropTech, ERP, or SaaS platforms, especially in contracting or project\-based businesses, is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, comfort working with both business and technical stakeholders, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment are expected.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience in solution consulting or presales will be considered.

2f4b1b8d.title: Partner Solution Engineer
2f4b1b8d.description:
**The Role**
 Lyzr, the enterprise AI agent platform, seeks a North American Partner Solution Engineer to fill a cross\-functional role, including 1/ Building agentic solutions using Lyzr’s platform with partner technologies to create POCs, demos, and related content for Lyzr Cloud, ISV, and Hardware Partners 2/ Envisioning, creating, and presenting technical assets to partners (both marketing and deployment/integration materials), 3/ onboarding partner sales teams (technical and business personas) to understand Lyzr solutions/resources to cosell with Lyzr 4/ building and maintaining internal GTM tools, and 5/ cultivating strategic relationships with cloud partners.
   

  

 You will join the Strategic Alliances team \- we build, market, and sell alongside the world’s largest tech companies (AWS, GCP, MSFT, Accenture, others). We lead strategic vision and tactical execution for successful Lyzr partnerships. Strategic Alliances at Lyzr manages relationships with various partners, potentially including hyperscalers, neo\-clouds, software companies, systems integrators, consulting firms, etc.
   

  

 In a rapidly scaling startup, this is a cross\-functional role at the intersection of customer/partner solutions engineering, solution architecture, partner enablement, technical marketing, and GTM engineering. You will be the technical face of Lyzr to partners — enabling partner technical teams, creating technical marketing content, and building the tools for scalable partner GTM for Lyzr.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role initially reporting to the VP of Strategic Alliances with visibility to the CEO. Lyzr is the agent platform for enterprise partnership \- the best company to build with. Period. The next 2 years will define how enterprise customers realize value from AI through software alliances, and we are leading the expedition. Join us at Lyzr to drive AI into the biggest industries in the world.
   

  

**About You**
 The ideal candidate is deeply technical yet communicates very clearly in US English. You have a good sense for cost vs benefit \- when to chase a tech issue for hours vs. when to step away and move on to higher priority work. You obsess about customer experiences, and pay attention to detail. You dive deep into agentic AI and work with the latest tech. You already use the latest AI tools for coding, testing, and accelerating your work. You recognize that the way things were done even 3 years ago won’t cut it this year, yet you are eager to learn from experienced leaders. You love to build real solutions that work in production, document them clearly for others, and you connect tech to real business problems. You take coaching well, even when you think you nailed it, you recognize there’s always room to improve. You adapt quickly when leadership priorities shift \- even when it means pausing work you care about. You have an idea how to manage projects, prioritize relentlessly, and set expectations clearly. You are able to laugh at yourself and know when to keep it profesh.
   

  

**About Lyzr**
 Lyzr is the AI agent platform for enterprise. Lyzr AI solutions enable enterprises to design, deploy, and govern AI agents at scale. Enterprise technology lives in our DNA: security and governance are built into Lyzr from the start; not bolted\-on as an after\-thought. Lyzr’s full\-stack approach rapidly moves customers from idea to production without having to stitch together point solutions from a dozen different vendors. We enable enterprises to move beyond isolated AI use cases and into reliable, production\-grade agentic workflows with strong controls around security, accuracy, and compliance.
   

  

 Recognized by Accenture, Harvard Business School innovation ecosystems, and finalist for AWS global AI awards, Lyzr works with global enterprises to reimagine complex workflows using agentic AI. We focus on making AI agents dependable at scale \- so teams can replace fragmented tool stacks with a unified, governed intelligence layer. We have great investors, great leaders, and we are ready to scale. Join us as we create simplicity from the chaos of AI in business environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Building agentic solutions: Own the design/delivery of joint agentic solutions — production\-grade deployments and prototype demos alike — built on Lyzr and partner tech. Applies established blueprints and architectural patterns from Lyzr \+ partners; operates with or without external engineering support depending on engagement context.
* Hands\-on development capability: Writes and reviews Python (or equivalent) code directly, and leverages AI\-assisted code\-gen tools to accelerate solution development. Comfortable working in cloud\-hosted development environments and contributing code alongside or independent of partner engineering teams.
* Creating Technical Marketing \& Enablement Content for Partners: Build and maintain partner/customer\-facing assets; including integration guides, reference architectures, tech white papers, hands\-on labs, solution briefs/accelerators, competitive positioning, case studies, step\-by\-step customer guides, playbooks, webinars, and similar assets. Enable internal \& external stakeholders to understand Lyzr solutions and identify business problems solved by Lyzr solutions. Develop compelling demos and video walkthroughs for partners and customers.
* Delivering Partner/Customer Enablement as the Subject Matter Expert (SME): Join partner and/or customer\-facing meetings to support field sales resources (Lyzr \& partner sellers) to land the value proposition of Lyzr solutions and drive revenue. Delivering hands\-on workshops as needed, and explaining delivery playbooks in real time.
* Technical SME \- Support strategic customer/partners serving as a technical escalation point for complex agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment patterns. Act as a SME for Lyzr solutions, including Lyzr Blocks, Studio, GitAgent, LyzrGPT, Architect.new, and more.
* Design and build Lyzr GTM tools to accelerate Lyzr’s GTM efforts.
* Assist in instrumenting and measure partner GTM impact — tracking metrics like partner\-sourced pipeline, influenced revenue, and related dashboards.
* Onboard partners with structured technical onboarding experiences; from initial architecture review through first joint customer deployment.
* Lead/support "office hours" enablement with partners to deepen expertise and identify customer opportunities.
* Synthesize partner feedback/learning into actionable product insight; capture field experience and delivery patterns to share with product and deployment teams.
* Collaborate with leadership to shape joint business plans, especially focused on technical integration goals with strategic partners.


**What We Seek**
* Experience: Varies by country: 3\-12 years of experience in customer/partner\-facing engineering roles, sales engineer, product engineer, solution engineer, solutions architect, forward deployed engineer, technical consultant, or similar. Enterprise experience preferred, with ability to operate independently in highly ambiguous startup situations.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and tools, including some mixture of Lyzr, LangChain, CrewAI, N8N, leading code\-gen solutions, \*claw, git, and others
* US Eastern Time\-Zone (GMT \-5\): Weekdays must be available with high\-quality internet for voice calls with internal or external stakeholders during a range from 800 \- 1800 hrs US Eastern Time (i.e. until 330am India time)
* Exceptional English Communication: Written and spoken, must demonstrate strong English communication. You are able to convey ideas succinctly (or are willing to learn).

We are seeking a motivated and technically strong **Associate Solution Architect** to join our team at Iota Analytics. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in software development, cloud technologies, microservices, and distributed systems, along with an interest in solution architecture.

In this role, you will work closely with senior architects, developers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, integrate, and implement scalable and secure technology solutions. * Good understanding of **cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS**.
* Strong understanding of **microservices architecture and distributed systems**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Docker** and exposure to **Kubernetes**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD concepts and tools**.
* Good knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, APIs, and system integration.
* Understanding of **security best practices**, scalability, performance optimization, and application reliability.
* Experience working with databases, APIs, and enterprise application integrations.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field**.

Good to Have

* Experience with Azure/AWS architecture and cloud\-native services.
* Knowledge of **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep.

We are looking for someone who is technically curious, proactive, and eager to grow into a **Solution Architect** role. Headquartered in the UK, with offices in the US and Centers of Excellence in India, **Iota Analytics** is a tech\-led legal process and analytics firm bringing together technology, data science, and process outsourcing to support legal teams globally.

We serve Am Law 100 firms, leading ALSPs, and global enterprises while fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and the highest standards of data privacy and client trust.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in India.**
 This is a senior, client\-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.
   

  

 You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.
   

  

 The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.
   

  

 You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.
   

  

 The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud\-based applications and infrastructure.
   

  

 You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital\-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document current\-state requirements and translate them into scalable future\-state digital platform architectures.
* Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
* Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role\-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
* Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
* Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
* Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom\-built systems.
* Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS\-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
* Collaborate closely with front\-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
* Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution\-design materials.
* Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
* Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
* Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.


**Requirements**
* Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital\-platform architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
* Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
* Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
* Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
* Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self\-hosted deployments.
* Experience leading CMS or digital\-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content\-management solutions.
* Strong understanding of AWS and cloud\-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
* Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front\-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
* Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
* Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role\-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
* Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
* Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
* Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.

256d0f79.title: Principal Solutions Architect - SAARC
256d0f79.description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**Available Locations: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi**
**About The Role**
 As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.
   

  

 You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation. Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge\-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.
   

  

 You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long\-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own long\-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi\-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.
* Design and facilitate executive vision\-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi\-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co\-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.
* Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud\-to\-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.
* Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.
* Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.
* Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.


**What Success Looks Like** 
  

  

* In your first 6 months:
+ You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3\-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts.
+ You've designed and facilitated 2\-3 executive vision\-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi\-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component.
+ You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone.
+ You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 12\+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).
* A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading executive\-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.
* Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event\-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).
* A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.
* Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.
* Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.
* Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800\-207, ISO 27001\), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.
* Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi\-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Hands\-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.
* Prior experience in a role that required navigating cultural and linguistic diversity across multiple APAC markets.


 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
   

  

 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo** 
 : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers\-\-at no cost.
   

  

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in\-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
   

  

 Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e\-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107\.

**Preferred/Good to Have**

* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)

**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset with a sense of urgency during close periods
* Good client communication and ticket documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tickets/priorities simultaneously
* Team player with willingness to support on\-call/rotational schedules

20de312c.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
20de312c.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The Product and Engineering team in the Cloud Native Business Unit is looking to bring on a Senior Technical Program Manager to join a team of TPMs focused on driving complex and cross\-cutting initiatives and programs to meet our top objectives and key results to delight our customers.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* You will take charge using your technical leadership and program management skills to drive execution with high quality for these key initiatives.
* You will be responsible for establishing best practices, collaborating across multiple business units and managing dependencies and deliverables for multiple programs.
* You will be working with a global team of software engineers who develop new features and capabilities with a rapid rate of change.

f05744ad.title: Program Manager
f05744ad.description:
**Purpose of the Role** 




 Agratas is seeking a dynamic and experienced Programme Manager to join our cutting\-edge R\&D facility. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in driving innovation, overseeing complex projects, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic programmes in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





 We are seeking a strategically astute and technically accomplished Programme Manager to drive the industrialisation roadmap from next\-generation battery cell design and development through to manufacturing at our Bangalore facility. This is a pivotal role, charged with aligning technical programme execution with corporate strategy, driving operational transformation, and building long\-term organisational capability in advanced manufacturing.
 



  





 The Programme Manager will serve as a key contributor to the leadership team, bringing together strategy, innovation, and execution to ensure that the India R\&D and industrialisation programme delivers industry\-leading outcomes in cost, quality, scale, and sustainability.
 



  





 By joining Agratas R\&D in Bangalore, you’ll be part of a world\-class research hub focused on advancing battery cell technology. Whether you’re an engineer, technician, or scientist, you’ll contribute to projects that power the future of mobility and energy, while working in an environment that values both technical excellence and sustainability.
 



  





 Agratas R\&D in Bangalore offers the rare combination of cutting\-edge science, meaningful impact, and career\-building opportunities—all within a supportive, forward\-looking team.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas** 



* Lead and manage cross\-functional programmes from concept to completion
* Align project outcomes with business objectives and R\&D priorities
* Collaborate with technical teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Ensure timelines, budgets, and quality standards are consistently met
* Strategic Programme Leadership
* Corporate Strategy Integration \& Business Planning
* Anticipate global technology, regulatory, and competitive trends and proactively adjust programme priorities to maintain market leadership.
* Programme Leadership: Lead the execution of multiple process engineering projects, driving the industrialisation of advanced battery cell manufacturing technologies.
* Development, governance and delivery of timing, budget and capability requirements for our UK Gigafactory Project as well as leadership of technology development programmes.
* Process Development \- Oversee programmes to design, deploy and optimise the manufacturing systems for electrode manufacturing, cell assembly and Formation, Aging \& Test. Equipment Integration.
* Technology Transfer: Lead cross\-functional teams in transferring technologies from both R\&D and other technical partners to manufacturing.
* Lead the strategic prioritisation of technology development and industrialisation projects based on business value, technical risk, and time\-to\-impact.
* Ensure seamless technology transfer from R\&D into commercial production, including roadmaps for scale\-up and automation.
* Define and govern programme portfolio metrics to ensure maximum ROI, cost leadership, and resilience.
* Operational Excellence \& Transformation
* Provide strategic oversight for supplier engagement and procurement decisions to ensure global supply chain scalability and resilience.
* Deliver operational excellence through robust cost control, financial modelling, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with external partners, including material suppliers and automation vendors.
* Risk Mitigation: · Identify and mitigate technical risks across all stages of process development and scale\-up.



  





**Job Context** 




 About You:
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
* Advanced technical certifications in programme management or manufacturing are highly desirable.
* Strong technical experience in battery cell design and manufacturing processes and a proven record of delivery in dynamic, fast\-paced environments.
* High level of understanding of lithium\-ion battery chemistries and manufacturing process equipment, as well as technical and environmental standards for battery cell production.
* Strong background in using project management tools and methodologies. Proven ability to manage complex, large\-scale programmes with a focus on technical deliverables and timelines.
* Relative experience in large\-scale, complex R\&D, manufacturing or engineering programmes
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment



  





 Joining Agratas R\&D in Bangalore means becoming part of a cutting\-edge team shaping the future of sustainable energy storage, with the backing of Tata Sons and the excitement of a scale\-up environment.
 



  





 Join us at Agratas and help shape the future of advanced research and development.

fe790376.description:
Nemetschek India Private Limited is a global organization and with a legacy of over half a century. It is a public company listed on MDAX and TecDAX (Germany) stock exchanges. The Nemetschek Group is a forerunner of digital transformation in the AEC/O (Architecture, Engineering, Construction \& Operations) industry and covers the entire life cycle of construction and infrastructure projects. With intelligent software solutions, we lead our customers into the future of digitalization. By using our solutions customers can plan, build, manage, and operate buildings and infrastructure projects.
 



  





 Nemetschek India is looking for a strong Technical Sales Specialist / Senior Solution Consultant to support enterprise growth across the AEC and infrastructure ecosystem in India. This is an individual contributor role focused on partnering with enterprise sales on strategic pursuits, shaping solution value for customers, and helping drive adoption of digital workflows and platforms at scale.
 



  





 The role combines deep domain understanding in AEC, BIM, and digital construction with strong customer\-facing consulting and commercial support skills. The successful candidate will work directly with sales teams, customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to translate business needs into compelling technical solutions, demonstrations, workshops, proposals, and proof points.
 



  





 Strategic sales support
 



 • Partner with enterprise sales teams on key pursuits, strategic accounts, and large opportunities.
 



 • Support discovery conversations with CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, Digital Heads, Design Heads, and project stakeholders to understand business priorities and digital transformation goals.
 



 • Contribute to large enterprise sales cycles including RFPs, bids, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations.
 



  





 Solutioning and value articulation
 



 • Translate customer business challenges into solution concepts, technical recommendations, and ROI\-oriented value propositions.
 



 • Shape solution architecture and workflow positioning across design, collaboration, construction, and asset lifecycle use cases.
 



 • Lead product demonstrations, proof of value discussions, workshops, and customer use case sessions tailored to account needs.
 



 • Work closely with account teams to articulate how Nemetschek solutions address customer pain points, workflow gaps, and digital maturity goals.
 



  





 Domain and technical consulting
 



 • Bring strong understanding of AEC, BIM, digital delivery, and construction workflows into customer engagements.
 



 • Hands\-on experience on tools like Allplan, Archicad, Vectorworks, SDS/2 etc.
 



 • Advise customers on adoption approaches for digital workflows, data\-driven collaboration, cloud\-enabled processes, and connected project environments.
 



  





 Market and customer development
 



 • Identify whitespace opportunities across infrastructure, real estate, EPC, design, and government sectors, and support account teams in developing solution\-led opportunities.
 



 • Collaborate with marketing on customer events, industry campaigns, workshops, and thought\-leadership engagements.
 



 • Help build reference customers, success stories, and repeatable value narratives from field engagements.
 



  





 Partner and ecosystem collaboration
 



 • Work with system integrators, consultants, channel partners, and technology partners on joint opportunities and solution positioning.
 



 • Support technical enablement of partners where required, including solution use cases, demonstrations, and technical messaging.
 



 • Collaborate with customer success and services teams to help ensure smooth transition from sales to adoption
 



  





 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 Experience
 



 • 10\-15 years of experience in technical sales, pre\-sales, solution consulting, or solution engineering roles.
 



 • Strong exposure to AEC, BIM, infrastructure, engineering, or construction technology environments and software like Allplan,SDS/2, Archicad, Vector works etc
 



 • Experience in customer\-facing solution presentations, workshops, and consultative technical selling.
 



  





 Skills and capabilities
 



 • Strong understanding of AEC workflows, BIM\-led collaboration, and digital transformation challenges across the project lifecycle.
 



 • Ability to connect customer business goals with technical solution value and adoption outcomes. • Strong presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
 



 • Comfort engaging both executive stakeholders and detailed technical users.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration capability.
 



 • Familiarity with platforms and technologies such as BIM, digital twins, project controls, cloud SaaS, interoperability, and workflow integration.
 



  





 Preferred background
 



 • Experience with enterprise software vendors serving AEC, infrastructure, engineering, or construction customers.
 



 • Exposure to consultative selling in complex multi\-stakeholder environments.
 



 • Experience working with strategic accounts, ecosystem partners, and enterprise bid cycles.
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



 • A young, dynamic, and innovation\-oriented environment.
 



 • A wide variety of projects within different industries.
 



 • A very open and informal culture where knowledge sharing, and employee development are key. • Room for personal initiative, development, and growth.

 We are looking for a Presales Engineer with a strong technical background who can understand complex technical products and translate them into compelling solutions for clients.  Technical Presales \& Solutioning\-

 ● Act as the technical point of contact during the sales cycle.
 



  





 Product Demonstrations\-

 ● Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, and solution documentation.

 ●Support cross\-functional initiatives beyond presales, including marketing, events, and solution positioning, as required.
 



 ●Collaborate with the marketing team to contribute to solution collateral, including flyers, brochures, case studies, and pitch decks.
 



 ●Assist in webinars, conferences, industry events, and product launches by supporting demos, presentations, and technical storytelling.
 



 ●Translate technical capabilities into clear, customer\-friendly messaging for digital and field marketing use cases.
 



  





 Stakeholder Collaboration\-
 



 ●Work closely with product and engineering teams to stay updated on new features and roadmap. ●Provide customer feedback to internal teams to improve product offerings. ●Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery/implementation teams. 
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  





 Technical Skills \-
 



 ●Strong understanding of software products, SaaS platforms, or enterprise solutions.
 



 ●Strong ownership mindset with attention to detail and follow\-through.
 



 ●Comfort working with presentations, documentation, and visual storytelling for both technical and business audiences.
 



 ●Ability to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
 



 ●Hands\-on experience with demos, POCs, or solution presentations. ●Familiarity with cloud platforms, databases, or modern tech stacks is a plus. 
 



  





 Soft Skills \-
 



 ●Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 ●Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple, business\-friendly manner.
 



 ●Ability to work in cross\-functional roles spanning presales, marketing, and customer engagement when required.
 



 ●Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
 



 ●Confident in client\-facing interactions. 
 



  





**Experience :** 




 ●Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
 



 ●3 \- 6 years of experience in presales, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles. 
 



  





**Company Overview:** 




 Aventior is a leading provider of innovative, end\-to\-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting\-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps to build scalable, future\-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
 



  





 Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation \& ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics \& visualization, and automated data capture for unstructured and semi\-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.
 



  





 At Aventior, our strength lies in combining deep industry expertise with advanced technical capabilities. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision\-making.
 



  





 We bring a holistic, cross\-industry perspective to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support. With a global delivery model, a multi\-country presence, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well\-positioned to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes at scale.

 Minimum 15 years of experience in cybersecurity solutions, presales, telecom/service provider networks, data centers, cloud security and managed services.

2d86694d.title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
2d86694d.description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have
   

  

 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaSWorking command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-readyPresence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same roomHands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of oneExperience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access controlWriting that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually readEngineering background is a must
   

  

 Nice to have
   

  

 Contact centre or CX domain backgroundExposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyersMultilingual or Arabic deployment experienceTime at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery
   

  

 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, WFOOur customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office dayOccasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support
   

  

 WHY THIS SEAT
   

  

 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
   

  

 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.

* End\-to\-end architecture and solution design leadership.

* Defining enterprise and solution architecture, including integration and data models and data ingestion pipelines, as well as user\-facing solutions
* Expressing complex technical solutions through architecture modeling tools

* Building strong relationships with key stakeholders, C\-level executives, and IT and Business Data Managers to drive long\-term adoption of Cognite’s products and services

* Independently work with managing integration, data modeling, and related activities using Cognite data connectors and extractors, SQL, Python/Java, Rest APIs and Cloud platform providers like Azure, AWS \& Google

47fd6eec.title: Technical Solution Architect - ThingWorx / SCPA
47fd6eec.description:
**Req ID:** 
 388377
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Solution Architect \- ThingWorx / SCPA to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Description – Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA**
**Job Title:** 
 Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA
   

  

**Platform:** 
 ThingWorx 10\.x
   

  

**Product Focus:** 
 Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) / SmartConnect
   

  

**Engagement Type:** 
 Solution Architecture, Design \& Delivery
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8\+ Years overall, including 5\+ years of ThingWorx experience
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA** 
 to lead the architecture and solution design of the next\-generation
 **SmartConnect connected\-product platform** 
 using
 **ThingWorx 10\.x and Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA)** 
 .
   

  

 The architect will translate approved business requirements, user needs, and acceptance criteria into a
 **secure, scalable, resilient, supportable, and maintainable technical solution** 
 . The role will provide technical direction across remote service access, endpoint automation, identity and access governance, enterprise integrations, master\-data synchronization, and multiple user populations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring deep hands\-on expertise in
 **ThingWorx architecture and development** 
 , combined with strong knowledge of
 **SCPA building blocks, IoT solution architecture, security, identity management, enterprise integration, and remote\-access solutions** 
 .
   

  

 A key objective of this role is to maximize the use of
 **standard SCPA configuration and reusable building blocks** 
 , minimize unnecessary customization, and establish governed, upgrade\-safe extension patterns where custom development is required.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for SmartConnect using ThingWorx 10\.x and SCPA.
* Define application, data, integration, security, deployment, infrastructure, and operational architecture.
* Translate business requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into traceable technical requirements, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Evaluate requirements against SCPA capabilities and determine the appropriate configure, integrate, extend, or custom\-build approach.
* Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, solution documentation, technical standards, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Establish implementation guardrails and reusable architectural patterns for development teams.


 ThingWorx \& SCPA Architecture
   

  

* Design the overall ThingWorx Thing model and asset hierarchy.
* Define and govern:
+ Thing Templates
+ Thing Shapes
+ Data Shapes
+ Services
+ Events
+ Subscriptions
+ Persistence strategies
+ Mashups and application components

* Assess and leverage SCPA standard capabilities, reusable building blocks, extension points, and custom components.
* Ensure custom extensions are maintainable, testable, reusable, and designed to minimize future upgrade impact.


 Remote Access \& Endpoint Management
   

  

* Architect secure attended and unattended remote\-access solutions for gateways and downstream endpoints.
* Define architecture for session routing, customer/user consent, endpoint availability, failure handling, auditability, clipboard access, and file transfer.
* Design secure gateway\-to\-endpoint communication and access patterns.
* Ensure remote\-access capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity and least\-privilege requirements.


 Automation \& Remote Package Execution
   

  

* Design automated file\-watch ingestion and processing capabilities.
* Define targeted remote\-package execution architecture, including:
+ Endpoint targeting
+ Integrity/checksum validation
+ Retry and failure\-management policies
+ Execution status
+ Per\-endpoint results
+ Audit records
+ Monitoring and observability

* Establish scalable automation patterns for managing distributed endpoints and connected assets.


 Security, Identity \& Access Governance
   

  

* Define Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least\-privilege security architecture.
* Design static and dynamic visibility groups and segmented access models.
* Architect Just\-In\-Time (JIT) privileged\-access approval workflows, including customer\-owned approval processes.
* Define identity and authorization models supporting:
+ Customers
+ Internal employees
+ External contractors
+ Business partners

* Design identity federation and authentication patterns using enterprise identity platforms.
* Ensure security controls, authorization decisions, privileged access, and user activity are appropriately auditable.


 Enterprise Integration \& Master Data
   

  

* Define integration architecture between ThingWorx/SmartConnect and Unity (Salesforce) for endpoint master data.
* Establish system\-of\-record ownership and read\-only data\-field principles.
* Design synchronization, reconciliation, error handling, retry, and recovery mechanisms.
* Provide visibility into synchronization status and last\-successful\-sync information.
* Establish standards for REST APIs, events, data contracts, and integration patterns across enterprise systems.
* Support integrations with IAM/IdP platforms, Salesforce, CMDB, SAP, logging, monitoring, and other enterprise applications.


 Non\-Functional Architecture
   

  

 Define and govern non\-functional requirements covering:
   

  

* Availability and high availability
* Performance
* Scalability
* Resiliency and recovery
* Security and privacy
* Observability and monitoring
* Auditability
* Maintainability
* Supportability
* Deployment and release management


 Ensure architectural decisions support production operations, troubleshooting, future enhancements, and platform upgrades.
   

  

 Architecture Governance \& Delivery Support
   

  

* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, threat\-modeling discussions, and design\-assurance activities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
* Review implementation designs and code to ensure compliance with approved architectural patterns.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to ThingWorx consultants, developers, integration engineers, and infrastructure teams.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, QA, Service Operations, Infrastructure, and enterprise integration teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.


 Migration \& Coexistence
   

  

* Define the migration strategy from the existing SmartConnect implementation to the next\-generation platform.
* Develop migration and coexistence architecture to minimize business and operational disruption.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt during modernization.
* Define deployment, transition, rollback, and release strategies.


 SmartConnect Capability Alignment
   

  

 Capability AreaUser NeedsArchitect Responsibility
 **Remote Access** 
 UN\-1 to UN\-4Define secure session management, gateway routing, consent, endpoint availability, transfer, failure handling, and audit architecture.
 **Automation \& Systematic Data** 
 UN\-5 to UN\-6Define ingestion, checksum validation, retry, endpoint targeting, execution, results, and observability patterns.
 **Access Governance** 
 UN\-7 to UN\-9Architect visibility groups, RBAC, least privilege, and customer\-owned JIT approval workflows.
 **Unity Master\-Data Synchronization** 
 UN\-10Define system\-of\-record integration, reconciliation, ownership, synchronization, and failure\-handling architecture.
 **Multiple User Populations** 
 UN\-11Define identity federation, population classification, policy enforcement, authorization, and auditable access patterns.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience designing enterprise software, industrial IoT, connected\-product, remote\-service, or similar technology solutions.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on ThingWorx architecture or senior development experience, including ThingWorx 9\.x and/or 10\.x.
* 3 to 5 years of strong experience with ThingWorx Composer, modeling, Mashups, services, events, subscriptions, security, persistence, deployment, and integrations.
* 3\+ years of demonstrated experience with Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) or comparable ThingWorx solution/building\-block architecture.
* 3 to 5 years of strong understanding of ThingWorx Thing Templates, Thing Shapes, Data Shapes, asset hierarchies, services, and persistence models.
* Experience designing secure remote\-access, endpoint\-management, connected\-device, or fleet\-automation solutions.
* Strong knowledge of RBAC, identity federation, segmented/multi\-tenant visibility, approval workflows, audit logging, and least\-privilege security principles.
* Experience designing enterprise REST/API and event\-driven integrations.
* Experience integrating platforms such as Salesforce, IAM/IdP, CMDB, SAP, monitoring, and logging systems.
* Ability to translate functional requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into technical architecture and implementation guidance.
* Strong experience with architecture governance, design reviews, technical risk management, and documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical, security, operational, business, and executive stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ThingWorx Developer, Model Specialist, Deploy Specialist, or equivalent certification.
* Hands\-on experience with SCPA extension points, custom building blocks, reusable components, and upgrade\-safe architecture.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of SAML, OAuth/OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, identity federation, and privileged\-access management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and ThingWorx persistence architecture.
* Experience designing high\-availability ThingWorx environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and automated deployment.
* Experience working within regulated healthcare, medical\-device, life\-sciences, cybersecurity, or quality\-controlled product environments.


 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Technical Solution Architect will be responsible for producing and maintaining:
   

  

* Solution Architecture Document
* Context, container, component, and integration diagrams
* SCPA fit\-gap assessment
* Configure / Integrate / Extend / Custom\-build recommendations
* ThingWorx Thing and asset model
* Data and persistence architecture
* Security and RBAC model
* Identity and federation architecture
* Visibility\-group design
* Remote\-access architecture
* JIT privileged\-access workflow design
* Endpoint automation architecture
* Unity/Salesforce integration design
* API, event, and data contracts
* Non\-functional requirements
* Operational and observability architecture
* Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
* Threat\-model inputs
* Technical risk and mitigation plans
* Migration and coexistence architecture
* Deployment and release architecture
* Technical standards and implementation guardrails
* Architecture and design\-review outcomes


 Measures of Success
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:
   

  

* Deliver an architecture that provides clear traceability to approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maximize the use of SCPA standard configuration and reusable building blocks wherever practical.
* Minimize unnecessary customization and technical debt.
* Ensure custom development is justified, governed, testable, maintainable, reusable, and upgrade\-safe.
* Build security, auditability, least privilege, resiliency, scalability, and operational supportability into the architecture from the outset.
* Provide development and delivery teams with clear architectural decisions, interfaces, standards, and non\-functional expectations.
* Enable successful migration to the next\-generation SmartConnect platform with minimal disruption to existing users and operations.


 Key Skills
   

  

**ThingWorx 10\.x \| Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) \| ThingWorx Architecture \| Industrial IoT \| Connected Products \| Thing Modeling \| Thing Templates \| Thing Shapes \| Data Shapes \| Mashups \| REST APIs \| Remote Access \| Endpoint Management \| RBAC \| JIT Access \| Identity Federation \| SAML \| OIDC \| Microsoft Entra ID \| Salesforce Integration \| PostgreSQL \| Azure \| Security Architecture \| API \& Integration Architecture \| High Availability \| Observability \| CI/CD \| Solution Architecture**

 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. CE\&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
   

  

 Our mission is to protect customers from cybersecurity threats. Our vision is to deliver a comprehensive AI\-driven security stack that provides best\-in\-class protection. Our Threat Protection strategy at Microsoft spans multiple products and services, providing state\-of\-the\-art protection across the entire digital estate. Our culture is centred on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life\-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. You can help us to achieve our mission.
   

  

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Purview Data Security, Sentinel and Defender XDR solutions and services. This is a customer\-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. Our Security CSAs work with Enterprise level customers on the bleeding edge of our Security solution stack.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and passionate Security Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to drive customer transformation in our Security Solutions. You will own the customer engagements deliveries, including architecture design sessions, specific implementation project/pilots and helping to remove technical blockers. You will be driving successful customer security outcomes enabled by your design and engagement with key customer teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles, a background of deep technical expertise, and success building trusted advisor relationships with senior customer executives, Enterprise Architects, IT Management and Developers.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

* Customer Satisfaction \- Drive positive Customer Satisfaction \& become a trusted advisor.
* Customer/Partner Insights \- Provide feedback \& insights from customers/partners.
* Be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.
* Land an end\-to\-end value prop for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with focus on Threat Protection, ID \+ Access Management, Data Security and Cloud Security.


 Business Impact
   

  

* Position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage and develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results \& help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments.
* Identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise. Deliver according to MS best practices \& using repeatable IP.
* Accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high\-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability, and reliability upon deployment.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Learn It All – Align individual skilling to team/area demands \& Customer Success goals.
* Accelerate customer outcomes \- Share expertise, contribute to IP creation \& re\-use to accelerate customer outcomes.
* Run Architectural Design Session to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment. Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.
* Collaborate and orchestrate with other Cloud Solution Architects and MS stakeholders in developing complex end\-to\-end Enterprise solutions with the Microsoft Security platform.
* Leverage the breadth of your technical experience and knowledge in foundational security, foundational AI, architecture design, with depth Subject Matter Expertise in security to deliver the end\-to\-end security story for Microsoft, highlighting the value proposition using your experience in security and expertise around related technologies and concepts such as Data Security, Zero Trust, threat management, SOC monitoring (SIEM / SOAR), Extended Detection \& Response (XDR) \+ SIEM, Cloud Security and Identity


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Preferred/Additional Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will have a breadth of knowledge across Microsoft Cloud security domains– SIEM \& XDR, Purview\- Data Security. Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, and Identity –Expertise/experience focused on:
   

  

* Purview Data Security – DLP, MIP and IRM
* Defender for Office (MDO)
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Microsoft Defender For Cloud (MDC)
* Defender for Endpoint (MDE
* Defender for Identity (MDI)
* Defender for Applications
* Identity\- Entra ID
* Breadth of technical security experience and knowledge, with depth and Subject Matter Expertise in one or more of the following domains:
* Data Security – DLP, MIP and IRM
* SIEM and Cloud Security Analytics
* Security Operations Center (SOC)
* Extended Detection and Response (XDR)
* Identity
* proven ability to map the customer’s needs to technical solutions.
* Strong technical understanding of Microsoft Security Solutions and of competitors.
* Empathy, curiosity, and desire to constantly improve, acquire new skills and drive for results.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in previous roles.
* Able to quickly resolve customer escalations by coordinating appropriate resources as needed.
* Certification in one or more of the following technologies preferred: Microsoft Security architecture, CISSP, CCSP or equivalent
* Business Value: The ability to convey the business need and value of proposed solutions, plans, and risks to stakeholders and decision makers. This includes the ability to persuade and inform based on facts and alignment with goals and strategy
* Trusted Advisership: The ability to build trusted advisor status and deep relationships across stakeholders (e.g., technical decision makers, business decision makers) through an understanding of customer needs and technologies.
* Situational fluency: Using self\-awareness as a mechanism to interpret verbal and non\-verbal cues to increase your ability to "read the room."
