0bf9275f.title: Solution Engineering - Copilot
0bf9275f.description:
**Overview**
 our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer in the AI Business Solutions – Copilot team, you will lead technical engagements that drive AI transformation for enterprise customers. Your mission is to win technical decisions and accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio \& Agents, and related solutions by delivering compelling demos, envisioning sessions, and scalable architectures. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through secure, compliant, and value\-driven implementations that align with their enterprise strategies.
   

  

 This role is pivotal in shaping the future of work by enabling customers to realize the full potential of AI\-powered productivity. You will collaborate closely with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to remove technical blockers, generate pipeline, and ensure seamless handoffs for deployment and adoption. Your success will be measured by technical wins, customer adoption, partner engagement, and your contributions to a high\-performance, learning\-oriented team culture
   

  

* Drive AI transformation by orchestrating complex technical engagements across multiple stakeholders.
* Lead architecture design for secure, scalable solutions aligned with enterprise strategy.
* Mentor IC3–IC4 engineers and lead peer learning sessions to elevate team capability.
* Influence product and go\-to\-market strategy by providing structured feedback to engineering and sales leadership.
* Proactively identify and escalate unresolved technical blockers through formal channels.
* Champion compliance, diversity, and inclusion by modeling ethical behavior and inclusive practices


**Responsibilities**
* Lead AI transformation engagements (e.g. demos, pilots) to win technical decisions and drive customer commitment to Copilot/Agents, including documented adoption plans and a smooth hand\-off to Customer Success/partners for usage onboarding.
* Support AI Workforce SSP hunting effort by engaging w/customer contacts, lead qual., and partner co\-sell opportunities
* Assist in ME3 , ME5 , ME7 , Agent 365 upsell opportunities focused on Teams Phone that require technical support, and bring in a partner for co\-sell.
* Generate new pipeline and competitive wins for M365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio \& Agents, ME3 and Frontline Worker by delivering impactful AI\-powered demos/Art\-of\-Possible sessions, removing technical blockers, and highlighting Microsoft’s differentiation to secure deals and protect the install base.
* Craft scalable, secure, and modular architectures that align to customer’s enterprise strategy and technical roadmap while embedding security at every level.
* Maintain operational excellence with 100% deal hygiene – capture technical close plans and consumption plans in MSX for every opportunity, attach a partner to every qualified deal, and promptly escalate unresolved technical blockers.
* Continuously upskill to meet role expectations (achieve L200 consultative and L400 technical depth certifications) and contribute to team excellence by sharing at least one deal win/loss insight per quarter and engaging in regular coaching.


**Qualifications**

b3002128.title: Senior Solution Architect, Mumbai
b3002128.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud\-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
   

  

**What is The Role:**
 Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and tackle our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be passionate about perfection; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.
   

  

 “We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing:**
* Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.
* Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.
* Crafting and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.
* Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.
* Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.
* Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.
* Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.
* Crafting collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.
* Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and improvements to our engineering and leadership teams.
* Deepening both your sales and technical skills through self driven education while taking advantage of all the professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.


**What You Bring:**
* A track record of success in a technical presales role—enough experience selling and implementing technology to earn your customer’s trust.
* A proven track record to articulate and sell the benefits of modern platforms, software and technologies.
* A real passion for being curious and a continuous learner. You are someone that invests in yourself as much as you invest in your professional relationships.
* A history of successful customer relations where you developed an understanding of what made a difference, and devised architectures that helped meet a goal, tackle a problem, or outpace competitors.
* An ability to influence. Have you more than once convinced a team you worked for, of an idea, technology, or architectural pattern?
* The ability to inspire groups, both large and small.
* A willingness to travel 30% within region, as well as occasionally internationally.


**Additional Information \- We Take Care of Our People:**
 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
   

  

 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
   

  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact \- We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave


 Different people approach problems differently. We need that. 6be8e7f3.title: AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer - VOIS
6be8e7f3.description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an AWS Cloud DevOps Engineer to design, implement and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS cloud and networking solutions supporting business\-critical Vodafone applications and customers across Europe.


You will help design, plan and implement AWS cloud services that provide mission\-critical infrastructure to internal customers. The role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, Kubernetes platform administration, infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, security, cost optimisation and Level 2 and Level 3 operational support.


You will work with multiple technology functions, including solution design, delivery, architecture and IT security. Your work will directly influence cloud service delivery, production stability and customer services. The position is based in India within VCI Professional Services.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Manage project\-led integrations and the day\-to\-day administration of AWS cloud solutions.
* Design, prototype and build reusable modules and cloud solutions aligned with the CET framework and Agile delivery cycles.
* Provision and maintain CET framework components and other AWS services using Terraform and Terragrunt.
* Manage the lifecycle, maintenance and upgrades of AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service, CET\-EKS components and associated observability capabilities.
* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including capacity management, platform troubleshooting and preparation or modification of Kubernetes manifests and resources.
* Perform Bottlerocket AMI rotations and worker\-node patching.
* Maintain AWS Relational Database Service infrastructure, including upgrades and rightsizing.
* Design and deploy hybrid connectivity solutions across CET\-based AWS accounts.
* Build and manage continuous delivery pipelines for Kubernetes modules and applications.
* Configure ArgoCD environments and deploy infrastructure components using ArgoCD and Helm charts.
* Apply GitOps practices using GitHub, ArgoCD and Amazon EKS.
* Drive infrastructure and operational automation through CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bash and Python.
* Conduct peer reviews and maintain established coding standards.
* Troubleshoot AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, networking, storage and performance issues.
* Manage platform monitoring and observability capabilities, including Grafana dashboards.
* Identify and implement cloud cost optimisation opportunities.
* Monitor expenditure using AWS Cost Explorer and AWS Budgets.
* Manage cloud platform security, vulnerabilities and compliance, including security and compliance requirements for EKS clusters.
* Perform proofs of concept for AWS infrastructure enhancements.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure and operational documentation in Confluence.
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 incident and problem\-management support.
* Help establish collaborative DevOps practices and cloud engineering methodologies across the organisation.
* Share AWS knowledge and support the development of cloud expertise within the team.
* Contribute towards cloud\-service availability, cloud adoption and consistent feature delivery.
**Who you are**
---------------


**Essential experience and knowledge**

* You have at least 6 years of experience in cloud computing, or at least 6 years of experience in enterprise IT.
* You have practical expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure and cloud platform operations.
* You have experience administering Amazon EKS and Kubernetes platforms.
* You understand Kubernetes lifecycle management, capacity management, security, compliance and troubleshooting.
* You have hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terragrunt.
* You are experienced in GitOps and continuous delivery using technologies such as GitHub, ArgoCD and Helm.
* You understand CI/CD practices and have worked with tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* You are proficient in version control using Git.
* You can use Bash or Python to automate operational tasks, including user administration and security hardening.
* You understand cloud networking, connectivity, storage, security, monitoring and performance management.
* You have experience supporting AWS RDS infrastructure.
* You can manage observability and monitoring solutions, including Grafana dashboards.
* You understand cloud cost optimisation and can use AWS Cost Explorer and AWS Budgets.
* You have experience with enterprise ticketing tools and Agile delivery methodologies.
* You can produce clear technical and operational documentation.
* You communicate effectively and use structured, solution\-focused thinking to address technical challenges.
* You hold a degree in an IT\-related discipline.

 **Desirable experience and qualifications**

* 6 to 9 years of relevant experience in programming or systems analysis within Agile delivery environments.
* Experience applying DevOps practices in a cloud environment.
* Experience managing highly business\-critical technology environments.
* A relevant DevOps, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, AWS or HashiCorp Terraform certification.
* Broader knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud technologies.
* Experience evaluating technical requirements, reducing service disruption and adopting emerging cloud technologies.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* The opportunity to work with production\-scale AWS cloud infrastructure supporting mission\-critical services.
* Exposure to modern cloud\-native technologies, including Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Terragrunt, ArgoCD, Helm and GitHub Actions.
* Experience collaborating with solution design, delivery, architecture and IT security teams across a complex international technology environment.
* The opportunity to contribute to high\-availability services with a target uptime of 99%.
* Scope to influence cloud automation, platform stability, security, compliance, cost efficiency and DevOps adoption.
* Opportunities to conduct proofs of concept, evaluate infrastructure improvements and contribute to cloud platform evolution.
* The opportunity to share knowledge and build AWS capability across the wider team.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced lifecycle management for Amazon EKS and Kubernetes platforms.
* Cloud infrastructure provisioning and maintenance using Terraform and Terragrunt.
* GitOps\-based deployment using GitHub, ArgoCD, Helm and Amazon EKS.
* CI/CD pipeline design and configuration for infrastructure and Kubernetes workloads.
* AWS RDS infrastructure maintenance, upgrading and rightsizing.
* Bottlerocket AMI rotation and Kubernetes worker\-node patching.
* Cloud observability and monitoring using Grafana and related platform components.
* AWS cost monitoring and optimisation using Cost Explorer and Budgets.
* Security, vulnerability management and compliance for AWS and EKS environments.
* Hybrid cloud connectivity design and implementation.
* Structured troubleshooting across cloud networking, storage, platform capacity and performance.
* Operational support practices for business\-critical cloud services.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with architecture, security, design and delivery teams.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

---------

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

-----------------------------

 UNIFY Dots is a global technology and software solutions company specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 based solutions. The job will be work from home but may require travel to the client site.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your job duties include the following tasks and responsibilities:
   

  

* Lead the implementation for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Project Operations, Human Resources, Copilot for Finance (“D365”) projects including analysis, design, build, test, train, cutover, operations, and support.
* Manage client engagement and lead client workshops to define business requirements required for them to successfully implement the D365 solution. Ensure these requirements are captured in Business Scenario Documents/ Functional Requirements Documents / User Stories per the requirements of the project and onto Azure DevOps.
* Lead Conference Room Pilots to show case the D365 solution to clients.
* Create deliverable examples for other team members including Design documents for complex customizations and report modifications.
* Lead Data mapping and import data into D365 using data entities.
* Perform Field mapping between D365 and other integrating systems.
* Lead the configuration of dual\-write between D365 and Power Apps and Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement Apps where needed
* Review design documents for customizations, reports for D365, data mapping and integration mapping written by other team members. Ensure the design documents capture boundary conditions and include comprehensive test scenarios.
* Oversee configuration of D365 and Copilot as required.
* Ensure a high\-quality AI\-enabled solution by providing leadership for testing including functional testing, integration testing and automated testing using the Regression suite automation test tool.
* Lead training for D365 and associated systems for clients as well as for other Unify Dots team members.
* Lead pre\-go live cutover and post go live support to clients and manage any issues including escalating to Microsoft for support.
* Maintain the Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect certification
* Provide pre\-sales support as required for key D365 deals by leveraging AI and writing business scenarios, configuring D365 and associated systems and present a winning demonstration to prospective customers
* Lead the usage of AI and Copilot in the organization and drive training sessions as well as creation of agents as related to ERP implementations for client environments.
* Prepare realistic and winnable estimations as well as scope of work and assumptions for customizations, report enhancements, workflows, batch jobs, upgrades, integrations and data migration work.


 Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* At least 8\+ years of experience in implementing Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics AX2012R3 Knowledge of D365 Finance \- GL, AP, AR, FA, Expense Mgmt and PMA is required.

* CA or CPA certification would be an added advantage.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Benefits :**

* Medical Insurance for Team member \+ Spouse \+ Children \+ Parents.

a734fad2.title: Solution Architect
a734fad2.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  

  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally\-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.
   

  





 FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.
   

  





**Your role and responsibilities:**



* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high\-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.



**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**



* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.
* Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.
* AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI\-enabled solutions.
* Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.
* Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.
* Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third\-party applications to streamline 3rd\-party integrations and facilitate data flow.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.
* Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.



**What success in this role looks like:**




 Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM
* Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience
* Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks
* Excellent listening and presentation skills
* 5\+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally
* Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections
* Skilled in negotiation and objection handling
* Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.
* Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams.



**Required skills:**



* 7\+ years of Professional Services experience in software industry in SaaS platforms
* Previous roles in Solution Architect or Domain Architect within ITIL oriented / ITSM systems are advantageous
* A problem\-solving innovator with a knack for thinking outside the box
* Proficient at creating architecture diagrams, process maps, data\-flow diagrams, and clear design documentation.
* Extensive expertise in Enterprise landscapes across various domains, including ERP systems, Accounting Systems, HRMS, IDAM, and more
* Demonstrated experience in designing customer experience process flows
* Strong understanding of the Cloud Stack and SaaS products
* Proficiency in developing custom apps and REST API\-based integrations
* Preferred, though not mandatory, background in Javascript and NodeJS



  

  





**Preferred skills:**



* ITIL Certification
* Knowledge of Project Management principals


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 


  


 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies that rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 


  


 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
 
 our wins.
 


  


 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!
 



 At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
   

 Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.
 


  


 We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
 **SOLUTION ARCHITECT** 
  to join 
 **PROFESSIONAL SERVICES** 
 in
 **INDIA.** 
 This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full\-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading. 
 


  


**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**



  


**Insight on your impact** 



  


 We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi\-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.
 


  


**What you'll be doing:** 



  


 As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:
 


  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping \& analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi\-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large\-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  


  


**Your qualifications, your influence** 



  


*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills* 



  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4\+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4\+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4\+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning \& Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results\-oriented, motivated, self\-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll\-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  


  


  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion** 

**and Belonging** 



  


 Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 


  


 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
 


  


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 



  


 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 


  


 Anaplan does not:
 


  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  


  


 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Everseen****: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.**

**The Role**

As a Program Manager \- Data Ops within the India Operations Team, you will be responsible for managing technical customer projects and ensuring those projects are delivered in a timely manner and to a high standard. You will bridge project delivery with core technical execution, working closely with Systems Engineers, Computer Vision/AI specialists, Product, and Data \& Operations teams. A critical focus of this role is leading technical performance initiatives—such as projects to optimize client Transaction Loss Prevention—and driving specialized internal and customer\-facing delivery tracks projects, and Pre\-annotation workflows. You should be a self\-starter with strong technical aptitude who is proud to strive for excellence.



**Job Responsibilities**
* **Project Execution \& Governance:** Accountable for the successful execution, management, and delivery of customer and internal technical projects, ensuring strict adherence to scope, budget, and schedule.
* **Planning \& Milestone Tracking:** Create, maintain, and update detailed project plans, tracking all milestones, technical dependencies, risks, and issues throughout the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle.
* **Client Performance \& Management:** Drive and manage Post\-deployment Performance \& System Tuning initiatives specifically aimed at continuously improving customer TLP metrics and loss prevention outcomes.
* **Specialized Technical Track Delivery:** Take project ownership of key technical systems and delivery streams, including **agentic performance improvement**, and **Pre\-annotations** data pipelines, ensuring smooth coordination between engineering, data, and delivery teams.
* **Stakeholder \& Customer Communication:** Lead customer communications, serving as the primary delivery and technical coordination point of contact to build strong working relationships and set clear expectations.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Global operations, Customer Success, Product Development, Systems Engineering, and Data/QC teams to maintain seamless alignment on technical requirements and project commitments.
* **Deployment \& Lifecycle Management:** Assist with managing ongoing deployments, model rollouts, and software upgrades, ensuring seamless integration into existing customer retail environments without service disruption.
* **Reporting \& Operational Insights:** Coordinate reporting with Global operations, Customer Success, and Data/Reporting teams, accessing historical project metrics to facilitate data\-driven decision\-making and forecasting.
* **Issue Resolution \& Jira Workflow:** Provide proactive problem\-solving for technical roadblocks, managing issue resolution, and coordinating Jira sprint boards across delivery and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* **Feature Validation \& Feedback Loops:** Collaborate with clients to validate new features, gather operational feedback, and funnel insights back to the Product and Engineering teams for continuous platform enhancement.


**Collaborating with**  


* Everseen’s Global Operations, Systems Engineering, Computer Vision/AI, Product, and Data \& Analytics teams, Post\-deployment Performance \& System Tuning
* Global retail enterprise customers and implementation partners
* Operational teams handling annotations, QC, and edge deployments


  

**Skills Required**

* **Experience:** Overall 10\+ years of experience with 3\+ years of program/project management experience managing technical or customer\-facing projects in a global, fast\-paced, matrixed technology organization.
* **Education \& Certifications:** A relevant bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or equivalent); PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum certification is an advantage.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Demonstrated familiarity with retail tech, computer vision/AI workflows, data annotation/pre\-annotation pipelines, or edge software solutions, automation opportunities.
* **Domain Track Record:** Experience managing performance\-tuning initiatives and platform\-specific deployments
* **Agile \& Delivery Tools:** Proficient with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, and modern project management tooling to manage backlogs, sprints, and status reporting.
* **Analytical Problem Solver:** Strong analytical mindset capable of interpreting system performance data, identifying bottlenecks, and driving corrective actions.
* **Communication \& Stakeholder Management:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business discussions with external clients and internal leadership.
**About** **Everseen**
======================


Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience.

Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily.

Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world \- including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths \- we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain.

We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.  



Our Culture



Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer\-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions.
We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact.  



Our Values

We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses.

We ARE CUSTOMER\-FIRST. They guide our decisions.

We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit.

We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality.

We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.

**Our Commitment**
------------------


Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion.

Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. Everseen will not tolerate prejudice or discrimination of any kind including without limitation, where based on aspects such as, race, colour, sex, gender, religion, age, family status, disability of any kind, sexual orientation.

**Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.**

You will bridge project delivery with core technical execution, working closely with Systems Engineers, Computer Vision/AI specialists, Product, and Data \& Operations teams. * Project Execution \& Governance: Accountable for the successful execution, management, and delivery of customer and internal technical projects, ensuring strict adherence to scope, budget, and schedule.
* Planning \& Milestone Tracking: Create, maintain, and update detailed project plans, tracking all milestones, technical dependencies, risks, and issues throughout the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Global operations, Customer Success, Product Development, Systems Engineering, and Data/QC teams to maintain seamless alignment on technical requirements and project commitments.
* Deployment \& Lifecycle Management: Assist with managing ongoing deployments, model rollouts, and software upgrades, ensuring seamless integration into existing customer retail environments without service disruption.
* Reporting \& Operational Insights: Coordinate reporting with Global operations, Customer Success, and Data/Reporting teams, accessing historical project metrics to facilitate data\-driven decision\-making and forecasting.
* Issue Resolution \& Jira Workflow: Provide proactive problem\-solving for technical roadblocks, managing issue resolution, and coordinating Jira sprint boards across delivery and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Feature Validation \& Feedback Loops: Collaborate with clients to validate new features, gather operational feedback, and funnel insights back to the Product and Engineering teams for continuous platform enhancement.


**Collaborating with**
* Everseen’s Global Operations, Systems Engineering, Computer Vision/AI, Product, and Data \& Analytics teams, Post\-deployment Performance \& System Tuning
* Global retail enterprise customers and implementation partners
* Operational teams handling annotations, QC, and edge deployments


**Skills Required**
* Experience: Overall 10\+ years of experience with 3\+ years of program/project management experience managing technical or customer\-facing projects in a global, fast\-paced, matrixed technology organization.

* Analytical Problem Solver: Strong analytical mindset capable of interpreting system performance data, identifying bottlenecks, and driving corrective actions.

 Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world \- including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths \- we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.
   

  

 Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain.
   

  

 We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.

421de269.title: AWS /.NET Solution Architect — Cloud & Application Modernization
421de269.description:
About the opportunity

Join 360 Business Solutions as an AWS/.NET Solution Architect on enterprise modernization engagements focused on data center exit, AWS migration, and re\-platforming of legacy Microsoft SQL Server business logic into modern .NET services. You will define target architecture, guide engineers, and ensure technical decisions support scalable, secure, cloud\-native delivery.

Key responsibilities

· Define and evolve solution architecture for AWS\-hosted .NET / .NET Core applications replacing legacy on\-prem and SQL\-centric logic.

· Produce architecture decision records, reference patterns, and integration designs for APIs, data access, messaging, and identity.

· Lead technical discovery related to undocumented stored\-procedure business logic and map it to modern service boundaries.

· Partner with Database Modernization and API/Integration engineers on migration patterns (strangler, dual\-run, cutover).

· Establish non\-functional requirements: security, observability, performance, resilience, and cost efficiency on AWS.

· Review designs and code for adherence to architecture standards; mentor senior engineers.

· Collaborate with DevOps on infrastructure\-as\-code, environments, and deployment topology (containers, serverless, or hybrid as appropriate).

Required qualifications

· 8\+ years software architecture / senior engineering experience with substantial .NET / .NET Core delivery.

· Hands\-on AWS architecture experience (compute, networking, storage, IAM, databases, messaging).

· Deep understanding of migrating monolithic or database\-centric applications to service\-oriented / cloud designs.

· Strong SQL Server knowledge and ability to reason about stored\-procedure\-heavy systems.

· Ability to communicate architecture clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.

· Experience guiding distributed Agile teams remotely.

Preferred / nice\-to\-have

· AWS Solutions Architect Professional (or Associate with deep practical experience).

· Exposure to Azure alongside AWS; Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar IaC.

· Marketplace, e\-commerce, or high\-throughput transactional domain experience.

· Familiarity with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, or polyglot modernization paths.

How we hire

Candidates complete role\-specific skills assessments on the 360 Teams platform, including objective scoring and rubric\-graded code or long\-answer evaluations, before advancing to interviews with the engagement team. You will be employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) in the Philippines or India, with 360 Business Solutions managing onboarding, ongoing support, and career development. This role requires meaningful working\-hours overlap with the client’s US business day; specific overlap expectations, equipment, and benefits are discussed during the hiring process.

Compensation: Competitive compensation (details provided during the hiring process).

Work Location: Remote

7238134c.description:
**About Loop**


Loop is a subscription management platform built for e\-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.


We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved \~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025\. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2026 as we accelerate toward our $50M goal.

**Our DNA:**

* High Agency action over instruction
* High Ethics trust is the foundation
* Positive Attitude solutions over excuses

**Responsibilities**

* **Sales solutioning:** Attending sales conversations with technical leadership (CTOs etc) and consulting them on solutioning/ architecture using Loop’s existing APIs/ portal/ custom CSS and JS.
* **Client Onboarding:** Collaborate with the onboarding specialists to understand the technical requirements and ensure smooth onboarding of the merchants.
* **Data migration:** Own the migration infrastructure to help merchants migrate their subscriptions data from their previous platform to Loop ensuring no data loss and errors.
* **Technical Support:** Provide technical support to clients during the onboarding process, addressing any issues or concerns promptly.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain documentation for common configurations, data migration process and popular troubleshooting for speed resolution.

**Ideal Profile**

* Minimum of 4\-5 years of experience in tech operations or a related role.
* Good communication skills
* Proficiency in JavaScript, CSS, HTML and Python scripts
* Experience in working with e\-commerce platforms, particularly Shopify, is a significant advantage.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced and dynamic team environment.
* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently when required.

a867af05.title: Sr Manager, Data Architecture
a867af05.description:
**About the Team**  

Joining the Stanley Black \& Decker team means joining one of the world’s largest, fastest\-growing, and most dynamic companies. Stanley Black \& Decker is unique in that we’ve got a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn’t stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company poised and ready for the future.
  

  

Being a part of our team means living our core values of


* courage \& innovation
* agility \& performance
* inclusivity \& collaboration
* integrity \& accountability

It means thriving in an environment of constant innovation and positive change. It means delivering tools, services, and solutions that the world counts on when it really matters. It means maintaining the highest standards in everything you do, every day.


**Key Responsibilities**

Develops data and information management and analytics patterns and blueprints establishing principles, reference architectures, guardrails, and standards. Enables data confidentiality, integrity and availability Optimizes data architecture, data models and database including designing, developing and deploying improved conceptual, logical and physical data artifacts. Defines data standards including design patterns. Develops data and metadata policies and procedures for structural design and development to build, maintain and leverage the data model, ensuring integration with corporate data standards


**Key Activities**

* Influences and deep focus on technical Data Architecture standards \& guidelines, Data Management practices, policies and procedures
* Provides technical leadership for legacy platform modernization
* Proactively mitigates data risks with advanced security/compliance controls
* Ensure adherence to the standards \& practices to drive consistency, timeliness, quality, security and delivery of data in a cost\-effective and timely fashion
* Accountable for driving data solutions (PoC to implementation) for service requirements by planning and managing multiple complex data architecture design efforts
* Accountable for oversight on creation and maintenance of the subject area data warehouse / record of reference
* Champions advanced analytics and AI/ML adoption
* Accountable for review of existing data architectures to determine overall effectiveness and compliance with original objectives
* Deep focus \& accountability on driving innovation and applying industry recognized best practices, compliance standards and techniques to prevent/minimize data redundancies across the organization
* Mentors Data Architecture team on complex challenges around performance, availability and scalability of the physical database
* Evangelize master data management and working with MDM and business teams who own the data
* Accountable to drive collaboration with the solution and domain architects to develop methods for synchronizing data entering company systems
* Works with outside partners to ensure SBD requirements are met
* Evangelize Enterprise Data Governance strategy

**Functional Skills:**

* Ability to tie together solutions across systems
* Business acumen
* Business process modeling
* Facilitation
* Knowledge of required technologies (incl. 3rd party solutions)
* Statistical modeling
* Understanding of future technologies
* ITFS Project Methodology knowledge

**Technical Skills**

* Experience with Big Data Analytics \& tools/frameworks like Hadoop, Spark, Kafka etc
* Data Architecture \& Modeling
* Data warehouse technologies
* Expertise in Master Data Management
* Expertise in Data Modeling Tools
* Expertise in Data Visualization
* Expertise in Data Governance, Metadata management
* Integration Technologies \& ETL/ELT tools
* Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Leads through influence, drives innovation in global teams
* Conceptual thinking
* Creative thinking
* Problem solving / analytical thinking
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Interpersonal skills
* Ability to execute
* Ability to prioritize and make trade\-off decisions
* Adaptability / ability to manage change
* Strong growth mindset

**Education/ Experience**

* Undergraduate degree and 13\+ years relevant experience, or
* Graduate degree and 10\-12 years relevant experience.
* Additional training or certification in organization change management highly desirable
* Previous experience as a successful enterprise architect highly desirable
* 7 to 10 years of experience in at least two IT disciplines (such as technical architecture, solution architecture, network management, application development, middleware design, information analysis, database management or operations management) in a heterogeneous environment — or five years of experience in solution architecture, business analysis or business strategic planning
* Demonstrated track record of leading high\-performance teams toward the successful attainment of challenging goals
* Internal or external management of those units.

***We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.***

Joining the Stanley Black \& Decker team means working in an innovative, tech\-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black \+ Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.


**Who We Are**

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4\.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state\-of\-the\-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers \& greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.


**Global Benefits \& Perks**  

You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire.


**What You’ll Also Get**

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60\+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.


**Learning \& Development:**  

Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state\-of\-the\-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).


**Diverse \& Inclusive Culture:**  

We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.


**Purpose\-Driven Company:**  

You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

 Worked on implementation RFPs as a solution architect responsible for designing solutions end to end

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
* Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

fd07bd9b.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced SAP Solution Architect with a strong track record in SAP S/4HANA implementation and solution design across at least one major end\-to\-end business process, such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Plan to Produce, Account to Report, or Inbound to Outbound.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, deliver, and maintain secure, compliant, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions that meet business needs and enable efficient operations. You will work closely with business\-facing organizations, business partners, process architects, project teams, implementation partners, and operational teams throughout the planning, preparation, execution, and monitoring of projects and business enhancements.
   

  

 You will lead solution discussions, contribute to enterprise architecture decisions, and ensure effective integration across ERP components and connected applications. You will also be accountable for solution quality across the application life cycle, from initial concept and design through implementation, deployment, stabilization, and operational support.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Lead the design and delivery of SAP S/4HANA solutions and related project activities.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, compliant, maintainable, and supportable SAP solutions.
* Collaborate with business partners and process architects to identify fit\-for\-purpose, sustainable, and value\-adding solutions.
* Assess solution options, provide architecture recommendations, and contribute to design decisions that shape the SAP landscape.
* Ensure effective integration across SAP modules including SD/LE, MM, EWM, TM, FI, CO, GTS, EH\&S, and non\-SAP applications like OpenText, Loftware, 3PL systems, Tax applications.
* Provide technical leadership throughout project delivery, business enhancements, testing, deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through high\-quality solution design, application life\-cycle management, reliable project delivery, and effective service introduction.
* Ensure compliance with internal process and security requirements and external obligations, including GxP, GDPR, and software licensing requirements.
* Minimize business disruption during go\-live through robust design, effective testing, cutover planning, operational readiness, and a formal project handover process.


**Project delivery**
* Define solution scope, dependencies, interfaces, non\-functional requirements, and technical acceptance criteria.
* Review and approve solution designs in accordance with architecture principles, development standards, and established guidelines.
* Support project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure that solution documentation, test evidence, operational procedures, and handover materials are complete before production release.
* Support post\-go\-live stabilization and the transition of new or enhanced solutions into operational support.


**Change, release, and application life\-cycle management**
* Ensure adherence to change and release management processes in line with relevant standard operating procedures.
* Monitor execution of the application life\-cycle management plan for applications in scope.
* Ensure complete and accurate handover documentation is created and approved before production release.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve the SAP application landscape.


**Who You Are**
* Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* At least 12 years of professional experience with SAP applications.
* At least 6 years of experience working in an international environment.
* Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation, project delivery and solution architecture.
* Experience leading technical discussions and coordinating internal teams, business stakeholders, and external delivery partners.
* Experience in regulated environments and with compliance\-related requirements is an advantage.
* Management and leadership experience in an international environment.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with business partners, process architects, vendors, and technical teams.
* Ability to make sound decisions, manage ambiguity, and act autonomously.
* Strong customer focus and a high level of ownership for solution quality and delivery outcomes.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

e9b487a2.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
e9b487a2.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.### **The Role**



The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer\-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value\-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross\-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts and executive engagement.



The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.



### **What You’ll Do**


* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof\-of\-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.
### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years overall experience including 3\+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre\-sales and solution consulting customer\-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands\-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy\-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer\-facing engagements from preparation through follow\-up.
### **Perks \& Benefits**


* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break
###### **\#LI\-Remote**


###### **\#LI\-Associate**

  

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

e16960b9.title: Sr. Solution Architect, Startups
e16960b9.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Do you like startups? Are you interested in Cloud Computing \& Generative AI? Yes? We have a role you might find interesting.
   

  

 Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers, or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that’s capital, engineering resource, or experience. This is where you come in.
   

  

 The Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with these early stage startup companies as they build their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.
   

  

 We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with early stage startups to help them as they grow. In this role, you’ll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You’ll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.
   

  

 As well as spending time working directly with customers, you’ll also get plenty of time to “sharpen the saw” and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories and it’s important that we can help startups take advantages of the right ones. You’ll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the startups you work with. And for the customers you don’t get to work with on a 1:1 basis you’ll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You’re surrounded by innovation. You’re empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Your experience and career development is in your hands. We live our leadership principles every day. At Amazon, it's always "Day 1".
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth

1a9c1088.title: Sr. Program Manager, Brand Protections
1a9c1088.description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5\+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.


 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.
* Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade\-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.
* Own complex enforcement decisions in ambiguous, high\-stakes situations, setting precedents that scale across geographies


**About The Team**
 The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
