 • Work closely with: 
 



 o Claims business teams 
 



 o Operations teams 
 



 o Customer IT, architecture, and security teams 
 



 o System integrators 
 



 o Third\-party vendors and external partners 
 



 • Drive workshops to understand current\-state processes, future\-state  requirements, gaps, and dependencies. 
 



 • Convert business requirements into practical, scalable solution designs while  balancing product capability versus customer\-specific customisation. • Handle ambiguity during discovery phases and bring structure to incomplete or  evolving requirements. 
 



 • Make real\-time decisions during testing, cutover, and production support  situations. 
 



 • Support high\-pressure go\-live activities, defect triage, business escalations, and  hypercare. 
 



 • Ensure customer confidence through strong communication, ownership, and  decisive problem\-solving. 
 



  





**2\. Enterprise Integration Ownership** 




  





 • Own end\-to\-end integration architecture between the Claims Platform  and the insurer ecosystem. 
 



 • Hands\-on experience integrating claims solutions with: 
 



 o Policy Administration Systems 
 



 o CRM and omni\-channel platforms 
 



 o Document Management Systems (DMS) 
 



 o Payment and finance systems 
 



 o External provider, hospital, TPA, and regulatory ecosystems 
 



 o Customer communication platforms such as SMS, email, portals, and  contact centres 
 



 • Define and drive the overall API and integration strategy for customer  implementations. 
 



 • Design synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns across upstream  and downstream systems. 
 



 • Own error handling, retry mechanisms, exception management, reconciliation,  and operational monitoring for integrations. 
 



 • Ensure end\-to\-end data consistency and transaction integrity across multiple  systems. 
 



 • Work with customer enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure the  solution fits within the broader insurer landscape. 
 



 • Support data mapping, interface specifications, payload definitions, and  integration testing. 
 



 • Provide architectural guidance on performance, dependency management, and  system interoperability. 
 



  





**3\. Claims Product \& Domain Mastery** 




 • Demonstrate deep expertise in Life and Health claims processes and operating  models. 
 



 • Strong understanding of: 
 



 o Pre\-authorisation workflows 
 



 o Reimbursement and cashless claims 
 



 o Auto\-adjudication and manual assessment flows 
 



 o Claims intake and registration 
 



 o Medical coding and clinical pathways 
 



 o Provider and hospital workflows 
 



 o Claims payment, settlement, and recovery 
 



 o Fraud, Waste, and Abuse controls 
 



 o Claims correspondence and communication processes 
 



 • Guide customers on how to use the platform effectively rather than over customising it. 
 



 • Identify where customer requirements can be solved through product  configuration versus custom development. 
 



 • Ensure solution designs align with industry best practices and support  operational efficiency. 
 



 • Understand the broader impact of claims processes on customer experience,  operational teams, provider networks, and downstream finance systems.
 



  





 • Be able to challenge customer requests when they introduce  unnecessary complexity, operational risk, or deviation from the product  roadmap. 
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by combining deep claims  knowledge with practical implementation experience. 
 



  





**Experience Profile** 




 • 12\+ years of total experience 
 



 • 2\- 4\+ years of experience specifically in Life and Health Claims platforms • Proven experience leading international, on\-site insurance implementations • Strong exposure to APAC, EMEA, or other global insurer environments • Experience working across complex insurer IT landscapes and multiple  stakeholder groups 
 



 • Hands\-on involvement in large\-scale implementations, production go\-lives, and  hypercare 
 



 • Strong ability to work across business, technology, and delivery teams • Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes under pressure 
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Smooth and predictable go\-lives with minimal escalations 
 



 • Strong confidence and trust from customer CIOs, Heads of Claims, and  business leadership teams 
 



 • Well\-designed integrations and stable production systems 
 



 • Delivery teams aligned to a product\-first implementation approach • Clear architectural decisions with minimal ambiguity or rework • Faster implementation cycles with reduced delivery risk 
 


* • Reduced dependency on founders and senior leadership for delivery assurance • Customers viewing the individual as a trusted advisor rather than only a  technical architect

7bb9f3a3.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
7bb9f3a3.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer\-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value\-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross\-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof\-of\-concepts and executive engagement.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof\-of\-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years overall experience including 3\+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre\-sales and solution consulting customer\-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.


****Nice to Have****
* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands\-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy\-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer\-facing engagements from preparation through follow\-up.


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Health \& wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

b3222881.description:
**About VikingCloud:** 




 VikingCloud is the leading Predict\-to\-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost\-effective risk mitigation decisions – faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform™, the industry’s largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6\+ billion online events every day.
 



  





 VikingCloud is the one\-stop partner trusted by 4\+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.
 



  





**This Position** 




 Sales Engineering focused on pre\-sales and on\-going client support.
 



 Location : Vadodara (Work from office)
 



 Shift : US Shift
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 As a Pre\-Sales Engineer your responsibilities will include:
 


* Pre\-sales support for Compliance, Managed Security Sales, and Security consulting opportunity for designated accounts
* Engage clients in defining and identifying business requirements relating to Managed Security Solutions, Compliance Solutions, Managed Security Testing, and Vulnerability Management.
* Own and positively develop the relationships with key technical decision makers and influencers within target customers
* Drive new sales opportunities by proactively engaging with the technical community within target accounts
* Scope and clearly translate defined requirements, proposed solutions, and value proposition into Proposals/Statement of Work (SOW).
* Present and articulate our value proposition to customers at all levels within the organization both technical and business audience (including C\-levels)
* Be a trusted advisor who provide sound security advise to customer and help them establish business case, including TCO and ROI justification, and shape requirement
* Be the voice\-of\-customer, channeling constructive feedback from value customer to provide market\-driven inputs to our product and services team
* Be the solution owner, taking lead and working with cross\-functioning team including professional services, product management, sales, and marketing to drive the development of market\-driven solution and services, and for marketing events



  





**Qualifications** 




 As a Pre\-Sales Security Consultant your skills and qualifications will include:
 


* Must have at least 3 years of strong hands\-on experience in Cyber Security with at least 2 years in technical solutioning and presales
* Significant professional experience in a presales/sales engineering role within managed services or professional services, focused on supporting sales to Enterprise accounts
* Must have experience working in a customer\-facing role and comfortable presenting to a small to medium audiences on both technical and business\-related topics
* Strong communications skills for product demonstrations and presentations to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Excellent written skills for RFP responses, proposals, pricing, and gathering technical requirements
* Must have working technical knowledge of security technologies (across multiple domains such as SIEM, EDR, Cloud Security, Firewall, Network IPS, DLP etc.), information security concepts and familiar with security products (Microsoft, Palo Alto, Netskope, Splunk, Carbon Black, Fortinet etc.) and the security marketplace.



  





 Desirable:
 


* Professional security related qualification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, GIAC or equivalent
* Working knowledge and familiarity with GRC and Offensive Security consulting services (e.g. penetration testing, PCI audit, security assessment) is highly desirable (pre\-sales perspective)
* Broad experience and understanding of industry standards, framework, and best practices such as ISO27001, PCI DSS, NIST, etc.
* Broad experience and understanding of security trend, threat landscape and framework such as the cyber kill\-chain
* Experience with Managed Security Services or Professional Services
* Experience in preparing technical architecture blueprint and responding to large scale complex RFP



  





  





 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, political affiliation or opinion, medical condition, status as a veteran, and/or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

* Build industry analytics use cases with the right KPIs and dashboards. These cover real estate, oil \& gas, banking, FMCG, manufacturing, and healthcare. Examples include occupancy and revenue, production and SCADA telemetry, regulatory reporting and customer 360, sell\-out and trade promotion, OEE, and patient flow.
* Build and deliver tailored Fabric and Power BI demos, and run Proof of Value engagements that convert into signed projects.
* Write technical proposals, SOWs, BOMs, effort estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Microsoft sellers and Partner Development Managers on co\-sell (MSX) and partner incentive programs.
* Build reusable presales material, including pitch decks, demo environments, and industry use case packs.



**Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years in data engineering, BI, or analytics, including at least 2 years in presales or solution consulting.
* Strong hands\-on Microsoft Fabric knowledge, or equivalent experience with Synapse, Azure Data Factory, or Power BI Premium.
* Strong Power BI, SQL, and data modelling skills, with the ability to build a convincing demo quickly.
* Proven ability to build industry analytics use cases for real estate, oil \& gas, banking, FMCG, or manufacturing.
* Excellent presentation skills: confident with C\-level audiences, clear at telling a data story, and able to handle questions on the spot.
* Experience with discovery workshops, demos, RFPs, proposals, and SOWs.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* Nice to have: DP\-600, DP\-700, or PL\-300 certification; Real\-Time Intelligence (KQL, Eventstream, Eventhouse) experience; presales experience with MENA or Africa customers; Arabic language skills.



**What We Offer** 



* Fully remote from India, with flexible hours that overlap with the MENA working day.
* Periodic travel to MENA and Africa for customer engagements and Microsoft events.
* Sponsored Microsoft certifications and a clear path to Presales Lead.
* A competitive base salary plus a bonus linked to deals won.

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with the product and engineering teams to represent the voice of the customer, define priorities, and influence the product roadmap, helping with the adoption of Databricks’ AI offerings

+ ML Engineer: Build and maintain production\-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
+ AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs \& agentic systems, including vector databases, fine\-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI

* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non\-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life\-long learning, and driving business value through ML \& AI

33b23d63.title: Senior Staff Security Architect
33b23d63.description:
**Position Overview**  

  

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Staff Security Architect to assist the design, implementation, and governance of secure infrastructure across on\-premises, AWS, and Azure environments. This role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native security, secure software development strategies, information security and security engineering, with an eye towards automation and infrastructure\-as\-code. You will be responsible for reviewing software and infrastructure architectures, engineering robust security controls, and owning the automation of go\-live security reviews to ensure scalable and secure cloud deployments.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Cloud Security Architecture: Design and maintain secure cloud architectures for AWS and Azure platforms, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and compliance requirements.
* Software Architecture Review: Collaborate with engineering teams to review application and infrastructure designs, identifying and mitigating security risks early in the development lifecycle.
* Security Engineering: Develop and implement advanced security controls, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption, and monitoring solutions.
* Automation Ownership: Lead the development of automated pipelines and tooling for go\-live security reviews, integrating with CI/CD workflows to enforce security gates.
* Governance \& Compliance: Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory and organizational compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX, CJIS).
* Mentorship \& Leadership: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior security engineers and cross\-functional teams.
* Incident Response Support: Collaborate with incident response teams to advise on cloud\-related security incidents.

  

**Required Qualifications**  

* 7\+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4 years focused on cloud security architecture.
* Strong background in software development (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar).
* Deep expertise in AWS and Azure cloud platforms, including native security services.
* Proven experience conducting software and infrastructure architecture reviews.
* Demonstrated ability to design and implement automated security review pipelines.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code/configuration\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Ansible, Puppet, etc).
* Experience with container security (e.g., Kubernetes, EKS, AKS) and serverless architecture.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and CI/CD integration.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISSP, or CCSP.
* Experience with multi\-cloud security strategies and hybrid environments.
* Knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CSA CCM, and MITRE ATT\&CK
**We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!**

a7d0015b.title: GDS Consulting - Microsoft 365 Solution Architect - Manager
a7d0015b.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Microsoft 365 solution architecture** 
**/ Technical manager 1\-2** 
 –
 **Consulting**
 EY GDS Consulting – Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Architect with a strong background in building and modernizing enterprise collaboration and content solutions. The role sits within the Enterprise Content and Modern Work practice, delivering integrated, compliant, and scalable solutions to clients across multiple regions.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for professionals with deep expertise in Microsoft 365 solution architecture, custom development, and integration to join our Digital Engineering Consulting team. This role offers the opportunity to work with a leading global organization, contribute to complex transformation and modernization initiatives, and play a key role in shaping and growing our modern workplace and integration service offerings.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Produces high\-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
* Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
* Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
* Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
* Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
* Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.


**Skills And Attributes**
* 7–12 years of experience in enterprise solution architecture and development
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
+ SharePoint Framework (SPFx)
+ Microsoft Teams app development
+ .NET / C\#
+ REST APIs and integration patterns

* Proven experience designing enterprise\-grade M365 solutions
* Strong understanding of modern workplace concepts (collaboration, productivity, extensibility)
* Excellent architectural thinking beyond platform\-specific constraints
* Experience designing integrated solutions across multiple systems
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native and modern application architectures
* Ability to define standards, patterns, and best practices


**Core Skills:**
* Microsoft 365 \& SharePoint: SPFx development, PnP Framework, PowerShell automation
* Application Development: .NET, C\#, React, Azure Functions, enterprise\-grade solution design
* Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents with governance awareness
* Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, security, and integration with Power Platform and custom apps
* Integration Architecture: REST \& SOAP APIs, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, secure enterprise integrations
* Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control


**Desirable Skills:**
* Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
* Microsoft Syntex: AI\-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
* AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
* Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
* Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
* PCF Controls: Custom PowerApps Component Framework development using React and TypeScript


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self\-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor's or master's degree
* Strong experience across Microsoft SharePoint (on‑premises and online), with the ability to modernize and extend solutions beyond platform constraints
* Proven hands\-on expertise with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps, and Power Automate for building modern, extensible business solutions
* Strong front\-end development skills using TypeScript, React, Angular, and Fluent UI, with an emphasis on scalable and reusable components
* Solid experience with PowerShell and PnP for automation, provisioning, and enterprise governance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to operate as a solution architect and trusted advisor


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**About EY**
 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.
   

  

**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**
**Join us in building a better working world.**
**Apply now**
**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

db13a029.description:
**Job Description**
 As a SAP CO, a solid understanding of end\-to\-end finance value flows, and hands\-on experience in S/4HANA implementations and transformations. Exposure to digital transformation, automation, and AI/Agentic AI concepts will be a strong advantage.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead and support Controlling (CO) and FPRA processes, including Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Project Controlling
* Drive solution design, configuration, and deployment for SAP Finance initiatives, especially in S/4HANA environments
* Transformation programs (S/4HANA, RISE, ERP modernization)
* Enhancements and production support
* Ensure strong alignment between R2R, CO, FPRA, and other finance sub\-modules
* Participate in Business requirement gathering, Fit\-gap analysis, Solution design (FSDs, BPDs, DADs), SIT/UAT and deployment
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (IT, Business, Vendors) to ensure end\-to\-end process integration
* Support data migration, system integration, and financial validation activities
* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives
* Contribute to digital transformation programs


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field with Minimum 12\+ years of experience in SAP FICO, with strong focus on Controlling (CO)
* Proven experience in S/4HANA implementation or transformation programs
* Strong understanding of Finance value flows (R2R, CO, FPRA, O2C, S2P integration),Cross\-module integration
* Hands\-on experience in SAP CO configuration and solution design,Working in global ERP environments
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Exposure to global stakeholders


**Nice\-To\-Have:**
* Experience in Central Finance (CFIN), Group Reporting, BW/Reporting tools, Automation tools (RPA, workflows)
* Exposure to AI / Generative AI / Agentic AI, Agile / Azure DevOps


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond

 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

 Broad outline of the Role
   

  

 The role owns the design and development of solution architecture with respect to technical solution design and service design for complex solutions in the respective areas of Network/SDWAN/Cloud and security/Unified Collaboration/Mobility and IoT/other domains with the objective of increasing revenue, profitability, and market competitive. This is a tactical role which defines the direction of new solutions, processes, standards based upon business strategy or customer need, with a significant mid\-term impact on business unit overall results.

 Bachelors degree in engineering; 7\-12 Years relevant experience

 Understanding on Enterprise Architecture, business concepts, processes, and requirements
   

  

 Experience in creating HLD and LLD
   

  

 Developing creative, logical solutions and assisting in the presentation of findings and recommendations to clients
   

  

 Industry domain knowledge of key technology and industry trends

6350d569.title: Senior Consultant – Salesforce Service & Data Cloud
6350d569.description:
We are looking for a **Senior Salesforce Consultant** with strong hands\-on experience in **Salesforce Service Cloud and Data Cloud** to join our team in Bangalore.

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting Salesforce implementations, solution design, development, integrations, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform enhancements. You will work closely with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable and high\-quality Salesforce solutions.

Experience with **Salesforce Field Service** will be highly valuable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and customize **Salesforce Service Cloud** features and solutions.
* Design and support the ingestion and integration of data from multiple disparate sources into **Salesforce Service Cloud and Data Cloud**.
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using declarative tools, including **Flows, Validation Rules, Formula Fields, and Page Layouts**.
* Develop **Apex classes and triggers** and custom **Lightning Web Components (LWC)**.
* Gather requirements and contribute to **solution design reviews and sprint planning**.
* Support the development of high\-quality digital experience portals.
* Provide technical guidance to architects and development teams on when to use **Salesforce out\-of\-the\-box functionality versus custom development**.
* Apply Salesforce best practices across design and implementation.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and provide support to end users.
* Collaborate with and support developers when required.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions and development processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field**, or equivalent experience.
* **8\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce experience**, with strong expertise in Service Cloud or related Salesforce modules.
* Experience participating in at least **one end\-to\-end Service Cloud implementation** and **one Data Cloud implementation**.
* Strong knowledge of the Salesforce platform, including:
* Objects and data model
* Security model
* Profiles and Permission Sets
* Flows
* Governor Limits
* Storage optimization
* Strong understanding of **Salesforce Data Cloud**, including data segmentation, data spaces, data indexing, and related concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with **Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC)**.
* Experience using **Salesforce CLI and VS Code**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Data Cloud and data ingestion from multiple sources**.
* Good understanding of **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** and version control using **Git**.
* Strong understanding of **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP)** concepts.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with architects, developers, and business stakeholders.
* A **“Let me help” mindset** with a proactive and collaborative approach.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **REST API integrations**.
* Experience with middleware or iPaaS platforms, particularly **Azure\-based integration solutions**.
* Familiarity with **Salesforce Agentforce**.
* Experience with **Salesforce Field Service**.
* Experience with **CRM Analytics**.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to work on challenging Salesforce projects involving **Service Cloud, Data Cloud, integrations, and digital transformation**, while collaborating with experienced Salesforce architects and developers.

If you are an experienced Salesforce professional looking for your next opportunity, we would be interested in hearing from you.

Pay: ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Understand functional requirements and should be able to develop technical design using standard patterns and be able to communicate the same effectively to the team members.

 As technology rapidly evolves, it’s more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client’s toughest business problems.
   

  

 Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world's leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

 : Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast\-changing, customer\-driven environments.

**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Lead Cloud Applications Consultant serves as the trusted technical advisor, primary point of contact, and technical leader for a portfolio of strategic OpenText Cloud customers.The role combines deep technical expertise, customer engagement, cloud operations leadership, and technical governance. The TSM is responsible for driving customer success, platform health, operational excellence, and long\-term value realization across the entire customer lifecycle. Working closely with Customer Success, Cloud Operations, Engineering, Product Management, Professional Services, and Support teams, the TSM ensures customers receive a proactive, connected, and outcome\-focused experience.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
* Building credibility as a trusted technical advisor.
* Leading strategic customer discussions and executive\-level engagements.
* Managing complex OpenText cloud\-hosted environments.
* Understanding customer business goals and translating them into technical solutions.
* Driving customer adoption, operational excellence, and platform optimization.
* Navigating complex stakeholder environments and influencing across organizational boundaries.
* Troubleshooting critical issues and leading high\-impact escalations.
* Identifying opportunities for automation and operational improvements.
* Demonstrating strong ownership, accountability, communication, and customer focus.


**What You Need To Succeed**
* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Consulting, Cloud Services, Managed Services, Enterprise Application Management, Technical Account Management, or related customer\-facing technology roles.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and leading complex technical engagements.
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-based service delivery and operational support models.
* Subject Matter Expert in OpenText Content Management technologies including Content Server, Extended ECM (xECM), Archive Server, OTDS, Search \& Indexing, Brava, PowerDocs, and related integrations.
* Experience with SAP, SuccessFactors, Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and Engineering integrations.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications across Windows, Linux/UNIX, web/application servers, databases, and cloud platforms.

374e3242.description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 A Principal Consultant Client Services at Argano plays a crucial role in shaping the direction of the Client Services family. They are responsible for managing and enhancing relationships with mid\-to\-large clients to ensure their satisfaction, retention, and continued business with the company. They are involved in setting strategic goals, leading mid to large size client initiatives, and providing expert guidance to both clients and internal teams and providing advanced technical support and configurations when requested. They act as a bridge between the client and Argano, ensuring that client needs are understood and met. A Principal Consultant is constantly implementing and testing enhancements as well as new functionality.
 **This position requires module expertise in Oracle HCM Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting. Additional modules are a plus.**
**Responsibilities**
* Maintain regular communication with mid to large size clients to understand their needs, concerns, and feedback. Respond promptly to client inquiries and resolve issues in a timely manner.
* Align existing client practices and procedures with validated HCM Cloud methods to solve client needs and challenges.
* Troubleshoot issues.
* Propose a best practice solution to resolve challenges.
* Identify business requirements and map them to the Oracle Cloud functionality.
* Identify functionality gaps and develop solutions to them, through process or design.
* Configure the Oracle Cloud to meet client requirements and document application set\-ups.
* Analyze and resolve functionality issues as well as proactively identifying long\-term solutions.
* Lead and present to clients and internally
* Advise clients on options, risks and any impacts on other processes and/or systems.
* Manage scope and client expectations on individual assignments and in day\-to\-day activities.
* Lead and support clients with the execution of test scripts.
* Participate in internal forums for training, teamwork, issue resolution and innovative design.
* Provide knowledge transfer to clients.
* Create specification documents for technical object development.
* Be leaders with a vision in the Oracle Cloud space with innovative solutions around the product.
* Constant Implementation and testing of advanced enhancements as well as new functionality.
* Manage and oversee client accounts, including contract renewals, upselling, and cross\-selling products or services.
* Develop account plans to maximize value for both the client and Argano.
* Focuses on maintenance, reconfiguration, new functionality or modules.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction by delivering exceptional client service and addressing any client issues or complaints.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business goals and objectives. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to help clients achieve their goals through the company's products or services.
* Work closely with internal sales, marketing, Project managers, etc. to align client needs with Argano’s offerings.
* Prepare and present regular reports to management and clients, outlining key performance metrics and the status of client accounts.


**Education**
**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.) expected.


**Experience**
* 5 \- 10 years of Managed Services experience in Multi Client environment.
* Module\-specific experience in Benefits and either Workforce Compensation or Recruiting.
* Demonstrated experience in understanding business practice concepts in your modules of expertise.
* Track record of building long\-lasting relationships with your clients
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* 3 full life cycle Oracle HCM Cloud implementations
* Ability to understand fundamental system design and purpose.
* Ability to engage effectively at the business and technical level.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Oracle certified in your modules of expertise.
* Ability to manage/deliver projects, including experience planning and estimating.
* Validated ability to support sales as Subject Matter Expert
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Knowledge of challenges commonly faced by client and support teams.
* Ability to work well autonomously and in a team environment.
* Ability to effectively manage priorities and multiple clients.
* Self\-motivated and able to plan work effort and manage priorities.
* Experience Leading and managing mid\-size client projects independently.
* Experience providing complex solutions to clients.
* Proven track record of successful project management and client satisfaction.

Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next\-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

 At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500\+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm.  Planview is looking for a

 Work Mode: Hybrid

* Support Planview SaaS applications: monitoring, delivery coordination, and reporting.

* Manage user access, security roles, and governance within client portfolios.
* Build reporting and dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to give clients visibility into portfolio health, risk, and performance.
* Maintain positive, trusted relationships with customers through proactive communication and reliable service delivery.


**What You'll Bring**
* 2\+ years of experience in managed services, technical support, or SaaS application administration.
* Intermediate SQL skills (Oracle SQL or Microsoft SQL) and comfort troubleshooting web/application\-tier issues (e.g., IIS).
* Working knowledge of project/agile/lean portfolio management concepts and tools (Planview, Clarity, CA PPM, JIRA, or similar).
* Experience with reporting and dashboarding tools, Power BI preferred.
* Basic understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis as they relate to portfolio management.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to work independently as a subject matter expert for clients.

 At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
   

  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company\-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.


 Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best\-in\-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!
   

  

**AI Use in Recruitment**
 Planview may employ AI\-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. Questions regarding the processing of your data may be directed to privacy@planview.com.

d680c289.title: Team Lead or Delivery Lead
d680c289.description:
Job Description: Team Lead / Delivery Lead

Company: Yalabs Solutions Private Limited Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu (on\-site/hybrid)

Type: Full\-time Experience: 4–6 years Reports to: Founder \& CEO

About Yalabs

Yalabs is a Chennai\-based software development studio building products and delivering

projects for US healthtech, Singapore proptech/HR\-tech, and fintech clients. We work across

full\-stack web development, AI/LLM systems, and automation platforms.

About the Role

We're looking for a Team Lead / Delivery Lead to own end\-to\-end delivery of client projects —

from requirement gathering through development to launch. You'll manage a small team of

developers, work directly with clients, and make sure projects ship on time without

compromising quality.

This is a hands\-on leadership role: you'll review code, unblock your team technically, run client

calls, and keep projects organized — not a pure management role, and not a pure IC role.

Responsibilities

Client Management

\- Run client calls and requirement\-gathering workshops

\- Translate client requirements into clear technical specs and user stories

\- Manage scope, timelines, and expectations; flag risks early

\- Present progress, demos, and deliverables to stakeholders

Team Leadership

\- Lead a team of 2–4 developers across one or more concurrent projects

\- Break down requirements into epics, tasks, and sprints

\- Review code and pull requests for quality, architecture fit, and best practices Unblock developers on technical decisions and mentor junior team members

\- Run standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives

Delivery \& Process

\- Own the project board (Trello/Jira) — tasks, priorities, blockers

\- Track progress against timeline and communicate slippage early

\- Coordinate QA, UAT, and go\-live

\- Maintain documentation: specs, architecture notes, handover docs

Cross\-Functional Collaboration

\- Work closely with design, QA, and other developers across projects

\- Coordinate with founder/leadership on architecture decisions and resourcing

\- Collaborate with other Yalabs teams when projects overlap

What We're Looking For

Must\-Have

\- 4–6 years of experience in software development, with demonstrated project/delivery

ownership

\- Strong hands\-on technical background (full\-stack web development — React, Node.js,

or similar)

\- Experience managing or mentoring a small team of developers

\- Comfortable leading client calls and communicating technical concepts to non\-technical

stakeholders

\- Ability to write clear requirements and technical specs

\- Strong ownership mentality — you don't wait to be told what to do next

Good to Have

\- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Microsoft 365/Graph API)

\- Exposure to AI/LLM integrations

\- Experience with agile/scrum delivery

\- Prior client\-facing consulting or agency experience What Success Looks Like

\- Projects ship on time with minimal firefighting

\- Clients trust you and communication stays smooth

\- Your team grows technically under your mentorship

\- Leadership doesn't need to get involved in day\-to\-day execution

Growth Path

This role has a clear path to Engineering Manager / Head of Delivery as Yalabs scales. Strong

developers who show leadership and client\-facing ability are encouraged to apply and grow into this role over time.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

07d5d33a.title: Data Delivery Manager
07d5d33a.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for a **Data Delivery Manager** to oversee the successful execution of intricate data migration, platform, and management projects.


You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams and clients to guarantee high\-quality, future\-ready architectures and smooth project delivery. Join our team to create meaningful data delivery results and grow your career.

**Responsibilities**

* Take full ownership of delivery on assigned accounts
* Ensure governance of delivery and production processes according to the selected delivery model
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all delivery\-related matters, including escalations and resource ramp\-downs
* Handle resource allocation to guarantee appropriate skills and seniority levels
* Deliver technical leadership to guarantee robust and future\-ready data solution architecture
* Facilitate coordination across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
* Build and maintain long\-term client partnerships
* Proactively resolve client issues and manage engagement risks
* Oversee the preparation of customer proposals and statements of work
* Guarantee project compliance with EPAM processes and agile delivery methodologies
* Ensure execution of client responsibilities across engagements
* Develop delivery plans with precise timeframe and resource estimations
* Implement ongoing delivery risk management strategies
* Track and enhance delivery productivity
* Contribute technical and management expertise to sales activities and bid processes

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline
* Solid background in Data Delivery Management spanning 14 to 20 years
* Proven experience leading complex data migration and data management solution delivery
* Skilled in Data Architecture and Data Solution Architecture
* Hands\-on experience with Big Data, ETL/ELT Solutions, Databricks, and Data Mesh
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud Platform
* Solid project management expertise grounded in industry best practices
* Capability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and disciplines
* Outstanding communication and client\-facing abilities
* Strong leadership and mentoring skills
* Background in agile delivery models
* Capacity to manage delivery risks and escalate issues when needed
* Sharp analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* English proficiency at C1 (Advanced) level

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

They are in charge of a variety of tasks, such as leading delivery teams, , rectifying reliability issues, monitoring progress, tracking CPI, KPIs,. A service delivery Lead is a vital role in boosting the Client experience by ensuring the smooth delivery of top\-notch services that meet and exceed customer demands.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Job Description
   

  

* Strong Domain / Technical Knowledge: Hands\-on ETE experience to manage PTP, MDM and SCM clients in Managed service model
* Maintaining high performance levels for service\-related processes, and implementing improvement activities wherever necessary
* Taking ownership of critical incidents, coordinating with resolution parties, and establishing effective communication between stakeholders for post\-incident reviews
* Ensuring that systems, procedures, and methodologies are in place to support outstanding service delivery
* Developing a deep understanding of projects to gain insights into the scope of service delivery
* Taking accountability for service delivery performance, meeting customer expectations, and driving future demand
* Analyzing third\-party as well as internal processes, and creating strategies for service delivery optimization Roles and Responsibilities:
* Performance and Quality Management
* Recommending methods of improvement and seeing that actions are implemented on time for service delivery upgrades
* Providing accurate and regular reports to the management on performance of the service delivery
* Leading personnel management, including staff recruitment, performance assessment, training, and mentoring
* Building strong relationships with teams and stakeholders to enable effective dialogue exchange between departments Technical Perception
* Great understanding of Finance and Accounts business ( PTP Preferable)
* Collaborating with technical design teams to set standards for software, hardware, and security
* Enabling high\-level performance benchmarks for process after screening PMM, Celonis and available data POV’s
* Providing functional SME support to the team to manage client / teams effectively 1\. Client Relationship Management: Service Delivery Leads need strong interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain relationships with clients. They should be able to understand client requirements, manage expectations, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the service delivery process. 2\. Leadership: They should possess leadership qualities to guide and motivate their team members. This includes the ability to delegate tasks, provide clear directions, and inspire collaboration and teamwork. 3\. Project Management: Service Delivery Lead often oversee multiple projects or initiatives. 4\. Problem\-Solving: Service Delivery Lead should be adept at analyzing complex situations, identifying problems, and proposing effective solutions. They should have the ability to think critically and make decisions quickly to address service\-related challenges. 5\. Financial Management: They should have knowledge of budgeting, cost management, and financial planning to ensure that service delivery stays within budget and aligns with financial goals. 6\. Continuous Improvement: Service Delivery Leads should have a mindset of continuous improvement. They should proactively identify areas for improvement, implement process enhancements, and drive efficiency in service delivery.

e3bb538b.title: Sr Program Manager, ASIN Localization
e3bb538b.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon.com  

  

Amazon.com – a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. We are making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.  

  

The Team: We at Localization are an integral part of creating new listings and enabling customers to shop in a language of preference globally. Our vision is to enable customers in every Store to have access to all of Amazon's WW selection and in a language of their choice. Every year, we help in launching new marketplaces and localize billions of products for Amazon worldwide. The site at Hyderabad manages multiple critical programs for WW Localization team.  

  

The Role: We are looking for an exceptional Program Manager to join Hyd team and drive Operational Excellence in non\-tech domain of project/program management. Operational Excellence is not a set of activities but a philosophy and a mind\-set anchored on problem\-solving and leadership, in order to create sustainable continuous improvement. We expect this leader to enhance both the value of services as well as its delivery to our customers, by deploying (but not restricted to) new processes and implementing consistent small improvements that compound over time to produce big results. We are looking for high\-potential, flexible, innovative, and forward\-thinking professional to join the team. Are you ready to drive high\-visibility and strategic programs as well as lead process improvement initiatives? Are you equally comfortable digging into business requirements as you are driving operational efficiencies? If yes, then come join us!
  

  

What do we expect you to do? This position will be responsible for driving multiple critical programs for WW ASIN Localization, ensuring successful delivery of business goals. You will structure programs to launch new processes, identify defects across existing portfolios and rectify them. The work entails managing multiple portfolios simultaneously and entails coordination with multiple internal teams of Amazon. This is a unique role that offers a great opportunity to build something new, work cross functionally across strategic businesses, and interact with global stakeholders. You will need to balance between big picture thinking and obsessing with the details, identifying risks. The ideal candidate should have exceptional written and verbal skills, and be comfortable presenting to senior leadership and drive alignment amongst stakeholders.  

  

Ideal candidate is expected to:  

* Work with internal teams (Engineering/Product Management etc) to identify opportunities and set up new processes from scratch which can reduce operational load on partner teams.
* Work with product management/Engineering teams to understand program requirements and jointly develop a solution to drive automation as well as deliver on the yearly goals.
* Manage stakeholder (Business/Tech) and collaborate with them effectively to deliver on joint goals
* Identify defects, deep dive root causes and work out short\-term and long\-term solutions. Use industry proven tools such as lean/six sigma to drive operational efficiencies and quality improvement in the operations team under your purview.
* Develop team goals and metrics that allow for accurate measurement and traction towards solving a business problem, achieve buy\-in from stakeholders and actively report progress on the goals.
* Thrive and operate in a variable \& grey environment by addressing situations of low workload forecast, varying customer priorities, changing mix of workload which will impact productivity bar and cross\-skilling of resources for most optimum throughput management.

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Sr Program Manager must serve as a single\-threaded leader capable of managing complex, cross\-functional escalations across multiple stakeholders including RBS, Softlines, and seller teams, transforming fragmented ownership into end\-to\-end resolution. The role requires strategic vision to shift teams from reactive problem\-solving to proactive quality assurance, establishing centralized project plans anchored by measurable P0 metrics across discoverability, variations, returns and detail page defects. This leader must demonstrate excellent SQL skills for making data\-driven decisions, translating business impact into actionable roadmaps with clear success criteria. The position demands stakeholder management excellence, coordinating between technical teams (BIE, Tech, Product) and business partners while establishing standardized SLAs and escalation protocols. Critical capabilities include organizational design, restructuring teams through cross\-training programs and resource optimization without additional headcount, plus technical acumen to understand catalog architectural enhancements and system behaviors. The PM must excel at building mechanisms, creating scalable frameworks for defect identification and reduction, and AI\-powered feedback loops that scale quality improvements. Finally, this role requires leadership influence to secure executive alignment, drive implementation timelines, and foster a culture of continuous improvement that impacts Amazon's worldwide catalog quality.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8da1e307.title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud Storage
8da1e307.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, specifically designing, constructing, or managing projects.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in software focused program/project management and in the business technology market.
* Knowledge of distributed software applications and the ability to quickly grasp new technical concepts.
* Ability to establish credibility and rapport with technical and non\-technical team members alike.
* Proven successful technical program management outcomes from idea to launching programs, throughout your career.
* Customer\-focused, intent on helping the team build an execution process that delivers incremental value on a frequent basis.
* Comfortable building relationships across functions, product areas, and organizational boundaries.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Set the vision and direction for a program by outlining goals and objectives, evaluating and running multiple projects, organizing cross\-project work within the program, and defining program controls/governance/standards.
* Drive consistency between Cloud processes and central processes. Bring visibility and strengthen communication across the teams.
* Enable execution across multiple teams and drive delivery across the complete portfolio of Cloud products and solutions.
* Engage with engineering directors, product leaders and other Technical Program Manager (TPM) groups, to streamline processes, simplify execution, manage OKRs, release on time, bring tooling for efficiencies and help the teams you are engaged with in execution.
* Contribute to various initiatives in Cloud Storage, Data Cloud, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) technical program manager community.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

18173357.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Pay, Recurring Payments
18173357.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management.
* Experience working on consumer\-facing mobile applications and high\-frequency transactional/utility products in the FinTech, Payments, or Commerce industry.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in applying modern AI/ML tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agent\-based automation to advance technical program management practices (e.g., autonomous dependency tracking, predictive risk analysis, and process optimization).
* Experience collaborating effectively with distributed Engineering, Product Management, Partnerships, UX, Legal, Compliance, and Finance teams.
* Understanding of the India digital payments and utility ecosystem, including UPI, Bharat Connect, regulatory landscape (RBI, NPCI), and key market players.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Google Pay India is at the forefront of India's digital payments revolution. We build and scale a leading platform used by hundreds of millions of consumers and millions of merchants for a wide range of transactions, from peer\-to\-peer transfers and bill payments to in\-store and online purchases. Beyond payments, we are expanding access to financial services, striving to make money management and financial products more accessible to all Indians. Joining our team means shaping the future of finance in one of the world's most dynamic digital economies.
   

  

 Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and own the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple complex, cross\-functional technical programs critical to Google Pay India's strategic goals, such as everyday utility payments (Billpay, Recharge, Transit), new feature launches, platform modernization, and partner ecosystem integrations.
* Define program scope, objectives, and key results (OKRs), translating ambiguous problems into clear plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive program execution, proactively identify and mitigate risks, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advocate the integration of agent\-based AI tools and autonomous workflows into technical program management practices, proactively automating routine operations and enhancing predictive risk mitigation.
* Exercise strong technical judgment to understand engineering challenges, contribute to design discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and guide technical decisions.
