0c4856a5.title: Principal Program Manager, Ship With Amazon
0c4856a5.description:
**Description**
 Amazon, a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, Washington, is the global leader in e\-commerce. Since Amazon started in 1995, we have significantly expanded our product offerings, international sites, and worldwide network of fulfillment and customer service centers.
   

  

 It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Program Manager to join our growing team in Amazon Shipping (SWA) organization! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make SWA experience for our shippers seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by product innovation, technology led business excellence, passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional experience. You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment.
   

  

 You have a track record of exceptional performance and love working in a dynamic, ambiguous, fast\-paced environment in which managing multiple projects and priorities is the norm. You have expertise in managing programs that span multiple VP organizations, operating independently in highly ambiguous environments where both the problem and the solution are undefined. You are a strategic thinker who connects technical improvements to business outcomes.
   

  

 You dive deep and like the complexity of systems but drive simple, innovative solutions for customer\-facing experiences. You have excellent judgment and high standards. You are an articulate, persuasive communicator and a good writer. People trust and respect you and they like to work with you. You are eager to pioneer new experiences, putting the customer first and challenging conventional wisdom.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are seeking an innovative, intellectually curious, results\-oriented Principal Program Manager to drive broad cross\-organizational, cross\-regional, critical programs and charter level portfolios in our organization. The Principal PM will operate with complete autonomy and will be in charge of handling all aspects of technical projects within the SWA organization such as Shipper support, Billing \& Payment, Claims and Delivery experience domains.
   

  

 As a Principal Program Manager, you will
   

  

* Own and drive complex programs and portfolio, stakeholder relationship, program governance, and end\-to\-end program lifecycle.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, evaluate options and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role. You should also have the ability to coach, and mentor individuals; build a strong cross\-functional organization. Be a champion of operational excellence and establish team metrics for that excellence; including a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvement. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to senior leadership. Raise the bar on program management excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.
* Collaborate and influence team members, product, engineering leaders and work with development teams and other business groups, and presenting projects to senior leadership on a regular basis. This includes building relationships and identifying with stakeholders across the organization.
* Compile, manage, and report on project and portfolio level metrics, post launch adoption, and be responsible for leading many high profile meetings to align on project requirements
* This position requires the ability to operate in ambiguous situations and think outside the box when our customers’ problems may not always have clear solutions. It also requires backbone to lead upward as it will drive program adoption with senior leadership and customers while demonstrating empathy in responding to evolving customer needs.
* Build consensus across VP organizations through effective narratives and presentations, representing complex operational and technical trade\-offs clearly
* Manage executive\-level escalations with excellent judgment, balancing operational constraints with business priorities
* Establish and own success metrics that connect operational and technical improvements to business outcomes
* Create mechanisms for continuous visibility and proactive risk identification and represent team in Monthly, Quarterly business reviews to translate operational metrics into business impact for executive audiences
* Quantify the business impact of product features, technical improvements and communicate ROI to leadership
* Team Development \& Community Building, Drive knowledge sharing, build knowledge artifacts
* Amplify impact by creating and optimizing critical mechanisms that enable teams to deliver independently
* Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and knowledge sharing
* Raise the bar for program management excellence across Amazon Shipping
* Streamline processes and drive adoption of best practices across multiple organizations
* Use Generative AI for data analysis, generating insights on technical and business metrics, risks, dependencies and program status management


**You'll Collaborate Closely With**
* Product Management teams defining capabilities and roadmaps, status
* Commercial teams driving enterprise shipper adoption and delivery SLAs
* Engineering organizations building support, claims, billing/payments and delivery tracking platforms
* Operations teams supporting global shipping networks
* Principal Engineers and Architects on technical decisions
* VP\-level leadership across multiple organizations


 The right candidate will possess a strong product/program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading large programs for software product development, and will have a good technology exposure. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. 21dabd75.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
 Senior Principal Program Manager \- Interface Controllers
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager who will be responsible for the overall coordination of R\&D Development Projects and Key Customer Engagements within the Design IP Group. The candidate must have solid, hands\-on experience with PCIe, UCIe and/or Ethernet controllers and implementation in SoC with a history in successfully leading or managing designs with end customers. We are looking for an individual with an entrepreneurial mindset with strong leadership skills and “assume ownership” to ensure flawless execution. Someone who is passionate, and enjoys and thrives on coordinating all the facets of the design project in a matrix organizational structure to deliver successful results. Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate with R\&D and marketing in defining the scope, and ability to collaborate with teams with clear communication skills, are the must\-have attributes in this role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Program Manager you are responsible for driving the various internal teams to deliver Controller IP based products and services. You must be knowledgeable and proficient with Ethernet and PCIe standards, MAC and protocols. Additionally, proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification to understand Interoperability and Compliance test suites. This position is responsible for creating and executing project plan, proactively mitigating risks, and managing the Project life cycle from inception to project delivery and post\-production support. You will also be responsible for managing external stakeholders as customer facing Program Manager.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with internal \& external customers, stakeholders to define project objectives and requirements.
* Prioritize requirements and define scope to meet customer needs in a timely manner given available resources.
* Develop, maintain, and distribute (as appropriate) standard project management deliverables for the successful implementation of the project, including: implementation plan, project schedule, project budget and variances, issues \& action items log, meeting minutes, risks assessment and contingencies.
* Manage deliverables (including SOWs, change management, approval of deliverables).
* Partner with internal and external development teams to deliver on time and with the quality required.
* Serve as the project owner in development process; maintaining quality checklists, Jira tickets, schedule tracker etc.
* Manage each release through the quality checker process.
* Partner with various teams to identify areas in need of improvement to increase customer satisfaction and decrease support requests.
* Anticipate problems and complications and formulate solutions so as not to impede the progress of the project.
* Assume responsibility and drive ownership for issue resolution.
* Holding status update meetings with technical teams and updating higher management on the project progress.
* Create and maintain scorecards to track project performance.
* Accountable for on time project delivery, product quality, cost, and operations.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution.
* 15\+ years of experience out of which at least 2\+ years of Program Management or Technical Product Management experience in a technology\-oriented organization.
* Physical Layer and Protocol layer experience on AT LEAST ONE High speed SERDES on Ethernet/PCIe/CXL/UCIe
* Experience in PCIe/UCIe LTSSM states / UCIe Interfaces / Ethernet standards
* Proficient with Ethernet, PCIe, UCIe standards and Protocols. Proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification reg. Protocol, Interoperability and Compliance test suites
* Strong project management skills with the ability to work on and track multiple projects simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically when executing the project and solving problems.
* Familiar with mixed\-signal IP design flow and methodologies, Verilog/RTL coding \& Verification


 Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical individuals.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

805d6097.title: SRE Program Manager
805d6097.description:
Program Manager – Site Reliability Engineering (Cloud Native Platform Team)
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Program Manager will drive day\-to\-day operations of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, ensuring alignment with organizational goals for reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. This role requires a strong technical background in SRE practices and proven program management expertise to drive cross\-functional initiatives, optimize processes, and deliver measurable business and operations value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Operational Leadership
* Drive adoption of SRE best practices such as error budgets, SLIs/SLOs, and automation to reduce toil.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory standards in all reliability initiatives.
* Program Management
* Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria for reliability initiatives.
* Develop and maintain quarterly roadmaps for SRE projects in collaboration with platform engineering teams.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies across multiple projects using tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Facilitate communication between SRE, development, and leadership teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
* Performance Measurement
* Establish and monitor KPIs for reliability and operational efficiency.
* Prepare executive dashboards and reports to translate technical metrics into business impact narratives.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives based on data\-driven insights.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the primary liaison between SRE and other teams (Product, Engineering and Delivery\-SOC).
* Influence decision\-making at all levels through clear communication and structured reporting.


 Performance Measurement Parameters
   

  

 Incident Metrics:
   

  

* Mean Time to Detect (MTTD)
* Mean Time to Respond (MTTR)
* Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
* Incident Frequency and Severity


 Change Management:
   

  

* Change Failure Rate
* Change Success Rate


 Reliability Metrics:
   

  

* System Uptime / Availability
* Service Level Objective Achievement Percentage


 Operational Efficiency:
   

  

* Automation Rate
* On\-call Burden Reduction


 Measurement Matrix for Leadership Presentation
   

  

 Use a dashboard approach combining:
   

  

 Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation.
   

  

 Monthly/Quarterly trends on SLO
   

  

 Incident Heatmaps: Highlighting root causes and resolution times.
   

  

 Business Impact Metrics: Cost savings, risk reduction, and ROI from reliability improvements.
   

  

 Tools: Datadog
   

  

**Experience Requirements**
 Technical Background:
   

  

* Prior hands\-on experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in DevOps roles.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures (Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems).


 Program Management Expertise:
   

  

* 5\+ years in program or technical project management.
* Proven ability to manage cross\-functional initiatives in fast\-paced environments.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (JIRA, Confluence).


 Leadership \& Communication:
   

  

* Experience presenting technical and operational metrics to executive leadership.
* Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.


 Certifications: PMP, SAFe, or SRE Foundation – SAFe preferred

You will guide revenue for one of our products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a hands\-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.

66c1f51e.title: Digital Solutions Pre-Sales / Solution Architect
66c1f51e.description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 Highbrow Technology Inc is looking for a Digital Solutions Pre\-Sales / Solution Architect who can work closely with customers, Sales, Engineering, and Delivery teams to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into practical digital solutions.
 



 The role will primarily support opportunities across AI/ML, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Edge AI, Data \& Analytics, IoT, Cloud, Smart Infrastructure, and other digital transformation initiatives.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong customer\-facing capabilities, good technical understanding, and experience conducting requirement discovery, solution architecture, POCs, demonstrations, and technical proposal development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 · Participate in customer discovery meetings and understand business, operational, and technical requirements.
 



 · Work with Sales teams during initial customer discussions and opportunity qualification.
 



 · Visit customer locations when required to understand site conditions, existing infrastructure, workflows, devices, applications, and integration requirements.
 



 · Identify suitable digital solution use cases based on customer business challenges.
 



 · Translate customer requirements into solution architecture, functional requirements, and technical scope.
 



 · Work with internal Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams to validate technical feasibility.
 



 · Develop high\-level and detailed solution architecture.
 



 · Prepare technical presentations, solution proposals, architecture diagrams, BOMs, scope documents, and SOW inputs.
 



 · Support customer demonstrations, technical workshops, and solution walkthroughs.
 



 · Support POCs and pilot engagements from initial requirement definition through customer evaluation.
 



 · Support responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs from the technical and solution perspective.
 



 · Identify integration requirements across applications, APIs, cloud platforms, databases, cameras, sensors, IoT devices, and enterprise systems.
 



 · Evaluate technical risks, dependencies, and assumptions before commercial commitments are made.
 



 · Coordinate with Sales and Engineering teams during solution estimation and proposal preparation.
 



 · Act as the technical interface between Customer, Sales, Engineering, and Delivery teams.
 



 · Ensure structured technical handover once an opportunity moves into implementation.
 



  





**Technology Exposure** 




 The candidate should have good exposure to several of the following areas:
 



 · Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
 



 · Generative AI / LLMs
 



 · RAG solutions
 



 · Agentic AI
 



 · Computer Vision
 



 · Video Analytics
 



 · Edge AI
 



 · Predictive Analytics
 



 · Data \& Analytics
 



 · IoT
 



 · Cloud platforms
 



 · APIs and enterprise integrations
 



 · Intelligent Automation
 



 · NLP / Conversational AI
 



  





**Preferred Domain Exposure** 




  





 Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage:
 



 · Smart City / Smart Infrastructure
 



 · Video Surveillance / VMS
 



 · AI\-enabled Video Analytics
 



 · Edge AI platforms
 



 · Transportation
 



 · Retail
 



 · Healthcare
 



 · Manufacturing / Industry 4\.0
 



 · Public Sector
 



 · Critical Infrastructure
 



 · Enterprise Digital Transformation
 



  





**Customer\-Facing Skills** 




  





 The candidate should be comfortable:
 



 · Leading customer discovery discussions.
 



 · Asking detailed functional and technical questions.
 



 · Interacting with business, IT, Engineering, Operations, and leadership stakeholders.
 



 · Conducting onsite requirement assessments.
 



 · Understanding customer infrastructure and operational environments.
 



 · Presenting solution concepts and architecture.
 



 · Explaining complex technical concepts in business language.
 



 · Managing expectations around solution feasibility, dependencies, and limitations.
 



 · Coordinating across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
 



  





**Experience Required** 




 · 5\-8 years of overall technology experience.
 



 · Minimum 3\+ years in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Solution Architecture, or customer\-facing technical roles.
 



 · Experience supporting Digital Solutions, AI/ML, analytics, automation, IoT, cloud, or enterprise software opportunities.
 



 · Experience preparing technical proposals, architecture diagrams, presentations, and solution documents.
 



 · Experience supporting POCs, pilots, demonstrations, and enterprise customer engagements.
 



 · Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Background** 




  





 Candidates from companies working in areas such as:
 



 · Enterprise AI
 



 · AI/ML Solutions
 



 · Generative AI
 



 · Computer Vision
 



 · Edge AI
 



 · IoT
 



 · Smart City solutions
 



 · Video Analytics
 



 · Digital Engineering
 



 · Cloud and Data solutions
 



  





**Preferred Technical Exposure** 




  





 Exposure to some of the following would be beneficial:
 



 Python \| OpenCV \| TensorFlow \| PyTorch \| LLMs \| RAG \| Vector Databases \| APIs \| Docker \| Kubernetes \| AWS \| Azure \| GCP \| NVIDIA Jetson \| Computer Vision \| GenAI \| MLOps
 



 The candidate is not expected to be a full\-time developer, but should have sufficient technical understanding to engage customers effectively and work with Engineering teams to develop the right solution.
 



  





**Expected Opportunity Lifecycle** 




  





 Customer Discussion \-\> Requirement Discovery \-\> Site Assessment \-\> Use Case Identification \-\> Solution Architecture \-\> Technical Validation \-\> POC / Demo \-\> Proposal \-\> Customer Presentation \-\> Delivery Handover
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 · Technically strong and customer\-oriented.
 



 · Comfortable working directly with enterprise customers.
 



 · Willing to travel to customer sites for requirement discovery.
 



 · Strong in solution thinking and architecture.
 



 · Able to convert loosely defined customer problems into structured technical requirements.
 



 · Comfortable challenging requirements when technically necessary.
 



 · Strong in documentation and presentations.
 



 · Able to work effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams.
 



 · Capable of supporting multiple solution opportunities simultaneously.

You will develop and present innovative technical solutions to meet their needs, tailoring them to the specific situation and ensuring they align with IBM's sales strategy.

* Complex Solution Creation: Experience in creating complex, multi\-year solutions that optimize costs and meet client requirements, considering profitability.
* Cybersecurity Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering successful cybersecurity solutions, taking into account client requirements and stakeholder expectations.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with cross\-geography, cross\-line of business teams to develop and deliver solutions that meet client needs.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Solution Consultant: Cybersecurity, you will engage with clients and stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, business and technical requirements, and issues. You will develop and present innovative technical solutions to meet their needs, tailoring them to the specific situation and ensuring they align with IBM's sales strategy.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop Client Solutions: Collaborate with clients to understand their business and technical requirements, and develop tailored technical solutions to meet their needs, aligning with IBM's sales strategy.
* Present Innovative Solutions: Present developed solutions to clients, ensuring they meet their specific situation and requirements, while considering IBM's profitability.
* Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams: Work with cross\-geography, cross\-line of business teams to create complex, multi\-year solutions that optimize costs and meet clients' requirements.
* Deliver Successful Bids: Utilize strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills to deliver successful cybersecurity bids, working closely with various stakeholders.
* Optimize Solution Costs: Ensure developed solutions optimize costs for clients while meeting their requirements and considering IBM's profitability.


**Preferred Education**
 Bachelor's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Technical Solution Development: Experience with developing and presenting innovative technical solutions to meet client needs, tailoring them to specific situations and aligning with sales strategies.
* Complex Solution Creation: Experience in creating complex, multi\-year solutions that optimize costs and meet client requirements, considering profitability.
* Cybersecurity Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering successful cybersecurity solutions, taking into account client requirements and stakeholder expectations.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with cross\-geography, cross\-line of business teams to develop and deliver solutions that meet client needs.
* Cost Optimization: Experience in optimizing solution costs for clients while meeting their requirements and considering profitability.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cybersecurity Solution Expertise: Experience with designing and delivering successful cybersecurity solutions, taking into account client requirements and stakeholder expectations, is beneficial. This includes understanding security threats, vulnerabilities, and risk management.
* Complex IT Solution Knowledge: Familiarity with creating complex, multi\-year IT solutions that optimize costs and meet client requirements is advantageous. This involves understanding IT infrastructure, systems integration, and technology trends.
* Cross\-Industry Knowledge: Exposure to multiple industries, including their unique challenges and requirements, can be helpful in developing tailored technical solutions that meet client needs.

**Overview**
 our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.

* Ability to build demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and customer solution architectures.

* Ability to translate business requirements into AI\-powered solutions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
* Experience leading technical demonstrations and workshops.

* Experience with AI, machine learning, prompt engineering, or conversational agents.
* Knowledge of enterprise productivity, business process automation, and digital transformation.

b4df0176.title: Sr. Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
b4df0176.description:
**Join Us as Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer!**
ORBCOMM is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure that powers our global business and customer\-facing platforms. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing cloud modernization, automation, platform reliability, and operational excellence across our multi\-cloud environments. **Why You’ll Love Working Here**
As a member of our Information Technology \& Security team, you will partner closely with application, database, security, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud\-native solutions that support enterprise operations and customer experiences. Based in Hyderabad, India, you will contribute to the evolution of ORBCOMM’s cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping drive scalability, resiliency, and innovation across the organization.  

This position is based in our Hyderabad office and will be working an onsite work schedule. **What You’ll Do****Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering*** Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments.
* Develop scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant infrastructure solutions.
* Support enterprise and customer\-facing applications with a focus on security, performance, and reliability.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver cloud\-native infrastructure and platform services.
* Lead cloud modernization initiatives and infrastructure migration projects.

**Scalability \& Performance Optimization*** Design infrastructure capable of supporting business growth and increasing workload demands.
* Perform capacity planning and develop long\-term infrastructure scaling strategies.
* Implement load balancing, auto\-scaling, high\-availability, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Conduct performance analysis across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Proactively identify and address infrastructure bottlenecks before they impact production systems.

**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code*** Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and related automation tools.
* Automate provisioning, deployment, patching, and configuration management processes.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve CI/CD pipeline efficiency and deployment reliability.
* Establish standardized, repeatable cloud infrastructure deployment patterns and best practices.

**Reliability, Monitoring \& Operations*** Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions across cloud platforms.
* Support incident response, service restoration, and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive continuous improvements in infrastructure resiliency, recoverability, and operational maturity.
* Participate in on\-call support and escalation processes as required.

**Security \& Compliance*** Apply cloud security best practices across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments.
* Implement identity and access management controls, network security measures, and vulnerability remediation processes.
* Support compliance initiatives, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other applicable frameworks.
* Partner with security teams to ensure infrastructure aligns with organizational security standards.

 **Who You Are**
You are an experienced cloud infrastructure professional who thrives in complex, high\-growth environments. You bring deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and infrastructure engineering, along with a passion for building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that support business\-critical workloads.
If you have:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or cloud engineering roles.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Experience implementing and supporting large\-scale, highly available, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
* Proven success designing systems that support business growth, high transaction volumes, or global user bases.
* Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, load balancing, routing, and firewalls.
* Experience administering both Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with monitoring, observability, and operational monitoring platforms.


Preferred:* Experience working in multi\-cloud environments utilizing two or more of the following: Azure, AWS, and OCI.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or other containerized technologies.
* Azure and/or AWS cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms and distributed applications.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
* Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

**Then we want to** **meet** **you!** **The Benefits of Working Here**  

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally. **How We Hire**
ORBCOMM uses technology\-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human\-led, tech\-enabled culture. **About Us**
At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data\-driven decisions. Our industry\-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com! **Ready to Join Us?**
We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth\-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.  

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.  

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

bec0fcdf.title: Senior Technical Application Engineer, Power Conversion Solutions
bec0fcdf.description:
Join our global Technical Sales Support team at Hitachi Energy’s Power Conversion Solutions as a Technical Application Engineer for Asia Pacific, where you will work with customers and sales colleagues to ensure superior technical support. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on our business growth at the heart of our global PCS sales team.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
 As key member of the Global Technical Sales Support team, you will:
   

  

* Serve as technical advisor to our key customers and channel partners (Mainly system integrators, developers, IPP’s \& EPC’s.)
* During early stage of the sales process, lead technical presentations and direct customer dialogue to highlight the value proposition of PCS Converters, MV\-stations \& Automation/Digital.
* Support sales \& tender colleagues with technical solutions during sales and tender process.
* Support Sales in every step of the PCS partner program to enable new leads to become new channel partners.
* Work with our key customers and channel partners to ensure PCS converter technology is included and kept in AVL’s, including focus with Battery OEM’s in collaboration with PCS product Management \& business development.
* Bring Techno/Commercial inputs to Business Development and Product Management for future needs.
* Attend the various professional fairs/conferences in your region and be the technical ambassador of our PCS technology.
* Support the deployment of technical tools, in close collaboration with PCS product management \& R\&D, which are necessary to our channel partners in order to secure superior technical collaboration and win customers trust with PCS converter technology.
* Support winning bids by early influencing our customers on key features and help sales with value propositions.
* Defines in close alignment with the tendering the solution design and verifies the sizing of the solution.
* Contribute together with the Business Development function to a global partner program including contract templates, training and qualification program for partners and marketing support.


**Who You Are**
 We are seeking an energized and passionate Senior Technical Application Engineer for our Power Conversion Solutions business in Asia Pacific – APAC with location in Chennai, India.
   

  

* Proven experience in technical engineering \& sales support, ideally in the Converter and/or BESS markets
* Ability to maintain high levels of quality, accuracy, and process consistency
* Experience with utility scale power converters for BESS and/or similar technology
* Strong communication skills to align with Process Owners and manage technical sales
* Proven leadership skills


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent work experience. Concentration in Electrical Power / Energy Systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of power system principles and operations at the utility and industrial levels is required.
* Background in Battery Energy Storage Solutions and/or Renewables converter engineering.

d0b592bc.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Azure Data Architect - Manager
d0b592bc.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS** 
 –
 **Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Manager – Azure Data Architect \- G\&I**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Must have worked on Government Infrastructure Sector Projects
* Experience in Presales, RFP, GTM
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Marketing Operations \- Operations Management

 Delivery Lead Manager

 Any Graduation

 13 to 18 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 The Operations Service Delivery Lead is the professional responsible for coordinating the delivery of services to key enterprise customers and includes developing and executing activities related to end\-to\-end project management, as well as monitoring, managing and reporting on execution of deliverables. Extensive experience in a multinational environment managing and working within Business Excellence frameworks or with service delivery is required General Duties and Responsibilities Assists or leads in developing supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations. Awareness of CX products Understand and implement tools which would lead to efficiency gains Manage recruiting, staffing, pyramid mix, utilization and capacity of staff to optimize balance between cost and delivery targets. Resolve performance issues with delivery leadership. Responsible for improving delivery and both supporting and assisting in the creation of strategic initiatives for clients partnering with the different teams within Accenture. Formalize delivery plans for the service delivery operations(s) with service group delivery leadership. Ensure execution of delivery work across one or more service delivery operations. Deliver efficiencies through standard processes and synergies. Manage supply and demand, service quality and processes to meet delivery expectations, always looking for methods of improvement. Proactively improve client and customer relationships through extensive contact, while working with Client Account and Account Delivery Team leadership. Deliver agreed scope of services while achieving profitability improvements and productive gains. Manage and reduce costs on standard offerings, assets, technologies, licenses and facilities. Implement standard service level agreement (SLA) and other financial/operational metrics. Support the achievement of targets on contract controllable income (CCI) and cost\-to\-serve. Support estimate at completion (EAC) adjustments (if required).
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Achieve year on year efficiencies in conjunction with the delivery service providers. Designs and drives Program/Capability ownership, Stakeholder management and collaboration. Ensuring customer satisfaction by acting as the escalation point for any problems or concerns from project and delivery managers, as well as clients
   

  

* Responsible for all services including incident and change management. Drive optimization of delivery of standard solutions within area(s) of expertise. Address performance issues across the service delivery operations, create operational approach and implement continuous improvement. Implement the levers to consistently achieve performance targets such as Six Sigma, operational excellence, etc. Participate in account quality review process and engage appropriately in the Accenture Quality Assurance program. Review and validate the standard solutions/models for new deals, and take responsibility for their successful execution/completion. Tracking duties and deliverables from several project managers and their respective projects. Responsible for career management of service delivery operations staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning and annual performance process). Lead service delivery strategy and execution. Act as subject matter expert supporting teams and applying deep expertise and knowledge.
* Must have Skills Fluent in oral and written English skills (will have direct contact with clients). Proven leadership skills. Ability to motivate others to achieve goals and deadlines. Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer s needs and goals with company s strategies and goals. Skilled at delegating tasks to others. Generation of clear and functional reports for both supervisors and peers (both technical and non\-technical). At least 10 years of experience leading Software Development with emphasis in web / front\-end technology based delivery. Expertise in Digital Content Publishing. Extensive experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore production
* Roles and Responsibilities:
* In this role you are required to identify and assess complex problems for area of responsibility
* The person would create solutions in situations in which analysis requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors
* Requires adherence to strategic direction set by senior management when establishing near\-term goals
* Interaction of the individual is with senior management at a client and/or within Accenture, involving matters that may require acceptance of an alternate approach
* Some latitude in decision\-making in involved
* you will act independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments
* Decisions individual at this role makes have a major day to day impact on area of responsibility
* The person manages large \- medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts At least 15 years of experience in Client Management and relationship\-building. The ability to lead a complex project/program in which new services/tools are used or created. Recognize issues and opportunities and initiate proper action to solve or take advantage of them. Monitor and devise methods of improvement for overall performance and services. Review and contribute to creation of financial reports and supporting documentation for funders as outlined in funding agreements by projects. Ensure operations teams are aware of expectative and business needs
* Assure successful service delivery \- SLA achievement and high level of customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Sr. management to create strategies for improved client account management as well as growth and other opportunities. Working with the client and operations teams to identify and manage service improvement activities. Good to have Skills Certified in PMP, Agile, Scrum, Six Sigma

5b6592ef.title: Project Delivery Manager Supply Chain
5b6592ef.description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Project Delivery Manager – Supply Chain Applications**
**Your Role**
 Supply Chain transformations shape the backbone of global operations — and in this role, you will be at the center of driving them. As Project Delivery Manager for Supply Chain Applications, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, business\-critical application projects across a global landscape, working closely with Business Product Owners, IT Project Managers, Service Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, vendors, and senior business stakeholders across sectors and regions. You will own the full project lifecycle — from initiation and scope definition through execution, governance, and transition into operations — ensuring delivery is on time, within budget, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards and operational readiness requirements. Acting as the primary delivery lead for strategic initiatives, you will drive execution across internal teams and external partners, manage risk and budget transparency, lead governance activities and executive updates, and contribute to Supply Chain transformation roadmaps. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact across a global application landscape in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You bring substantial professional experience in IT project management, program management, or delivery management, with a proven track record of delivering complex enterprise application projects in global environments.
* Lead and Co\-Lead large\-scale Supply Chain application projects from initiation through hypercare and transition into operations for global applications such as Blue Yonder, Esko, and Tracelink
* You have hands\-on experience with Supply Chain application landscapes and related business processes, including planning, fulfillment, and traceability domains.
* You are skilled in project governance, stakeholder management, budgeting, forecasting, and vendor management, and you communicate effectively across both technical and business audiences.
* You are experienced in both Agile and traditional delivery methodologies, with a solid understanding of application lifecycle management and transition\-to\-support processes.
* You hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience.
* You are business\-fluent in English (written and spoken) and are comfortable with regular regional and international travel as part of the role.
* Experience in the healthcare or life sciences industry is a strong advantage.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

968fd2e1.title: VSSE Delivery Manager
968fd2e1.description:
The Delivery Manager, VSSE\-IT Systems Engineering, is responsible for leading the delivery and operational performance of technology solutions supporting Ford’s vehicle software and systems engineering. The role oversees PLM and Teamcenter capabilities, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, DevOps, application development, and AI/ML\-enabled engineering tools. This role will develop high\-performing teams, establish delivery priorities, manage strategic technology initiatives, and ensure solutions meet organizational standards for security, quality, reliability, scalability, and business value.
   

  

* Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of VSSE\-IT software platforms, modeling ecosystems, and engineering data capabilities.
* Define and execute technology roadmaps supporting systems engineering, digital engineering, product development, traceability, collaboration, and enterprise data integration.
* Provide technical leadership for Siemens Teamcenter customization tools such as VSEM, IVS and PLM integrations, including product structures, bills of materials, requirements management, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* Oversee Teamcenter architecture, customization, administration, upgrades, environment management, troubleshooting, data synchronization, and operational readiness.
* Lead integrations between Teamcenter, MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, MBSE tools, requirements platforms, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Apply integration technologies and configuration tools such as REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable PLM technologies.
* Manage and mentor cross\-functional engineering teams responsible for full\-stack development, cloud platforms, DevOps, quality, cybersecurity, and production operations.
* Guide the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-performance applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript, Angular or React, RESTful APIs, databases, and GCP cloud\-native services.
* Establish and improve DevOps practices, including Kubernetes/OpenShift, containerization, Jenkins or Tekton, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure automation.
* Advance AI/ML\-enabled engineering capabilities through the integration of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, analytics platforms, AI APIs, and intelligent modeling workflows.
* Partner with Siemens Product Development to address core product issues and coordinate the development and delivery of customer\-specific patches and fixes.
* Collaborate with product owners, systems engineers, architects, PLM teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to prioritize delivery, manage risks, and conduct architecture and production\-readiness reviews.
* Promote engineering excellence through Agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, code reviews, quality practices, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Ensure VSSE\-IT solutions meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, data quality, traceability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and user adoption.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, technology delivery, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience with Product Lifecycle Management platforms, including PLM customization, integrations, product structures, bills of materials, requirements, workflows, change management, release processes, and configuration management.
* At least 3 years of experience in people management, engineering management, delivery leadership, or a comparable technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software products and platforms using Agile, Scrum, or other iterative development methodologies.
* Strong technical experience with Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, Python, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Experience designing, deploying, and supporting cloud\-native applications using GCP, OpenShift or Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, Tekton or Jenkins, and Terraform.
* Experience leading PLM integrations with engineering, MBSE, ERP, requirements management, or enterprise data systems using REST, SOA, ITK, BMIDE, Active Workspace, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with data platforms, analytics solutions, AI/ML initiatives, or engineering data integration programs. Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, and TensorFlow is a plus.
* Proven ability to establish technical direction, manage delivery risks, improve engineering processes, and deliver secure, reliable, production\-ready solutions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, decision\-making, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high\-performing teams and partner effectively with engineering, product, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, PLM, and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter, Teamcenter X, 3DEXPERIENCE, or comparable PLM platforms.
* Knowledge of PLM data models, product structures, BOMs, workflows, lifecycle states, change management, and configuration management.
* Experience with PLM integrations, migrations, APIs, customization, and enterprise engineering systems.
* Familiarity with MagicDraw/Cameo Systems Modeler, Teamwork Cloud, SysML, Codebeamer, VIATRA, or similar MBSE tools.
* Knowledge of automotive product development, systems engineering, digital engineering, or regulated environments.
* Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, distributed systems, AI/ML applications, LLMs, and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with GCP, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, CI/CD, containers, observability, and cloud security.
* Experience leading distributed or global engineering teams in a collaborative, inclusive environment.

41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Foundational Data \& Model Services sits in Data \& AI Foundations, inside Business \& Market Insights. We own the data that B\&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
   

  

 About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on\-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load\-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
   

  

 The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
   

  

 Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
   

  

 Run the migration off Hadoop and on\-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
   

  

 Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
   

  

 Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
   

  

 Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
   

  

 Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade\-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
   

  

 Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
   

  

**All About You**
 We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
   

  

 Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
   

  

 Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
   

  

 Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
   

  

 Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
   

  

 Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
   

  

 A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow\-through rather than mandate.
   

  

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Technical Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.


 Technical Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.


 Process \& Communication
   

  

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast\-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands\-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four\-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

cca6a497.title: Technical Program Manager
cca6a497.description:
**Who we are** 




 Graviton Research Capital is a privately funded quantitative trading firm. We trade across a multitude of asset classes and trading venues using a diverse range of concepts, from time series analysis and stochastic models to machine learning and statistical inference. We analyse terabytes of data to identify pricing anomalies and drive innovation in financial markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Program Manager who thrives at the intersection of rigorous engineering and predictable delivery. You will not just "manage tasks" — you will orchestrate the development lifecycle for mission\-critical systems. Your goal is to ensure that our elite engineering teams can focus on high\-performance code while you own the execution strategy, dependency mapping, and release discipline.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Stand\-ups, Retrospectives) tailored for deep\-tech engineering teams.
* Transform high\-level trading requirements into granular, executable backlogs. Own capacity planning and burn\-down metrics to provide high\-visibility delivery timelines.
* Navigate the complex interplay between engineering teams (e.g., Connectivity, Core Infrastructure, Simulation) to prevent bottlenecks.
* Build and maintain advanced Jira dashboards, automated roadmaps, and Confluence documentation that serve as the "single source of truth" for stakeholders.
* Proactively identify technical debt, architectural blockers, or resource gaps that threaten release stability.
* Continuously refine Agile methodologies to suit low\-latency, performance\-sensitive development cycles (where "Definition of Done" includes rigorous performance benchmarking).



  





**Eligibility \& Required Skills** 



* 5\+ years of experience as a TPM, Program Manager, or Scrum Lead in a product\-engineering environment (HFT, FinTech, Networking, or Kernels/Systems).
* A strong grasp of the software development lifecycle for high\-performance systems. While you won't write code, you must understand concepts like build systems, CI/CD, and performance regressions.
* Exposure to low\-latency, trading systems, capital markets, networking, quant research or infra software is preferred
* Expert\-level proficiency in Jira Service Management/Software and Confluence. Ability to use JQL for advanced reporting.
* Exceptional ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear business updates for Engineering Leads and Partners.

Summary:  

  

As an OT Security Consultant, your typical day involves assessing, designing, and enhancing cybersecurity controls for Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and SCADA environments. You will work closely with clients to identify security risks, develop remediation strategies, and implement robust security solutions to protect critical industrial assets. You will leverage your expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, industrial control systems, security assessments, and risk management to deliver secure and resilient OT environments. Your role also includes contributing to the development of new cybersecurity service offerings, supporting business development initiatives, and driving innovation in industrial security practices.

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.  

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.  

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.

Develop cybersecurity strategies, operating models, roadmaps, and security enhancement plans for clients.  

Lead solution engineering activities and oversee project delivery for OT security engagements.  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical security solutions.  

Support the development of new industrial cybersecurity products, services, and offerings to reduce cyber risk in OT environments.  

Perform security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, Network Security, Embedded Security, and Industrial Security domains.  

Architect, recommend, and implement security solutions for industrial control systems, applications, data, assets, and personnel.  

Support presales activities, proposal development, scope definition, and marketing initiatives for OT security services.  

Assist in building internal industrial security capabilities, methodologies, frameworks, and best practices.  

Mentor junior team members and contribute to organizational knowledge sharing initiatives.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

Must To Have Skills: Operational Technology (OT) Security, Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security, SCADA Security, Network Security.  

Good To Have Skills: Web Penetration Testing, Infrastructure Security Testing, Endpoint Security Testing, Application Security Testing, IoT/IIoT Security.  

Minimum 5\-6 years of experience in security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, and Network Security.  

Preferred experience in Web, Infrastructure, IoT/IIoT, Endpoint, and Application Penetration Testing.  

Extensive expertise in cybersecurity with a strong focus on OT and Industrial Control System security.  

Comprehensive understanding of SCADA systems, PLCs, DCS, HMIs, and industrial control devices.  

Strong knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, NERC CIP, and IEC 61511\.  

Experience in performing risk assessments, incident management, and security strategy development within OT environments.  

Proficiency in administering and managing industrial cybersecurity platforms and OT monitoring solutions.  

Strong understanding of software and hardware technologies commonly used in ICS environments, including operating systems, databases, and programming languages.  

Hands\-on experience with industrial cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Nozomi, Dragos, Tenable, Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and industrial firewalls.  

Experience with vulnerability research, threat modeling, security code reviews, reverse engineering, exploitation techniques, and security testing methodologies including fuzzing and penetration testing.  

Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple engagements and stakeholders effectively.
