59f7338b.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect
59f7338b.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\+ years
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 6 to 10 years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 3\+ years of dedicated architecture and implementation experience within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data/Journeys) ecosystem
* **Mandatory Certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Journeys) Functional Consultant Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking an experienced **Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Architect** to design, secure, and optimize our enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) and engagement engine. The ideal candidate will orchestrate multi\-source data ingestion streams, map identity resolution rules, configure calculated metrics, and establish real\-time activation loops to power downstream personalization, customer segmentations, and automated marketing journeys.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Design and govern the global Customer Insights data architecture**, configuring real\-time data ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Dataverse, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and external third\-party transactional networks.
* **Architect complex Identity Resolution rules**, establishing data unification parameters, deduplication logic, match/merge profiles, and unified Customer 360 schemas.
* **Build advanced calculated insights and measures**, utilizing custom SQL\-based metrics, behavioral attributes, and predictive models to score customer lifetime values and churn probabilities.
* **Design high\-impact, omni\-channel customer journeys**, configuring dynamic audience segmentation rules, real\-time trigger events, and personalized content loops across communication channels.
* **Establish secure platform integration blueprints**, constructing data streaming flows connecting Customer Insights with Power BI dashboards, core Dynamics apps (Sales/Service), and external API endpoints.
* **Enforce absolute data privacy and governance guardrails**, managing role\-based access controls (RBAC), multi\-tenant compliance frameworks, and corporate data scrubbing rules (GDPR/CCPA).
* **Audit platform operations and processing latencies**, monitoring ingestion sync health, data refresh cycles, segment processing times, and API limit throttles.

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **6 to 10 years** of enterprise data engineering, CRM consulting, or marketing technology experience, with **3\+ dedicated years** actively designing, building, and maintaining setups explicitly on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (formerly Customer Data Platform) framework.
* **Strong technical mastery** of Microsoft Dataverse, Power Platform structures, Azure data ecosystem tools (Data Lake, Synapse), SQL, advanced segmentation logic, and REST APIs.
* **Deep structural understanding** of big data concepts, semantic data modeling, customer lifecycle matrices, identity resolution strategies, and cloud governance frameworks.
* **Mandatory certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Prior experience implementing **Azure AI/ML studio integrations** to feed custom predictive models directly into Customer Insights profile grids.
* Familiarity with real\-time web/mobile tracking integrations utilizing JavaScript SDKs or enterprise tag management tools.

c8e7abaa.title: Customer Solutions Engineer
c8e7abaa.description:
Customer Solutions Engineer \- Forward Deployment Engineering
 




  






 Company: KAVIA AI
 





 Location: India — Remote
 





 Type: Full\-time
 





 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering
 





 Experience: 4–8 years
 





 Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer\-facing technical ownership
 




  






 About KAVIA AI
 





 KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.
 





 We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.
 





 Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.
 




  






 The Role
 





 This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.
 





 Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.
 





 Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.
 





 This is not a conventional sales\-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.
 




  





 What You’ll Do
 

 Lead Technical Discovery
 
* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data\-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.



 Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations
 
* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.



 Convert Use Cases into Well\-Scoped Pilots
 
* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA\-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.



 Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers
 
* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands\-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.



 Move Customers to Technical Validation
 
* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before\-and\-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow\-on phase.



 Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets
 
* Write concise technical follow\-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one\-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer\-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.



 What We’re Looking For
 

 Required
 
* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployed engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C\+\+.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git\-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on\-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow\-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.



 Strong Plus
 
* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI\-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi\-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer\-controlled cloud, self\-hosted, restricted\-network, or air\-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before\-and\-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision\-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.




 A Note from KAVIA
 





 We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.
 





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer\-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.
 




  




 How to Apply
 

 Please apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following:
 



* Your current location in India and your ability to maintain regular overlap with US business hours.




 Please fill this form:
 
 https://forms.gle/4rYd2zjqhWV6kvbc6

119afe6c.title: Solutions Architect - Azure Delivery
119afe6c.description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
   

  

 With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts.
   

  

 Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The Azure Implementation Engineer is responsible for
 **building, migrating, and onboarding customer environments into Microsoft Azure** 
 as part of structured delivery projects. The role works closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, and Security teams to implement approved designs, execute migration waves, and prepare environments for steady\-state operations.
   

  

 The position requires
 **hands\-on Azure deployment skills** 
 and
 **basic Active Directory knowledge** 
 to support hybrid enterprise workloads.
   

  

 This is primarily a
 **project delivery and implementation role** 
 , with limited post\-go\-live stabilization support.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
 Working in collaboration with the Regional Service Centre and Azure Delivery teams, responsibilities include:
   

  

**Azure Implementation \& Project Delivery**
* Implement Azure landing zones and subscription structures as per approved architecture.
* Deploy core Azure services: Virtual Machines, VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage Accounts.
* Configure availability, backup, DR, and security baselines.
* Execute workload onboarding and cutover activities during migration projects.
* Perform build, test, and production go\-live activities.
* Prepare implementation guides, build documents, and handover packs.
* Participate in design walkthroughs and technical workshops with customers.


**Migration Execution**
* Perform on\-prem to Azure and cloud\-to\-cloud migrations.
* Assist with discovery and assessment phases using Azure Migrate.
* Execute replication and cutover activities using ASR and Data Box.
* Support post\-migration stabilisation and optimisation phases.
* Track technical actions for migration waves and project milestones.


**Identity \& Active Directory**
* Support identity integration between on\-prem AD and Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Perform user/group sync checks and RBAC configuration.
* Understand AD fundamentals: OUs, DNS, Group Policy basics.
* Assist with MFA and conditional access rollout as part of projects.


**Automation \& Tooling**
* Implement builds using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform templates for to deploy VNets, AKS clusters, and SQL databases.
* Support Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment.
* Use PowerShell / Azure CLI for automation during migrations and builds.


**Security Implementation**
* Hardening the environment by Zero Trust principles.
* Configuring Microsoft Entra ID (IAM) and enforcing Azure Policies.


**AI Integration**
* Build infra for Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search.


**Operational Readiness \& Handover**
* Assist in operational readiness activities before transition to support teams.
* Create SOPs and runbooks for steady\-state environments.
* Participate in knowledge\-transfer sessions with managed services teams.
* Ensure governance, tagging, and security standards are implemented before handover.

 An Azure Support Engineer should also have the following qualifications and experience\-
   

  

* 5\+ years in cloud or infrastructure delivery roles.
* Strong hands\-on Azure implementation experience.
* Proven involvement in migration or transformation projects.
* Working knowledge of:
+ Azure Compute, Storage, Networking
+ Azure AD / RBAC / Hybrid Identity basics

* Windows and Linux administration experience.
* Basic automation/scripting exposure.
* Experience working in professional services / project\-based delivery environments.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Characteristics**
* Delivery\-oriented mindset with strong documentation skills.
* Comfortable working with project plans and milestones.
* Customer\-facing experience during implementations.
* Ability to follow architecture designs and escalate risks early.
* Exposure to Well\-Architected Framework and governance models is desirable.

* AZ\-500 (Azure Security Engineer)
* AZ \-700 ( Network Engineer)


**Optional\-**
* AZ\-400 (Azure DevOps Engineer Expert)
* AZ \-305 (Azure Solution Architect)

This is **not a direct patient care role,** but *does involve patient outreach via phone or telehealth to ensure program participation and continuity of care*.

* **Psychiatry Program**
* **Telemedicine Program**
* **Pediatrics Program**
* **Nutrition Program**

* **Care Quality Program**

------------------------


* Ownership of a high\-impact program with measurable performance metrics
* Direct impact on patient access and program growth
* Performance\-based compensation with hourly pay and bonus incentives
* Remote work with flexibility after demonstrating strong performance
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth


**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------


* Manage and grow assigned program’s patient engagement and site utilization
* Conduct outreach to patients as needed to reduce drop\-offs and missed follow\-ups
* Coordinate with providers and operations teams to ensure smooth patient flow
* Identify operational challenges and recommend solutions
* Maintain accurate tracking of program metrics, patient volumes, and follow\-ups
* Provide regular updates to leadership on program performance


**Compensation \& Incentives**
------------------------------

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Experience in clinical or program coordination preferred
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable making outbound patient calls and coordinating workflows
* Detail\-oriented and able to work independently in a remote environment


**Schedule Requirements**
-------------------------


* Full remote role
* Eastern Time: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday\-Friday (including holidays)

--------------------------

* Operating system: Windows 10 or macOS (latest version).

**Benefits**
------------


* Competitive hourly pay with performance bonus

* Professional development opportunities


At Nao Medical, we're revolutionizing healthcare by blending cutting\-edge technology with heartfelt, personalized care. Over the past 13 years, we've proudly served more than a million New Yorkers at our various locations.

 Who We Are
   

  

 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world.  What You’ll Do

9ffa061b.title: Presales Engineer – Cloud & AI
9ffa061b.description:
**Job Description**
 About the job
   

  

**About Comprinno**
 Comprinno is a NASSCOM\-incubated company headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Pune, Coimbatore, and the United States. We specialize in cloud transformation, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling organizations to build scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud environments on AWS. Our flagship SaaS platform, Tevico, offers intelligent cloud governance and observability for AWS workloads. It helps enterprises improve uptime, reduce costs, and ensure compliance by proactively detecting anomalies and triggering automated remediation workflows. As a trusted partner to both startups and enterprises, we combine deep cloud expertise with a customer\-first mindset. Our services span Cloud Migration, Modernization, Security, Managed Services, Data Analytics, and Generative AI solutions, driving innovation and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a dynamic and customer\-focused Presales Engineer – Cloud \& AI to support our Cloud Transformation, Modernization, Managed Services, and AI/GenAI practices. This role is pivotal in shaping technical solutions for prospective customers, driving value\-based conversations, and bridging the gap between customer challenges and Comprinno's cloud and AI capabilities. As a Presales Engineer – Cloud \& AI, you will work closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Data \& AI teams, and Delivery teams to understand customer requirements, design high\-level solutions, and articulate how Comprinno's offerings can accelerate digital transformation and business outcomes. This is a high\-impact role that combines cloud solutioning, technical consulting, AI awareness, customer engagement, and presales excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Discovery \& Solutioning
   

  

* Engage with prospective customers to understand business objectives, technical challenges, and transformation goals.
* Conduct discovery workshops, assessments, and technical discussions to identify cloud and AI opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into high\-level cloud and AI solution architectures.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects and technical teams to develop scalable and cost\-effective solutions.


 Cloud Transformation Consulting
   

  

* Support customer initiatives across:
* Cloud Migration
* Application Modernization
* DevOps Transformation
* Managed Services
* Security \& Compliance
* Resilience \& Disaster Recovery
* Conduct cloud assessments and migration readiness evaluations.
* Prepare cloud cost estimates, modernization roadmaps, and optimization recommendations.
* Leverage AWS programs and frameworks such as:
* Migration Acceleration Program (MAP)
* AWS Well\-Architected Framework (WAFR)
* Foundational Technical Review (FTR)


 AI \& GenAI Solution Consulting
   

  

* Identify opportunities for AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI adoption within customer environments.
* Participate in AI discovery workshops and business value discussions.
* Support solution design for AI\-powered applications leveraging AWS AI services.
* Collaborate with Data \& AI teams to position analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI offerings.
* Assist customers in identifying suitable use cases for:
* Generative AI
* AI Assistants
* Knowledge Management Solutions
* Intelligent Automation
* Conversational AI


 Proposal Development \& Technical Presales
   

  

* Collaborate with Solution Architects to create:
* Technical Proposals
* Architecture Diagrams
* Effort Estimates
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Technical Responses to RFPs/RFIs
* Present solutions, recommendations, and technical approaches to customer stakeholders.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), demonstrations, and technical validations.
* Participate in technical reviews and solution walkthroughs.


 Customer Engagement \& Thought Leadership
   

  

* Attend customer meetings jointly with Sales teams to provide technical expertise.
* Build credibility and trust with customer technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to webinars, workshops, technical presentations, and customer\-facing events.
* Write blogs, case studies, solution briefs, and technical content that supports business growth.
* Maintain an active presence in cloud and AI communities.


 Collaboration \& Knowledge Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Delivery teams to ensure smooth handover and alignment between presales and execution.
* Maintain reusable presales assets, templates, assessment frameworks, and knowledge repositories.
* Continuously stay updated on AWS services, AI advancements, partner programs, and emerging technology trends.
* Contribute to internal capability building and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


 Travel \& Customer Interaction
   

  

* Travel as required for customer meetings, workshops, assessments, events, and strategic engagements.
* Represent Comprinno professionally during all customer\-facing interactions.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Cloud Consulting, Technical Sales, or related customer\-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of AWS cloud services across:
* Compute
* Networking
* Storage
* Security
* Databases
* Knowledge of cloud migration and modernization frameworks such as AWS MAP.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud assessment tools including Migration Evaluator and AWS Well\-Architected Tool.
* Understanding of:
* Kubernetes
* Containerization
* Cloud\-Native Architectures
* DevOps Practices
* Hands\-on exposure to Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Ability to create:
* Solution Documents
* Architecture Diagrams
* Technical Proposals
* Effort Estimates
* Statements of Work
* Understanding of Generative AI concepts including:
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Prompt Engineering
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* AI Assistants
* Agentic AI Concepts
* Familiarity with AWS AI services such as:
* Amazon Bedrock
* Amazon SageMaker
* Amazon Q
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional Certification.
* Experience positioning AI, GenAI, Analytics, or Data Engineering solutions.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks such as:
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* CrewAI
* OpenAI APIs
* Anthropic APIs
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience conducting AI assessments, GenAI workshops, or AI proof\-of\-concepts.
* Experience contributing to webinars, blogs, case studies, or technical marketing content.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Associate Certification (Mandatory).
* Customer\-centric mindset with strong problem\-solving abilities.


**Desired Qualifications \& Skills**
* AWS Specialty Certifications such as:
* Security Specialty
* Advanced Networking Specialty
* Machine Learning Specialty
* DevOps Engineer Professional
* Understanding of compliance frameworks such as:
* ISO 27001
* SOC 2
* HIPAA
* MBA or equivalent business qualification.
* Contributions to industry blogs, webinars, conferences, technical communities, or open\-source initiatives.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand customer business challenges.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to balance technical depth with business value articulation.
* Passion for cloud technologies, AI, and emerging innovation.
* Collaborative team player who can work across Sales, Architecture, Delivery, and Product teams.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
* Willingness to travel and work from customer locations across India and internationally as required by project engagements.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Consistently contributes to qualified pipeline creation and deal progression.
* Produces high\-quality proposals, architecture recommendations, assessments, and Statements of Work.
* Builds credibility with customers through strong technical consulting and solution design.
* Successfully supports closure of Migration, Modernization, Managed Services, Security, and AI opportunities.
* Develops reusable presales assets, assessment frameworks, and solution accelerators.
* Contributes to thought leadership through blogs, webinars, technical presentations, and customer\-facing content.
* Continuously expands expertise in AWS, Cloud, AI, and emerging technologies.


 Why Join Comprinno
   

  

* Work at the forefront of Cloud, AI, and AWS innovation with one of the leading AWS Partners in APJ.
* Be part of real transformation initiatives involving Migration, Modernization, DevOps, Security, Managed Services, and Generative AI.
* Collaborate directly with enterprise customers and influence strategic technology decisions.
* Accelerate your growth through AWS certifications, mentorship, and hands\-on customer engagements.
* Contribute to innovative solutions including Tevico and future AI\-powered offerings.
* Build thought leadership through webinars, blogs, events, and community participation.
* Join a collaborative, high\-performance culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.


**Required Skills**

46b0c209.title: Senior Specialist, EHS Solution Architecture
46b0c209.description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data\-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital\-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.


Role Overview
  
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands\-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data\-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current\-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, guide proof\-of\-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
* Define the MEEHS target architecture: Develop current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability: Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data\-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs: Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models: Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital\-thread capabilities: Conceptualize and assess digital\-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments: Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness: Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI\-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine\-learning use cases, and future agent\-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership: Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non\-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions: Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance: Incorporate secure\-by\-design, least\-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset: Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.


What You Should Have
  
  

**Primary Skills:** TOGAF
  
  

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)
* Enterprise System Integration


AI/Machine Learning Architecture
  
  

* Secondary Skills: CAD/BIM Platforms (Autodesk, Bentley)
* CMMS / Asset Reliability Platforms
* EHS Platforms (Enablon, Sphera, Cority, Intelex)
* Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of IT experience, including substantial experience in system architecture, solution architecture, enterprise integration, application modernization, and data\-platform design.
* Demonstrated experience creating solution, integration, application, data, cloud, security, and deployment architectures for complex enterprise environments.
* Experience designing interoperability across COTS, SaaS, vendor\-hosted, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise platforms using reusable integration and information patterns.
* Experience architecting data hubs, data platforms, warehouses, lakes or lakehouses, semantic models, metadata and lineage capabilities, data quality controls, and governed analytical consumption.
* Experience progressing concepts from discovery and feasibility assessment through proof of concept, pilot, implementation, rollout, operational transition, and lifecycle management.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, infrastructure, integration, data and analytics, procurement, service management, vendors, and managed service teams.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.


Technical Knowledge
  
* Architecture methods and modeling: Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability: API\-first and event\-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance: Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role\-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture: Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains: Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project\-to\-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.
* Analytics and AI enablement: Power BI or comparable business intelligence platforms, analytical data preparation, feature\-ready datasets, vector and semantic retrieval concepts, knowledge graphs, responsible AI controls, data provenance, model monitoring, and human oversight.
* Cybersecurity and identity: Zero Trust, secure\-by\-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations: SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.


Non\-Technical Skills and Competencies
  
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product\-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Ability to facilitate discovery, architecture workshops, trade\-off decisions, design reviews, feasibility assessments, and cross\-functional alignment using clear decision criteria.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non\-technical teams.

9e142782.title: Lead SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) & Dataspehere Consultant
9e142782.description:
REMOTE OPTION IS AVAILABLE
   

  

 NO FRESHER WILL BE PREFERRED
   

  

 We are looking for Lead SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) \& Dataspehere Consultant as a Full Time for our IT Company.
   

  

 Location\- Remote
   

 Experience\- 8\+ years
   

 Budget\- As per company standard
   

 Notice Period\- Immediate Joiner
   

  

 Process \& Analytics Services capability is at the forefront of transforming our business processes through innovation in automation, analytics, and artificial intelligence. As part of the Process Insights team, we are scaling our SAP analytics expertise to deliver best\-in\-class solutions. We are seeking a talented SAP Analytics Cloud \& Datasphere Consultant to drive analytical initiatives and empower data\-driven decision\-making at AstraZeneca's Global Business Services (GBS) – Process \& Analytics Services.
   

  

 Main duties and responsibilities
   

  

 The role will be responsible for the following activities:
   

  

 \- Design and develop analytic applications using SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP Datasphere, focusing on KPI and analytical models that support strategic business initiatives.
   

 \- Build interactive dashboards and KPI applications in SAC for both import and live scenarios, leveraging data sourced from SAP Datasphere and other platforms.
   

 \- Create scalable, secure, and governed data models in SAP Datasphere to support advanced analytics and reporting use cases.
   

 \- Integrate SAC dashboards seamlessly with SAP Datasphere datasets, ensuring up\-to\-date and consistent analytics for end users.
   

 \- Utilize predictive scenarios, R\-visualizations, and external libraries to create immersive and insightful user experiences in both SAC and Datasphere environments.
   

 \- Continuously optimize dashboard and application performance across SAC and Datasphere, while providing recommendations for enhancements and identifying bottlenecks.
   

 \- Develop and document Business Objects Universes, reports, and dashboards, ensuring accuracy and alignment with enterprise data standards.
   

 \- Connect, model, and harmonize data from SAP and non\-SAP sources in Datasphere, facilitating cross\-system analytics through SAC.
   

 \- Design comprehensive reports with multiple tabs, queries, visualizations, and drill\-down capabilities tailored to business requirements.
   

 \- Apply best practices in data visualization and user experience, enhancing accessibility and adoption of solutions built on SAC and Datasphere.
   

 \- Demonstrate expertise in data integration, connectivity, and modelling across SAC, Datasphere, and other data platforms.
   

 \- Utilize strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address technical challenges and drive continuous performance improvement.
   

 \- Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to team members, fostering knowledge growth in SAC and Datasphere technologies.
   

 \- Establish and maintain best practices for software quality, documentation, and project delivery within agile and scrum frameworks.
   

 \- Customize SAC applications using scripting languages (such as JavaScript) and leverage advanced features in Datasphere for data orchestration and automation.
   

 \- Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, contributing to the solution design and integration of SAC and Datasphere in end\-to\-end business processes.
   

  

 Essential requirements
   

  

 \- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
   

 \- Overall, 8\-12 years of experience and at least 2\-3 years' experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a Consultant, Analyst, Developer or relevant role.
   

 \- Proven experience designing and implementing solutions utilizing SAC for planning, forecasting, and KPI reporting, as well as integrating with SAP Datasphere and upstream processes.
   

 \- Expertise with SAC predictive functionality, Smart features (Smart Assist, Smart Predict, Smart Discovery), advanced story canvases, data blending, cross\-calculations, input controls, and linked analysis.
   

 \- Skilled in connecting SAC and Datasphere to varied data sources, including SAP HANA, and external databases.
   

 \- Proficiency in SAP Datasphere for building unified, harmonized, and governed data models to serve enterprise analytics.
   

 \- In\-depth understanding of data integration and ETL processes across SAC, Datasphere, and other analytics platforms.
   

 \- Advanced scripting abilities in SQL, Python, and JavaScript to enable data manipulation and automation within both SAC and Datasphere environments.
   

 \- Experience with SAC scripting for creating custom widgets and analytics applications, as well as automating data flows in Datasphere.
   

 \- Understanding of SAP related Finance and/or Operations processes will be valued.
   

 \- Certification in one or more of the following will be appreciated: SAC Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Low\-Code/No\-Code Developer.
   

 \- Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
   

 \- Energetic, organised and self\-motivated.
   

 \- Fluent in business English.

66910edb.title: Senior Security Consultant – AWS Cloud Architecture
66910edb.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 AWS Cloud Architect responsible for designing, building, and owning the complete AWS foundation for Gruve's Cisco ISE\-as\-a\-Service (ISEaaS) multi\-tenant managed service, with 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and network security environments. Owns the AWS Organization and multi\-account landing zone, tenant network architecture, security guardrails, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cloud cost management. This is a hands\-on build role: the successful candidate will personally author Terraform modules and design the account structure that every customer tenant is provisioned from, while applying reliability engineering practices to reduce operational toil. Working knowledge of Cisco ISE, RADIUS, and enterprise network security concepts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement multi\-account AWS Organization structure, including Organizational Units (OUs), management account separation, and consolidated billing.
* Design and enforce Service Control Policies (SCPs) and organization\-level guardrails for tenant isolation and compliance.
* Design tenant network architecture: VPC, multi\-AZ subnet design, route tables, VPC endpoints, NAT, DNS (Route 53 private zones including PTR records), and IP address management (IPAM).
* Implement AWS Transit Gateway hub\-and\-spoke connectivity with per\-tenant route tables, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and Direct Connect.
* Implement AWS security services: IAM and IAM Identity Center (SSO), KMS customer\-managed keys, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Own cloud cost management and FinOps: per\-tenant cost attribution, tagging strategy, budget alerts, Cost Explorer and CUR\-based chargeback reporting, and cost modeling to support service pricing and margin analysis.
* Design for high availability and disaster recovery across Availability Zones and regions, including backup, restore, and recovery runbooks.
* Apply reliability engineering practices: automation\-first operations, toil reduction, failure\-mode analysis, and infrastructure observability.
* Implement policy\-as\-code and security scanning in CI/CD pipelines (Checkov, tfsec, or equivalent).
* Partner with automation and ISE engineering teams to ensure infrastructure outputs integrate cleanly with configuration management.
* Subscribe to and manage the Cisco ISE AMI listing on AWS Marketplace per Region, including EULA acceptance and AMI version/release validation before each tenant build.
* Verify and manage AWS service quotas (EC2 instance types, EIPs, VPC limits) per Region/tenant.
* Configure Network ACLs and manage Elastic IP allocation policy (use only where explicitly required; avoid public exposure of ISE by default).
* Enable VPC Flow Logs for tenant VPCs/subnets where required by security or compliance standards.
* Configure EC2 instance metadata options (IMDSv2\) and other instance\-level hardening attributes.
* Own EC2 user\-data / bootstrap configuration for the ISE AMI (hostname, management IP, NTP, DNS) so it hands off cleanly into the Platform Automation Engineer's post\-bootstrap automation.
* Define NTP source design for ISE nodes alongside the existing DNS/Route 53 designs.
* Own the end\-to\-end AWS infrastructure validation checklist (EC2, EBS, security groups, routing, DNS, NTP, IAM, encryption, monitoring) at each tenant go\-live.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cloud architecture roles.
* Demonstrable experience designing and building a multi\-account AWS Organization or landing zone from the ground up.
* Strong hands\-on Terraform experience — candidates should be able to describe modules they have personally authored.
* Solid understanding of AWS networking, including Transit Gateway, VPN, and hybrid connectivity to on\-premises environments.
* Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategy, and cost attribution in multi\-tenant or managed service environments.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional preferred; AWS Advanced Networking or Security specialty certifications an advantage.
* Experience in a managed services provider (MSP), multi\-tenant SaaS, or hosted service environment is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with Cisco ISE, NAC, or enterprise network security concepts is an advantage.
* Strong documentation, design communication, and cross\-team collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS Core: AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Account Factory, Service Control Policies (SCPs), IAM, IAM Identity Center (SSO), EC2, EBS, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager (SSM), CloudWatch.
* AWS Networking: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Transit Gateway, Site\-to\-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, VPC Endpoints, NAT Gateway, IPAM.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (module authoring, remote state, workspaces), Git, CI/CD pipelines, policy\-as\-code (Checkov / tfsec / Sentinel).
* Security \& Governance: CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS key policies, least\-privilege IAM design, multi\-tenant isolation patterns.
* Cloud Financial Management: Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Report (CUR), tagging strategy, budgets and alerts, per\-tenant chargeback and cost modeling.
* Scripting \& Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell (any one or more), REST API integration.
* Familiar with Technologies: Cisco ISE, RADIUS / RADSec, 802\.1X, Ansible, Azure, Kubernetes.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

2901cb13.title: Delivery Lead (Technical Project Manager)
2901cb13.description:
**About The Role**
 You will be the person clients trust to keep a project on track. You will turn a brief into a plan, keep the team building the right thing in weekly steps, and make sure clients always know where things stand.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Run discovery with clients: understand the process, the goal and how success will be measured.
* Break projects into small, weekly deliverables, and keep scope honest.
* Run weekly demos and follow\-ups, and keep decisions and risks visible.
* Work closely with engineers, and unblock them quickly.
* Spot problems early and raise them with clients before they become surprises.


 You might be a good fit if
   

  

* You have delivered software or automation projects and can describe what went wrong on one.
* You can talk to both engineers and non\-technical business owners.
* You write clearly and keep things organised without making a fuss.
* You are comfortable saying no, or not yet, to a client.


 Nice to have
   

  

* A technical background, or experience as a developer or analyst.
* Experience with agencies or client\-services work.


 How we work
   

  

* A remote\-first team, working with clients in the US, UK and India.
* We ship working software every week and show it to the client.
* Clients own the source code and infrastructure we build, so we earn our next project by doing this one well.

b56287fc.description:
**Job Summary**
 Program Manager role in a global organization focused on delivering complex enterprise solutions using Adobe Experience Manager in a hybrid work model. The position requires extensive ownership of multi year digital programs ensuring strategic alignment operational excellence and measurable business outcomes while coordinating cross functional teams and stakeholders in a day schedule with no travel requirement.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end governance of large scale digital programs built on Adobe Experience Manager ensuring delivery on scope schedule and quality while aligning with organizational objectives and compliance standards.
* Coordinate cross functional teams including architects developers testers and business analysts to ensure seamless integration of Adobe Experience Manager solutions into the broader enterprise technology landscape.
* Oversee detailed program planning activities by defining milestones dependencies and resource allocation strategies that enable predictable delivery and mitigate risks across hybrid work environments.
* Manage stakeholder expectations through structured communication routines by presenting progress risks and mitigation plans that promote transparency and informed decision making at all levels of the organization.
* Monitor program performance using standardized metrics and dashboards to identify delivery bottlenecks and implement corrective actions that sustain velocity and improve overall efficiency.
* Guide solution teams on effective use of Adobe Experience Manager capabilities such as content management workflows and personalization features to maximize value creation for business units and end users.
* Implement robust risk and issue management practices by tracking impacts on timeline budget and scope and by facilitating timely escalations and resolution through cross team collaboration.
* Optimize hybrid work practices by defining clear collaboration norms tooling usage and communication channels that ensure productivity and cohesion for onsite and remote team members.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture and operations groups to ensure Adobe Experience Manager implementations are scalable maintainable and aligned with security and performance standards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by capturing lessons learned from Adobe Experience Manager programs and converting them into reusable frameworks templates and guidelines for future engagements.
* Ensure alignment of program outcomes with company mission and sustainability goals by prioritizing user centric digital experiences that improve access to information and services for diverse communities.
* Facilitate contract and vendor management activities related to Adobe Experience Manager including scope definition performance tracking and financial oversight to ensure optimal value realization from external partners.
* Maintain strong documentation discipline across all program artifacts such as charters status reports and decision logs to support audit readiness and knowledge transfer within the organization.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive experience of more than sixteen years in managing complex technology programs with a strong focus on enterprise scale digital initiatives and structured delivery methodologies.
* Possess deep practical proficiency in Adobe Experience Manager including design implementation and optimization of content management and digital experience solutions across multiple business domains.
* Apply solid program management domain expertise by using industry standard practices for planning governance risk management and stakeholder communication to ensure predictable outcomes.
* Utilize strong communication and negotiation skills to coordinate senior stakeholders technical teams and business partners in hybrid working environments and day shift schedules.
* Exhibit proven ability to manage budgets resources and vendor relationships for large programs while maintaining focus on measurable business benefits and operational resilience.
* Bring experience in working within global multinational organizations where cross cultural collaboration and adherence to regulatory and compliance guidelines are essential.
* Show capability to mentor and guide project managers and team members on program practices and effective use of Adobe Experience Manager so that delivery capabilities mature over time.
* Demonstrate analytical and problem solving strengths by interpreting performance data from multiple sources and converting insights into actionable improvement plans for ongoing and future programs.
* Maintain familiarity with modern agile and scaled agile ways of working and adapt them pragmatically to suit the constraints and objectives of complex Adobe Experience Manager initiatives.
* Display strong organizational and time management skills to balance multiple work streams within the program while safeguarding quality of deliverables and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Commit to continuous learning in digital experience technologies and program management methodologies ensuring that solutions remain modern sustainable and aligned with market expectations.

Program Manager role for a multinational organization focusing on strategic delivery of initiatives built on Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimiser. Oversee execution of multiple concurrent projects under the program portfolio ensuring that deliverables built on Adobe Experience Platform meet agreed quality and performance benchmarks

Champion continuous improvement within the program by capturing lessons learned after major releases and translating them into actionable improvements for future AEP and journey optimization efforts
  
Align program outcomes with organizational purpose by ensuring that experience solutions delivered through Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimiser contribute to better customer engagement and positive social impact

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate deep hands on experience in managing complex programs that rely on Adobe Experience Platform including orchestration of data driven experiences and integration with enterprise ecosystems
  
Bring substantial exposure to Adobe Journey Optimiser including configuration of journeys audience management and optimization of omni channel customer interactions within large scale environments
  
Apply strong program management capabilities such as portfolio coordination schedule management financial tracking and governance suited for day shift hybrid work models
  
Utilize advanced stakeholder management communication and negotiation skills to keep diverse business and technology partners aligned on Adobe Experience Platform and journey optimization priorities
  
Exhibit solid understanding of agile and iterative delivery practices enabling structured yet flexible execution of programs that depend on evolving customer experience requirements
  
Leverage experience in domains related to program management to contextualize customer journeys and translate strategic objectives into clear deliverables and measurable outcomes
  
Use analytical and problem solving skills to interpret data from Adobe Experience Platform and journey performance indicators and convert insights into targeted program level improvements

1284c983.title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
1284c983.description:
**Description**
 Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) provides the technology infrastructure backbone of every Amazon fulfillment site globally — and Quick Commerce is rewriting the rules of how that infrastructure gets built. This role will be the single threaded leader Quick commerce tech infrastructure for an entire country.
   

  

 Quick Commerce demands a fundamentally different approach: frugal, vendor\-managed infrastructure that launches at unprecedented velocity while maintaining enterprise\-grade availability. As the country's single\-threaded infrastructure owner, you will define the network and device strategy that enables Amazon to launch and operate hundreds of sites at speed and at a fraction of traditional cost. You will own the country\-level technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, govern availability and financial outcomes, and partner directly with senior business operations leadership. Quick Commerce is the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores, and team NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) shapes its technology backbone.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The NANO TIPM owns the country\-level infrastructure strategy — defining architecture standards and readiness criteria against which all site launches execute. For network infrastructure, the TIPM owns end\-to\-end scope from vendor selection through SLA governance through financial outcome. For End\-User Equipment (associate\-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers), the TIPM owns identification and recommendation while partnering with Device Tech for certification. The role's responsibilities fall into four themes — Theme 1 sets the framework, Theme 2 executes, Theme 3 governs, and Theme 4 feeds business needs back into Theme 1\.
   

  

 Theme 1 — Strategy, Vendor Management, and Contract Governance: Own the country's network technology roadmap, drive vendor selection end\-to\-end, and identify end user devices meeting regional cost and performance targets across all applicable site types.
   

  

 Theme 2 — Site Launch and Network Deployment: Define playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where decisions carry fleet\-wide implications beyond execution\-level authority.
   

  

 Theme 3 — Operations Excellence, Governance, and Financial Accountability: Own network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet, driving vendor performance through structured governance cadences.
   

  

 Theme 4 — Partnership with Business Operations Leadership: Translate the country's business growth priorities into infrastructure strategy, surfacing performance insights, capacity risks, and cost tradeoffs that inform decisions across the region.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce in India — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet\-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction versus legacy models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor decisions that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) team sits within Operations Infrastructure Services and exists to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small\-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. The team owns the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of the use cases today, scaling from \~500 sites to 3,000\+ by 2028, with the enablement model extending to every emerging no\-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience managing large\-scale projects from end to end


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The AI Infrastructure Architect sets the architecture those platforms are built to.
   

  

 The role defines the reference architecture and guardrails for AI workloads across Azure, AWS and private AI environments: training and inference platforms, GPU capacity and scheduling, data pipelines and data access, model operations, logging, monitoring, cost control and lifecycle governance. It establishes the standard intake pattern by which an AI use case moves from idea to a hosted, monitored, auditable service, so that scientists and business teams get speed without the organisation inheriting uncontrolled risk.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor architecture role. Its authority comes from design quality, evidence and adoption rather than from line management.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own the AI infrastructure reference architecture and the standards that govern training, fine\-tuning, inference and retrieval\-augmented patterns across public cloud and private AI hosting.
* Define the standard AI workload intake pattern, including architecture review criteria, data classification handling, environment selection and the conditions under which a use case may go to production.
* Set guardrails for sensitive data, model access, prompt and inference logging, monitoring, resilience, retention and cost, in partnership with Security, Data Privacy and Quality.
* Design GPU and accelerator capacity patterns \- shared pools, reservations, scheduling, quotas and burst to cloud \- and support the associated capacity and cost models.
* Support qualification of AI platforms, regions and services for enterprise consumption together with AI \& HPC Engineering and the public cloud architects.
* Define the MLOps and LLMOps reference chain: model registry, versioning, evaluation, deployment, drift and performance monitoring, and decommissioning.
* Maintain architecture decision records for AI platform choices, linking each to business value, risk posture and total cost of ownership.
* Advise business, research and Infrastructure Solution Delivery stakeholders on feasible AI infrastructure options, and translate scientific and commercial requirements into technical designs.
* Track the AI infrastructure market, evaluate emerging accelerators, model\-serving stacks and platform services, and bring credible innovation into the roadmap.
* Coach engineers and architects on AI infrastructure practice and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.


**Essential Requirement**
* 8\+ years' experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform architecture, with a strong track record of designing and supporting enterprise\-scale technology solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in building, deploying, and operating AI and machine learning infrastructure within production environments.
* Experience enabling AI solutions to transition from proof\-of\-concept stages into scalable, governed, and business\-critical services.
* Strong knowledge of GPU and accelerator technologies, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud\-based AI platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Hands\-on experience with model serving, inference optimization, MLOps/LLMOps practices, and modern data and vector pipeline architectures.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, observability, cost optimization (FinOps), and secure AI platform operations.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, including explainability, auditability, logging, human oversight, and risk management controls.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI infrastructure concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences while driving collaboration across engineering, security, privacy, and business teams.


**Desirable Requirement**
