95224ad2.title: Program Manager
95224ad2.description:
**About the company** 




 TinkerLabs is a problem\-solving and innovation consulancy that applies Design Thinking and Behavioral Science to address complex business and social impact challenges. Since 2013, the team has partnered with 100\+ organizations across 15\+ industries, including Fortune 500 companies, leading Indian enterprises, and global non\-profits. Clients range from Microsoft, Unilever, Tata Group, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Flipkart, and L\&T to the Gates Foundation, UNFPA, and GIZ. Through consulting engagements, sprints, and workshops, TinkerLabs helps teams generate bold, human\-centered, and simple ideas that drive meaningful change. More information about their work and collaborations is available at www.tinkerlabs.in.
 



  





**About the role** 





 Can you turn ambitious project visions into seamless operational reality? We are hiring for a
 
**Program Manager** 

 who can balance high\-energy facilitation with rigorous operational mastery for a very important and elaborate education programme at TinkerLabs. 
 




  






 We’ve partnered with a large corporate to equip students from design and engineering institutes in India to build products and services for a social impact cause using our methodology. The goal is to help students build strong ideas and connect them to an incubator that brings their ideas to life. 
 




  






 We’re looking for a Program Manager who can run this national\-scale design thinking workshop program \- you’ll be the force that turns a complex programme run smoothly for all stakeholders involved. And when a session needs a facilitator, you are able to stand up and run it yourself.
 




  






 This is not a coordination role. You are expected to shape the plan for the year, defend it with the client, and then deliver it.
 




  





**What will you do** 



* **Master multi\-city operations:** 

 Build and manage the end\-to\-end programme roadmap across multiple colleges nationwide. Track milestones, coordinate schedules, mitigate risks and bottlenecks, manage stakeholder and client communications and ensure seamless delivery
* **Organise the chaos:** 

 Drive key activities and keep track of all moving parts \- institutional partnerships, workshop content, facilitators training, workshop sessions, student submissions, feedback loops and important project tasks without missing a beat
* **Manage client trust:** 

 Lead client\-facing communications with poise and empathy. Set clear expectations, navigate bottlenecks seamlessly and bring grounding and ease to complex timelines
* **Streamline team resourcing:** 

 Balance workloads, forecast talent needs and hire the right people
* **Manage hybrid delivery:** 

 Seamlessly bridge the gap between digital learning platforms and in\-person events across various facilitators\- keeping student engagement consistent and the quality of project high
* **Facilitate with high energy:** 

 Lead engaging, interactive design thinking workshops both in\-person and online



  





**What are we looking for:** 




*Must haves:* 



* **Proven facilitation \& coaching experience:** 

 3\+ years of experience leading workshops, teaching, or facilitating design thinking, human\-centered design (HCD), or experiential learning modules.
* **Genuine facilitation ability:** 

 Has ability to command a room independently for 30\+ participants \- adapt on the fly when an exercise isn't landing, and build quick rapport with college students and faculty alike
* **Strong project management chops:** 

 Track record of managing complex projects/programmes with multiple moving parts, stakeholders, and strict deadlines \- nothing goes missing when working with you
* **Solid client management and communication skills** 

 : Comfortable delivering bad news, collaborating on solutions, sending clear emails and being seen as a trustworthy face for the client.
* **Willingness to travel:** 

 Eagerness to travel to college campuses across India (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3\) for live workshop modules



  





*Good to haves:* 



* Experience
 
**working with colleges, universities or student communities** 

 in India.
* **Comfort using AI tools** 

 as part of workshop delivery and content preparation.
* A
 
**design or education** 

 background.



  





**Besides the work, what is in it for you:** 



* **Ownership from day one.** 

 You won't just follow a playbook \- you will shape how this massive programme journey unfolds and scales.
* **High\-impact learning.** 

 You will watch students transform from passive learners into confident, empathetic problem\-solvers over the course of a full academic year.
* **High Impact, High Velocity:** 

 We move fast and aim high, offering an environment where you do meaningful, rewarding work while respecting personal boundaries.



  





**How to apply:** 





 To help us get a feel for how you think, we’d love for you to respond to one question:
 





 Tell us about a time when you managed a complex, long\-term project with many moving parts. What were the main challenges and how did you pivot from there?
 




  





*Please feel free to share the response in any format you would do justice to \- write it, draw it, record it.* 




  






 Please share your
 
**response, updated resume and relevant work sample/facilitation videos** 

 to
 
**curios@tinkerlabs.in** 

 with the subject line:
 
**Program Manager\_(Your name)** 




  





*As a human will review all the applications, everyone will receive a reply in due time*

d640ff0e.title: Program Manager
d640ff0e.description:
**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------


This is not a traditional project\-management role focused only on schedules, meetings, and status reports.


At Mirabilis Design, the Program Manager works across the full business cycle, from **product development and bug resolution to customer evaluations, sales opportunities, support activities, and marketing programs**. For someone interested in developing into a future **Program Leader, Product Manager, Operations Leader, or Business Leader**, this role offers significant learning and responsibility.


You will have visibility into what is happening across the organization and will play a key role in keeping teams aligned, identifying issues early, and ensuring that important commitments move forward.


The role provides direct exposure to:


* Engineering and product development
* Customer requirements and technical evaluations
* Sales opportunities and commercial priorities
* Marketing campaigns, events, and programs
* Product releases and support activities
* Senior management decision\-making


You will not simply report progress. You will help **drive progress**.


For someone who wants to understand how a technology company operates end\-to\-end and build experience across product, operations, customers, and business, this is an excellent opportunity.


**Location:** Chennai, India, Hybrid or Remote as applicable  

**Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant experience, or recent MBA with strong internship experience  

**Function:** Program Management / Operations / Cross\-Functional Execution


**About the Role**
------------------


Mirabilis Design is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution\-focused **Program Manager** to help coordinate activities across product development, customer support, product evaluations, sales, and marketing.


This is a highly cross\-functional role with visibility across the organization. The Program Manager will work with engineering, sales, marketing, customer\-facing teams, and management to ensure that assignments are clearly understood, properly owned, progressing according to plan, and completed on time.


The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, following through on commitments, identifying risks early, and ensuring that teams remain aligned.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


The Program Manager will coordinate and track activities across multiple areas of the business, including:


* Product development and release activities
* Bug identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution
* Customer support and technical follow\-up
* Product evaluations, trials, and customer deliverables
* Sales opportunities and related internal actions
* Marketing programs, campaigns, webinars, events, and content activities


You will be responsible for ensuring that every important activity has clear ownership, timelines, dependencies, and measurable progress.


A key part of the role is not simply tracking whether an assignment has been made, but confirming that it is actually progressing as expected.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Coordinate activities across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and customer\-facing teams
* Maintain visibility into open assignments, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies
* Follow up with team members to confirm progress and completion
* Obtain regular feedback to verify that programs are progressing according to plan
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and execution risks early
* Escalate issues before they become major schedule or customer problems
* Track customer evaluations, support requirements, product issues, and related internal actions
* Ensure important customer and sales commitments receive timely follow\-up
* Help coordinate product releases, bug fixes, demonstrations, evaluations, and marketing initiatives
* Provide concise **daily progress updates** and structured **weekly management reports**
* Highlight accomplishments, risks, delayed activities, dependencies, and actions requiring management attention
* Continuously improve internal processes for planning, tracking, communication, and execution

**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------


Candidates should have one of the following backgrounds:


* **3\+ years of experience** in program management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, or a similar role


**OR**


* A **recent MBA graduate** with strong and relevant internship or prior work experience in technology, product management, operations, consulting, engineering, or program management

**Desired Skills**
------------------


The successful candidate should have:


* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to work across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to identify problems and bottlenecks before they impact delivery
* Confidence working with engineering, sales, marketing, customers, and senior management
* Ability to summarize complex activities into clear management updates
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving technology environment


Experience in semiconductors, electronics, EDA, software products, aerospace, automotive, or other engineering\-focused industries is an advantage.

61a8b1c8.description:
**Nomura Overview:** 




 Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East \& West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com. Nomura Services, India supports the group's global businesses. With world\-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group's global operations. At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies \& programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well\-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.
 



  





**Divisional Overview:** 




 The Strategic, Analytics, and Business Re\-engineering (SABRE) division houses the AI transformation initiative, which serves as Nomura's Center of excellence for artificial intelligence\-driven automation and innovation across Global Operations. With increasing demand for AI initiatives across business units and regions—spanning 60\+ active use cases and 4 BU workstreams—SABRE AI provides enterprise program management, governance, and stakeholder coordination to ensure successful delivery of transformational AI solutions. The division is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end AI portfolio, from ideation and business case development through implementation and benefit realization. This includes coordinating \~12 campus hires, vendor resources, cross\-functional IT partnerships, and regional stakeholders across AEJ, EMEA, and Americas. The team works closely with Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit leaders to fast\-track approvals, manage dependencies, drive adoption, and ensure measurable business value. With a target of 30%\+ efficiency gains and a 3\-year transformation roadmap, the SABRE AI team is positioned as a strategic enabler of operational excellence and digital innovation across Nomura's global operations.
 



  





**Business Overview:** 




 The SABRE AI Program Management function provides centralized coordination, governance, and visibility across the growing AI portfolio spanning SSG, CSG, MO, and IWM. The VP, AI Program Manager serves as the single trusted source for priorities, progress, risk, and cost across 60\+ use cases, managing the campus hire team (\~12 members) and vendor resources. This role drives portfolio roadmap governance, cross\-BU coordination, risk and change management, financial tracking, and regional integration—with special focus on Japan integration, stakeholder management, and converting ideas into approved business cases. The role provides critical operational support to free the existing VP to focus on training, regional AI Catalyst engagement, strategy development, and flagship BU projects.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 • We support employee wellbeing by ensuring a sense of purpose and belonging.
 



 • We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
 



 • Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family's holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.
 



  





**Position Specifications:** 



* Corporate Title: Vice President
* Functional Title: VP, AI Program Manager
* Experience: 10\-15 years (including 5\+ years in program/portfolio management and 3\+ years in leadership roles)
* Qualification: B.Tech/M.Tech/MBA or equivalent; PMP/PgMP/SAFe certifications preferred



  





**Role \& Responsibilities:** 




  





**Portfolio Roadmap \& Governance:** 




 • Own and maintain the 3\-year AI transformation roadmap spanning 60\+ use cases across SSG, CSG, MO, and IWM • Maintain a single trusted view of priorities, progress, risks, and costs across all AI initiatives • Participate in governance forums with Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit leaders • Fast\-track NTI (New Technology Introduction) approvals through proactive stakeholder engagement and documentation • Maintain audit\-ready decision records, business case documentation, and approval trails • Achieve \<5% schedule variance through proactive risk management and dependency tracking • Convert ideas into structured business cases with clear ROI, feasibility assessments, and implementation plans
 



  





**Cross\-BU Coordination \& Stakeholder Management:** 




 • Serve as primary point of contact for all AI program inquiries across four business units • Resolve resource conflicts and dependencies across SSG, CSG, MO, IWM workstreams • Align build sequencing to headcount\-weighted priority and business value • Sustain pod utilization and optimize resource allocation across FDE teams and contractors • Facilitate regular coordination meetings with business unit sponsors, IT partners, and technical leads • Manage expectations and communicate trade\-offs across competing priorities • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders in Operations, Technology, Risk, and Compliance
 



  





**Japan Integration \& Regional Coordination:** 




 • Lead Japan integration efforts, serving as primary liaison with Japanese stakeholders • Ensure global technology adoption and consistent AI implementation standards across AEJ, EMEA, and Americas • Adapt communication and governance approaches for regional cultural and business contexts • Coordinate timezone\-spanning meetings and asynchronous collaboration across regions • Translate regional requirements into global roadmap considerations • Drive knowledge sharing and best practice exchange across geographic teams
 



  





**Risk, Change \& Reporting:** 




 • Maintain comprehensive RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) log across all AI initiatives • Drive adoption campaigns tailored to each business unit's culture and operational context • Proactively mitigate top risks including build slippage, SME availability, adoption resistance, and technical dependencies • Implement change management strategies to ensure successful AI solution adoption • Produce board\-ready briefings, executive dashboards, and stakeholder communications • Create compelling narratives that translate technical progress into business impact • Provide transparent reporting on program health, milestone achievement, and benefit realization
 



  





**Benefits \& Financial Management:** 




 • Track investment and costs against BU charge\-out models and budget allocations • Quantify progress toward 30% efficiency gain target with clear metrics and validation • Ensure benefits are captured in Operations Value Scorecard (OVS) with proper attribution • Coordinate with Finance on budget forecasting, cost allocation, and variance analysis • Build and maintain financial models for ROI tracking and benefit realization • Report on cost efficiency, value delivered, and return on investment to senior leadership
 



  





**Team Management:** 




 • Manage \~12 campus hires, providing mentorship, career development, and performance feedback • Coordinate vendor resources and contractors supporting AI build\-out activities • Build team capabilities in program management, stakeholder engagement, and AI literacy • Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture aligned with Nomura values • Conduct regular 1\-on\-1s, performance reviews, and development planning • Manage workload distribution and ensure team wellbeing and engagement
 



  





**Mind Set:** 




**Mandatory** 




**Domain \& Technical:** 




 • 10\-15 years of program/portfolio management experience, including large\-scale transformation programs
 



 • 5\+ years managing cross\-functional initiatives with 20\+ stakeholders
 



 • Strong track record of delivering complex programs on time and within budget
 



 • Expertise in program governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement
 



 • Experience managing teams (10\+ members) including campus hires and vendors
 



 • Proficiency in program management tools (JIRA, MS Project, Smartsheet)
 



 • Strong business acumen and ability to translate technical concepts for executive audiences
 



 • Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
 



 • Experience with financial tracking, budgeting, and benefit realization
 



 • Understanding of change management principles and adoption strategies
 



  





**Desired:** 




 • Experience in financial services operations or capital markets
 



 • Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, use cases, and implementation approaches
 



 • PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certifications
 



 • Experience with Japan or APAC regional coordination
 



 • Understanding of regulatory frameworks (NTI, Model Risk, AI Governance)

c8a00072.title: Presales Engineer
c8a00072.description:
**About Covlant** 

  






 Covlant is building the AI\-native quality layer for modern software teams. Most engineering organizations face the same trade\-off on every release: run the entire regression suite and wait hours for feedback, or run a subset and risk letting defects slip into production. Covlant removes that trade\-off.
 




  






 Our AI\-driven impact testing platform analyzes every pull request against a deep map of the entire codebase to understand exactly what changed and what that change affects. It then selects the right tests from a team's existing suites to cover the impacted code paths. Where coverage is missing, Covlant's quality agents generate and validate new tests, so only meaningful, trustworthy tests are run. Engineers and QA teams stay in control through a clear review experience that shows what was tested, what passed or failed, and why.
 




  






 The result is faster feedback loops, leaner regression cycles, lower test\-maintenance overhead, and greater confidence in every release. Covlant fits into the tools teams already use across their CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
 




  






 We're an early\-stage company working with enterprise engineering and QA teams, and we're growing our team in Bangalore. Joining Covlant now means shaping how the product is positioned, sold, and adopted, working closely with founders, Product, and Engineering, and helping define a new category in software quality.
 




  




**Role \- Presales Engineer** 

  






 Covlant is hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
 




  






 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate Covlant’s capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
 




  




**Key responsibilities** 

  




* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria.
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations for QA, engineering, IT, and executive stakeholders.
* Scope and run POCs with clear use cases, customer commitments, success criteria, milestones, risks, and a conversion plan.
* Partner with Account Executives/Sales leadership to develop technical win plans, address objections, and progress enterprise opportunities.
* Handle technical evaluations, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, integration discussions, and solution\-design requests.
* Advise prospects on test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test reliability, regression efficiency, and implementation best practices.
* Translate product capabilities into quantified customer value—for example, reduced regression effort, faster release cycles, lower test\-maintenance cost, improved automation coverage, and reduced production\-defect risk—and build credible ROI/value cases for buyers.
* Create reusable demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC templates, solution briefs, and competitive/technical collateral.
* Feed recurring customer needs, objections, gaps, and market insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Ensure a structured technical handoff from closed\-won opportunities to implementation or customer\-success teams.



  




**Ideal candidate profile** 

  




* 4–7 years of overall experience, with meaningful early hands\-on work in software development, QA, SDET, test automation, or implementation.
* 2–4 years in a customer\-facing technical role: Presales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Consultant, Technical Consultant, or similar.
* Strong experience in QA/testing and automation, including practical familiarity with tools and concepts such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, cloud testing, and test frameworks.
* Can communicate confidently with QA leads, engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and executive sponsors.
* Has led or materially contributed to tailored demos, POCs, technical discovery, solution proposals, and enterprise evaluations.
* Comfortable navigating integrations, APIs, SSO/RBAC, security reviews, cloud/SaaS architecture, and enterprise buying processes.
* Commercially aware: able to turn technical outcomes into a business case, quantify impact, and support sales teams through complex deal cycles.
* High ownership and comfortable operating in an early\-stage SaaS environment.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

  

AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  

  

Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  

  

AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.  

  

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.  

  

Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.  

  

You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.  

  

As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  

  

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.  

  

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).  

  

A day in the life  

The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.  

  

About the team  

ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.  

  

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

7bb19d16.title: IT Client Solutions Executive
7bb19d16.description:
**Experience:** 
 6 Months – 1 Year
   

  

**Location:** 
 Indore, Madhya Pradesh
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
   

  

**Notice Period:** 
 15–30 Days Preferred
   

  

**About GrowwStacks**
 GrowwStacks Automation Solutions specializes in business process automation, IT automation, low\-code/no\-code solutions, RPA, AI, and workflow automation. We help businesses improve efficiency and streamline operations through technology\-driven solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an
 **IT Client Solutions Executive** 
 to manage client interactions from
 **qualified lead to proposal closure and project handover** 
 .
   

  

 This is a
 **client\-focused role and not a lead\-generation position** 
 . The candidate will work with qualified leads provided by the company, understand client requirements, conduct discovery calls, coordinate with the technical team to identify suitable solutions, prepare proposals, manage client follow\-ups, and support a smooth transition from pre\-sales to delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a client\-first approach, strong coordination abilities, and the willingness to learn and understand new IT solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Connect with qualified leads and manage initial client communication.
* Conduct discovery calls to understand client requirements, business processes, challenges, and expectations.
* Gather and document client requirements accurately.
* Understand GrowwStacks' services and identify suitable solutions based on client requirements.
* Coordinate with developers and project managers to validate technical feasibility and solution approach.
* Prepare and coordinate project proposals including scope, deliverables, timelines, and commercials.
* Present and explain proposed solutions to clients in a clear and professional manner.
* Handle client queries and coordinate internally to provide appropriate responses.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with clients regarding proposals, feedback, revisions, and next steps.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients throughout the pre\-sales process.
* Coordinate the handover from client discussions to the technical/delivery team with complete requirements and project details.
* Stay involved after handover whenever required to ensure smooth communication between the client and internal teams.
* Maintain proper records of requirements, proposals, client communication, and follow\-ups.


**Requirements**
* Graduate in a technical discipline such as B.Tech, B.E., MCA, M.Tech, or equivalent.
* 6 Months – 1 Year of relevant experience in IT client servicing, pre\-sales, business analysis, solution consulting, project coordination, or IT services.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident in handling client calls and requirement discussions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
* Basic understanding of IT services and willingness to learn automation, AI, RPA, and related technologies.
* Good proposal preparation, follow\-up, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with both clients and technical teams.
* Proactive, organized, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a client\-facing environment.
* Candidates must be based in Indore.
* Candidates with a 15–30 day notice period will be preferred.

21e1b817.title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
21e1b817.description:
**Description**
 Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real\-world healthcare challenges, and launching data\-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
   

  

 15\+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
   

  

 Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
   

  

 Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C\+\+, JAVA, C\#, etc)
   

  

 Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
   

  

 Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
   

  

 Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
   

  

 English proficiency at Advanced level.
   

  

 Good presentation and demonstration skills
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
   

  

 Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
   

  

 Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
   

  

 Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility \& value.
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare\-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
   

  

 Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
   

  

 Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

eb024a40.title: Software Architect
eb024a40.description:
**Position: Software Architect**
--------------------------------


Software Architect will lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable network automation systems. The role requires deep experience in developing automation frameworks driving standardization and integrating best practises across CI/CD environments. The architect will be responsible for building core automation capabilities, defining architecture patterns, and collaborating with platform teams to deliver enterprise\-grade automation aligned with business and technology strategy.

  




### **RESPONSIBILITIES\***


#### **Strategy\***


* Define the target automation architecture and roadmap in line with enterprise goals and emerging technology trends.Drive simplification and standardisation across platforms through reusable and scalable automation solutions.
* Evaluate and propose strategic automation solutions that align with long\-term technology and business objectives.

#### **Business\***


* Translate business and operational needs into technical automation requirements and designs.
* Enable accelerated delivery of network services and capabilities by reducing manual effort and improving reliability.
* Ensure automation solutions align with operational priorities and business outcomes.

#### **Processes\***


* Champion CI/CD strategies, GitOps Practices and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) across using ADO, Python, Ansible, Open Policy Agent and containerisation.
* Define and enforce standards for automation development (e.g. coding best practices, SDLC)
* Support templating, modularization, and version control of automation scripts and playbooks.
* Ensure consistent and governed automation delivery across all deployment environments.

#### **People \& Talent\***


* Mentor developers and engineers in automation design, implementation, and tooling.
* Promote a DevOps and automation\-first mindset across network engineering and platform teams.
* Support skill\-building efforts through documentation, training, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.

#### **Risk Management\***


* Address technical debt and ensure automation architecture meets security and compliance requirements.
* Mitigate risks through controlled deployment, testing, and rollback strategies.
* Embed secure development practises in the automation lifecycle.

#### **Governance\***


* Establish automation design principles and documentation standards to ensure traceability and auditability.
* Define governance frameworks for managing automation pipelines, scripts, and configuration.
* Work closely with platform and security teams to enforce architectural standards and regulatory compliance.

#### **Location****–****Bangalore \& Chennai**


Email : careers@intuitorit.com

7f25aaa5.title: Forward Deployed AI Architect
7f25aaa5.description:
BOTS.AI (HR Anexi) · Mumbai, Andheri West · Full\-time, on\-site
 



**About BOTS.AI** 




 BOTS.AI is the AI deployment wing of HR Anexi, built on 19\+ years of working inside Indian organisations. We don't ship demos. We build agents that do the work every day, in production: chasing collections, reconciling invoices, booking dealer orders and closing out plant analytics. Our clients range from family\-run businesses to listed companies and global multinationals, across consumer retail, financial services, agri\-commodities, and diamonds and jewellery. Every deployment is a new environment and a new problem, and what we learn in one becomes the starting point for the next.
 



**The problem** 




 India's largest family\-run businesses are ready for AI. Their systems are not. Critical processes live in WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and the experience of a few senior managers. Technology companies build models and advisory firms build strategies, but very few build working systems inside that reality. That is the work we do.
 



**The role** 




 The Forward Deployed AI Architect is responsible for turning a client's workflow into a system that runs reliably in production, and for proving the value it creates. You design the architecture and you build it. On every engagement you work alongside our Principal, AI Transformation, who owns the client relationship, the commercials and adoption. You own the design, the build and the evidence that it works.
 



**What an engagement involves** 



* **Discovery.** 
 Working directly with finance, HR, sales or plant teams to understand how work actually moves, and deciding what should be automated, what should use an existing tool, and what should remain with people.
* **Build.** 
 Designing and building the system, including its integration with the client's existing software, its safeguards and its monitoring.
* **Proof.** 
 Measuring accuracy, speed, cost and usage, and presenting the results in a form a CFO can use to decide whether to scale.
* **Compounding.** 
 Converting each successful deployment into a reusable design, and turning repeated client problems into agents BOTS.AI builds and sells as its own products.



**The standard we hire to** 




 We do not require years of experience in AI. The field is too young for that to be a meaningful measure. We require evidence of what you have already done. The strongest candidates will be able to show that they have:
 


* **Owned a system in production that other people depended on,** 
 in any discipline (software, data, cloud, infrastructure or enterprise systems), and been accountable when it failed.
* **Built something with AI on their own initiative:** 
 a tool, an agent, an automation or a competition entry, created because they wanted to understand the technology, not because a role required it.
* **Measured their work in business terms,** 
 such as cost reduced, time saved, errors eliminated or adoption achieved.
* **Explained a technical decision to a non\-technical decision\-maker** 
 and seen it adopted.
* **Taught, documented or mentored** 
 in a way that made others more capable.



 Candidates typically bring 5–10 years of experience. Our own architects have come from backgrounds such as DevOps and site reliability engineering. What matters is the evidence above, not the title you held.
 



  





**What you will become here** 




 Within your first year, you will have designed and delivered production AI systems across several industries, built reference architectures used on engagements you were not part of, and contributed directly to the products BOTS.AI takes to market. Few roles in India offer this range of real deployment experience this early in the field's development.
 



  





**This role is not suited to candidates who** 



* Require a complete specification before engaging with a problem
* Consider a working demonstration to be a finished result
* Prefer presenting to leadership over working alongside operational teams



  





**Selection process** 



1. **Application.** 
 Your CV and a short written note covering two things: one system you owned in production (what it did, what went wrong, and what you changed), and one thing you built with AI on your own initiative (why you built it and what you learned).
2. **Conversation with founder's office** 
 (30 minutes).
3. **Work sample.** 
 We share an anonymised client workflow or a problem statement. You submit a one\-page design and discuss it with us in a 45\-minute session. (Subjective)
4. **Team conversation.**



 We aim to complete the process within 2 weeks.

df111201.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Azure Data Architect - Manager
df111201.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Manager – Azure Data Architect**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

aaf08547.title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
aaf08547.description:
**Description**
 Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real\-world healthcare challenges, and launching data\-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
   

  

 15\+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
   

  

 Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
   

  

 Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C\+\+, JAVA, C\#, etc)
   

  

 Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
   

  

 Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
   

  

 Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
   

  

 English proficiency at Advanced level.
   

  

 Good presentation and demonstration skills
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
   

  

 Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
   

  

 Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
   

  

 Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility \& value.
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare\-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
   

  

 Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
   

  

 Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

d9798685.description:
**Department:** 
 Infor Consulting Services
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Description**
 We are seeking a techno\-functional WFM Consultant with 3\+ years of experience in the Infor Workforce Management (WFM) suite. The ideal candidate will have expertise in implementing, enhancing, and supporting Infor WFM solutions, with strong functional and technical knowledge to effectively address business requirements primarily for customers in AMER region which requires working in night shift.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**
 As a Senior WFM Consultant for IMS, the candidate will be required to perform the following:
   

  

* Collaborate as a core member of the IMS WFM team, working closely with customers, business stakeholders, and Infor team members across various functions and levels.
* Leverage and enhance techno\-functional expertise in the Infor WFM suite and related third\-party technologies to support application configuration, customization, enhancements, and user enablement initiatives.
* Drive end\-to\-end delivery of Infor WFM enhancements and customizations, with primary focus on:


 Multi\-Viewer Scheduler (MVS) for advanced workforce scheduling and operational visibility.
   

  

 Time \& Attendance for workforce time management, compliance, and pay rule administration.
   

  

 Labor Forecasting and Budgeting (LFSO) for demand\-based planning and labour optimization.
   

  

* Analyse customer business requirements and objectives, translating them into effective functional and technical solutions that align with business needs.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution support for complex application, configuration, and integration challenges.
* Guide customers in effectively utilizing Infor WFM tools and capabilities to maximize operational efficiency and business value.
* Support implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-production activities to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Mentor and support junior consultants by sharing knowledge, promoting best practices, and assisting with solution design and problem resolution.
* Create and maintain high\-quality documentation, knowledge articles, training materials, and change management artifacts.
* Participate in on\-call, standby, and off\-hours support activities as required to support business\-critical operations


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ss years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM) solutions, with hands\-on experience in implementation, enhancement, and support activities.
* Strong techno\-functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in developing custom solutions using Java/J2EE, Groovy Scripting, APIs, Web Services (REST/SOAP), JavaScript.
* Experience in configuring, customizing, and supporting Infor WFM applications to meet business requirements.
* Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting.
* Experience developing and supporting reports and dashboards using IBM Cognos or similar reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of workforce management concepts, scheduling practices, labor compliance, and timekeeping processes.
* Experience in requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex functional and technical issues and provide effective solutions.
* Familiarity with system integrations, APIs, data interfaces, and batch processing.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience working directly with customers and stakeholders in a consulting or support environment.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within global, cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to participate in on\-call or off\-hours support as required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Responsible for supporting IMS customers from AMER Region.

11599442.description:
**Job Description**
**Oracle Cloud Financial Modules:**
* Accounting Hub
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Cash Management
* Expense Management
* Fixed Assets
* General Ledger
* Oracle Fusion Tax


 Related capabilities may include Intercompany Accounting, Subledger Accounting, Financial Reporting, Enterprise Structures, security, approval workflows, integrations, and period\-close processes.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 Argano is seeking a Principal Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Consultant to join our Managed Services practice. This client\-facing role provides ongoing functional support and advisory services across the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials suite. The consultant will own incidents, service requests, minor enhancements, quarterly update readiness, functional configuration, testing, and process optimization while working within agreed service levels and client priorities. The ideal candidate combines deep Oracle Fusion Financials expertise with strong knowledge of finance business processes and a proactive commitment to client success, system stability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 The Argano Managed Services division is unlike other managed services groups. We specialize in helping our clients transform their processes and enhance the end\-user experience. Creativity, teamwork, and loyalty are core principles that guide our daily actions. We have a unique corporate culture unlike any other firm in our business\-\-one that promotes healthy balance, respect, focus, friendship, and ongoing education. There are few firms in this industry that have a near zero employee turnover rate. We do. And it is something from which our clients benefit, and our employees celebrate. If you want to be part of an elite team where excellence is a way of life, join Argano.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Using in\-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud Financial Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consult with clients to provide cost\-effective solutions to solve business issues.
* Provide high\-quality client support by triaging and owning incidents and service requests through resolution, gathering complete business and system information, communicating status and risks, and meeting agreed service\-level targets.
* Troubleshoot client issues through functional analysis, configuration review, data validation, log and process review, replication, root\-cause analysis, and regression testing. When vendor assistance is required, open and manage Oracle Service Requests, provide actionable evidence, and drive issues to resolution.
* Manage Oracle service requests through resolution, including diagnostics, follow\-ups, validation, and status updates.
* Lead Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update readiness activities, including reviewing new and deprecated features, assessing client impact, recommending opt\-in functionality, coordinating configuration changes, preparing test scenarios, supporting regression and user acceptance testing, documenting outcomes, and delivering end\-user enablement.
* Proactively contribute to the overall support process by suggesting \& executing new process efficiencies, documenting common support issues and workarounds, to minimize the number of future support requests.
* Refine client requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval.
* Identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving system issues.
* Participate in team training activities to keep current with Oracle Cloud functionality.


**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD (technical accounting, management system, Business Admin, etc.) expected.


**Required Skills**
* Minimum 8–10 years of Oracle Financials functional consulting experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation or production support experience. Experience supporting multiple clients or complex environments in a managed services model is strongly preferred.
* Preferred to be a CPA/CA equivalent with an in\-depth understanding of finance business processes.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze Oracle Fusion Financials configurations, accounting rules, workflows, security roles, scheduled processes, reports, data loads, and integration touchpoints sufficiently to diagnose issues and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to independently research, reproduce, test, configure, and resolve client issues within agreed priorities and service levels while documenting root cause, resolution steps, testing evidence, and client communication.
* Ability to open, track, and manage Oracle Service Requests, including selecting appropriate severity, providing reproducible evidence, coordinating client actions, escalating when necessary, and validating Oracle\-provided solutions before closure.
* Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements and solving day\-to\-day issues.
* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Prior experience leading or managing projects.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external clients.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

3bbe7c0e.description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. A consultant in Argano Managed Services is an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM professional responsible for sustaining, optimizing, and continuously improving clients’ production environments after go\-live. The consultant manages a portfolio of client priorities, provides functional and technical leadership, and guides incident resolution, service requests, enhancements, and process improvements. Working collaboratively with client stakeholders, the Consultant helps protect operational stability, increase adoption, and deliver measurable business value. The role also mentors other consultants, contributes to reusable practices, and supports strong client satisfaction and long\-term account success.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Argano Managed Services helps clients sustain, optimize, and continuously improve their Oracle Cloud environments after go\-live. Our consultants combine functional expertise, collaborative problem\-solving, and proactive client service to improve business processes and the end\-user experience. We value creativity, teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and a healthy, respectful workplace.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle Cloud EPM Planning
* Manage multiple client workstreams and service priorities concurrently, balancing incidents, service requests, enhancements, recurring activities, and planned initiatives against agreed priorities and service commitments.
* Act as a functional expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision.
* Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. Keep all parties informed about progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand evolving business objectives, operational challenges, and Oracle EPM needs. Assess existing configurations, usage patterns, recurring issues, and business processes to identify opportunities to stabilize, automate, optimize, and improve user adoption.
* Maintain current knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM monthly updates and relevant Oracle roadmap developments. Assess client impact, communicate recommendations, and identify opportunities for optimization and innovation.


**Education**
 MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience, including significant experience supporting and enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud environments after go\-live, with prior full\-lifecycle implementation experience preferred to demonstrate a strong understanding of application design and downstream impacts.
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required.
* Hands\-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, configuring, or enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud modules such as Workforce, Capital, Projects, Profitability and Cost Management, or Strategic Modeling.
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills preferred
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Oracle EPM Data Exchange or Data Management, including troubleshooting data and metadata loads, mappings, integrations, validation failures, and recurring load processes.
* Experience with EDM a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Professional services experience in an Oracle Cloud EPM Managed Services, application support, or production\-operations role is strongly preferred; experience advising client stakeholders at a strategic level is also beneficial.
* In\-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.


 SKILL REQUIREMENTS
   

  

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Service Delivery Management: Prioritize and coordinate concurrent client needs across incidents, requests, recurring operations, and enhancements while maintaining clear ownership, realistic commitments, accurate status, and alignment with service levels.
* Continuous Improvement: Translate recurring issues, service trends, Oracle Cloud updates, and industry practices into practical recommendations that improve stability, efficiency, controls, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Strong commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Strong degree of initiative, accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.


**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
   

  

 Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
