7814b1ec.title: Delivery Manager
7814b1ec.description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

****Lyzr, in a minute****
**Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.**
**Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This role shapes that decision.**
****The role****
**Lyzr’s largest enterprise deals are won on business cases, not feature lists. As Solution Architect \- Pre\-sales , you will partner with our sales and solution teams on major enterprise opportunities — building the value case, quantifying business impact, and working directly with CFOs, COOs, and other business leaders to shape how AI agents fit their strategy. You will carry real influence over enterprise strategy, go\-to\-market, and how customers structure delivery and cost around AI.**
* Team: Presales
* Level: Senior
* Work mode: Hybrid


****What will make you win this role****
**These are the core requirements — the substance of the job.**
* 8\+ years of strong business solutioning background. You turn a customer’s business problem into a structured, quantified solution narrative.
* Executive\-level communication. You have worked with and reported to CTOs/ CIOs and business leaders and you are credible in that room.
* Value engineering and business transformation. Value generation, business consulting, and transformation work are your core toolkit, not adjacent skills.
* Strategy and go\-to\-market shaping. You have contributed to enterprise strategy, investor communications, and go\-to\-market decisions.
* Delivery and cost optimisation. You have optimised cross\-functional delivery and cost structures, and can bring that lens to customer conversations.


****Life at Lyzr****
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


**Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers and partner teams, mapping use cases to Lyzr Solutions
   

  

 Design reference architectures for customer VPC, multi\-cloud and air\-gapped on\-prem deployments, including integration with existing data, identity and security stacks.**
**Build and deliver tailored demos and scoped POCs that prove value within a fixed timeline.**
**Own the technical response on RFPs, security questionnaires and architecture reviews**

de66ca31.title: Technical Program Manager
de66ca31.description:
**Who are we?**  

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.  

In this role, you will own and drive strategic technical programs assigned by the Engineering organization. Program assignments will shift over time based on where the business requires delivery leadership — you may lead a single large, multi\-quarter initiative or a portfolio of smaller related efforts. In all cases, the programs you own will be funded, executive\-sponsored initiatives that advance our technology strategy, architectural direction, and/or company strategic plan. You will be expected to ramp quickly on new domains, establish the operating cadence and reporting for the programs you inherit, and transition mature programs into a sustainable business\-as\-usual state.
### **How will you contribute?**


**How will you contribute?**


* Understands the system architecture within program domain. Knows how to make sure dependencies are not broken by development changes and that program systems are not broken by upstream changes.
* Able to consider the larger picture (e.g., efficiency, availability, operability, scalability, business goals, customer experience, etc.) and balance it against the needs of engineering teams who have to build, maintain and extend features for the life of the technology. Incorporates these requirements into project plans.
* See's patterns and discovers solutions; makes connections to improve project/process efficiency. Knows what solutions exist elsewhere and how they can be connected.
* Can convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering team(s) (Q. Why did we build X? What business goal does it solve?).
* Knows how to assess engineering practices for testing, triage and maintenance and work with manager(s) to establish the right methods for effective project delivery.
* Multi\-disciplinary organizational skills with strong people and conflict management abilities.
* Analytical, design, problem solving skills towards customer success.
* Communication and collaboration skills.
### **What will you bring?**


* As part of your project and program ownership, you know the larger business picture (i.e., customer experience, organization goals, opportunities, and/or problems) and you deeply understand the technical requirements of the solutions being built (i.e., architecture, dependency impacts, efficiency, performance, availability, operability, etc.).
* You also take the time to understand the needs of engineers (who have to build, maintain, and extend features for the life of the system) to make appropriate trade\-offs.
* You remove blockers and impediments that impact the team. Organize the team to provide productive, consistent and steady output.
* You partner effectively with technical managers to secure resources, scope engineering efforts, set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery.
* You provide status reporting to senior leadership and C\-staff on your program.
* You help teams determine where to iterate to make improvements.
* You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them.
* Bachelors/Masters or equivalent.
**About our culture**  

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

Technical bachelor s degree (e.g. computer science, IS, engineering, math, etc.) or a non\-technical bachelor s degree (e.g. Business)

e831608e.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
e831608e.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

cad0349f.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Power Platform
cad0349f.description:
**Overview**
**Overview**
**Be a trusted advisor for Generative AI and Modern Work** 
 : Translate customer challenges into high\-value solutions using M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. Drive ROI\-focused scenarios that accelerate productivity, automation, and decision\-making.
   

  

* Drive Customer Success across Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform: Lead design and implementation of integrated solutions, covering prompt engineering, copilots/agents lifecycle, Power Platform connectors, data access, and environment strategy.
* Scale AI and low\-code solutions through Agentic AI and automation: Apply Copilot Studio and Power Platform capabilities (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) to help customers build secure, scalable, governed AI agents and workflows.
* Champion adoption, change management, and business value realization: Engage with business leaders, IT, and security teams to enable widespread usage, demonstrate value, and secure long\-term success and renewal.
* Evangelize best practices and reusable IP: Contribute to communities, internal assets, repeatable frameworks, and technical accelerators to drive consistent and scalable customer outcomes.
* Embrace a learn\-it\-all mindset: Maintain deep technical readiness in M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, M365 administration, and modern AI architecture aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU) priorities and corporate initiatives.


**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
 Business Impact
   

  

 Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking). Collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on\-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction. Proactively manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures. Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.
   

  

 Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., product offerings such as value\-based deliverables \[VBDs], advice, training, technical validation), ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed to prepare customers for operational readiness and achievement of their business goals and targets. Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long\-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage. Guides customers/partners towards a well\-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence \[AI]\-enabled), and cost\- and performance\-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities. Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.
   

  

 Proactively identifies new opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation. Actively listens to and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements. Identifies, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps existing architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes. Proactively captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.
   

  

 Proactively identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption. Applies business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries and leverages them to develop strategic and actionable insights. Presents business cases to program managers to influence product roadmaps, decision making, bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product \[MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings. Proactively helps the customer/partner adopt and use Microsoft product/platform strategy\-aligned (cross\-solution area) solutions. Builds relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs), and helps build the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs). Independently interacts as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and other C\-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.
   

  

 Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Defines customer/partner conditions of success by leveraging an understanding of customer goals. Anticipates and addresses customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.
   

  

 Partner Specialization
   

  

 Identifies and prioritizes several opportunities that align with revenue goals, and orchestrates growth of solution utilization pipeline with partners. Provides assistance with partner and sales teams to bring clarity to specific opportunities through proof of concept and technical pre\-sales support.
   

  

 Understands solution area\-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) business stakeholders to lead and execute initiatives to translate opportunities into actions. Proactively guides and supports partners in developing repeatable offerings, practices, products, and solutions. Advises the partner throughout initial strategic customer implementations.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up\-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand. Role models technical readiness, both depth\-aligned to solution area priorities and breadth\-aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU)/corporate initiatives (e.g., security, resilience, AI), and influences team to drive their own technical readiness. Acts as a mentor, leading readiness and upskilling activities in the team/organization by educating colleagues on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing proven practices.
   

  

 Proactively identifies gaps through delivery, communicates those gaps to relevant team members and internal/external stakeholders, and connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas that drive changes and improvements to products, IP (both existing and new), technologies, and/or processes/practices that enable solutions to scale across customers. Contributes to the development and modification of Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies. Provides thought leadership and innovation to customers/partners and internal communities at the local level.
   

  

 Contributes to leading virtual teams (v\-teams) around technologies and customer/partner challenges, and shares ideas, insights, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape. Demonstrates strong industry knowledge and increases recognition for Microsoft solutions by contributing to and sometimes leading presentations and engagements with external and internal audiences (e.g., Tech Connect, Build, Ignite) Contributes to intellectual property (IP) and identifies patterns where no IP exists (e.g., CoPilot and AI scenarios) to help build scalable and repeatable models. Participates in external technical and non\-technical community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) that elevate the Microsoft brand and shares learnings across internal teams.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
**Required/minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.
   

  

 4\+ years experience working in a customer\-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external).
   

  

 4\+ years experience working on technical projects on Power Platform, Copilot Studio and similar technologies
   

  

 Technical Certification in Cloud Power Platform, Copilot Studio and similar technologies
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about

Date: Sep 5, 2026
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500032
   

  

 Functional Area: Remote
   

  

 Syntax is a leading Managed Cloud Provider for Mission Critical Enterprise Applications and has been providing comprehensive technology solutions to businesses of all sizes since 1972\. Syntax has undisputed strength to implement and manage ERP deployments (Oracle, SAP) in a secure and resilient private, public or hybrid cloud. With strong technical and functional consulting services, and world\-class monitoring and automation, Syntax serves some of North America’s largest corporations across a diverse range of industries. Syntax has offices worldwide, and partners with Oracle, SAP, AWS, Microsoft, IBM and other global technology leaders.
   

  

 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Experience: 12\+years
   

  

 Skills: SAP SD, MM, S4Hana Migration
   

  

 Location: Remote\-India
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 SAP SD/MM Solution Architect – Conversion Programs
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The SAP SD/MM Solution Architect will play a key role in SAP S/4HANA conversion and transformation programs, including Brownfield conversions, Selective/Purplefield transformations, CVI implementations, and system upgrade projects. The role requires a highly experienced functional architect who can understand complex business requirements, design scalable SAP solutions, and guide project teams to ensure successful delivery.
   

  

 The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, technical teams, and functional consultants to ensure that solutions are aligned with SAP best practices and client objectives while maintaining delivery quality and efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Act as the Solution Architect for SAP SD and MM modules in S/4HANA conversion, transformation, and upgrade programs.
* Analyze client business requirements and existing SAP landscapes to design effective and scalable solutions aligned with SAP best practices.
* Lead solution design discussions and ensure end‑to‑end integration across modules such as FI, CO, EWM, TM, PP, and other integrated processes.
* Provide architectural guidance on conversion strategies including Brownfield, Purplefield/Selective transformation, CVI implementation, and system upgrades.


**Delivery Leadership**
* Provide functional and architectural leadership to SD/MM consultants during project execution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex functional queries, providing guidance and clarity to consultants during implementation.
* Support the team in resolving design challenges, configuration issues, and integration complexities.
* Ensure deliverables meet project quality standards, timelines, and client expectations.


**Effort Estimation \& Planning**
* Assess requirements and forecast the time, effort, and resource needs required to deliver solutions effectively.
* Support project planning by contributing to effort estimations, solution proposals, and staffing requirements.
* Work closely with project management and delivery leadership to ensure optimal resource utilization.


**Hands‑On Functional Support**
* Step in as an SD/MM functional consultant when necessary to address resource gaps or support critical project activities.
* Contribute to configuration, testing, issue resolution, and functional validation when required to ensure project continuity.


**Stakeholder \& Client Engagement**
* Engage proactively with business stakeholders, project teams, and leadership to ensure alignment on requirements and solutions.
* Demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills in client discussions, workshops, and solution reviews.
* Build trusted client relationships by providing practical, well‑structured, and value‑driven solutions.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Act as a mentor and guide for functional consultants, supporting their growth and helping them resolve challenges during project delivery.
* Demonstrate the qualities of an intermittent leader by proactively driving discussions, guiding decision making, and supporting the team when needed.


**Process Improvement \& Internal Initiatives**
* Contribute to internal initiatives, accelerators, and proof‑of‑value (POV) solutions that improve delivery efficiency and service offerings.
* Work on process optimization initiatives aimed at enhancing internal delivery models and expanding service capabilities for clients.
* Support the development of best practices, reusable assets, and solution frameworks for the conversion practice.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 12\+ years of SAP experience with strong expertise in SAP SD and MM modules.
* Proven experience working as a Solution Architect or Senior Functional Lead in SAP projects.
* Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA conversion programs, including Brownfield, Purplefield/Selective Transformation, CVI implementations, and system upgrades.
* Deep understanding of Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) and Procure‑to‑Pay (P2P) business processes.
* Experience working with cross‑module integrations including FI, CO, PP, EWM, TM, and other SAP modules.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Strong experience in solution design, effort estimation, and resource planning.
* Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and decision‑making capabilities.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong architectural thinking and solution design capability
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Proactive mindset and leadership orientation
* Ability to mentor teams and guide consultants through complex implementations
* Strong client engagement and relationship management skills


**Additional Responsibilities**
 The responsibilities listed above represent the core scope of the role. In addition, the architect will be expected to support other minor responsibilities and organizational initiatives as needed to ensure successful project delivery, continuous improvement, and the overall growth of the practice
   

  

**Why Syntax?**
 Become a part of our success story and work in a company with exciting innovation projects that are causing a stir across the industry. We recently launched one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities based on SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Digital Manufacturing Cloud for Execution \- for Smart Press Shop, a pioneering joint venture between Porsche and forming specialist Schuler.
   

  

* Competitive, above\-average compensation
* Global tourist: With us, you can also work from abroad from time to time
* Flexible working time models, home office
* Attractive benefits, e.g. company pension scheme or various health offers
* A modern environment in which the "you" is part of it
* Open feedback culture, flat hierarchies and a motivated team
* Individual career planning with continuous training and coaching on the job


 You see a personal challenge in this responsible task? Apply now \- and become part of the SYNTAX team!

c39993cb.title: Transformation Program Manager
c39993cb.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


**Your Role**
-------------


The role owns the end\-to\-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go\-live sign\-off.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* **Stakeholder leadership and CXO communication**: operate as the single point of confidence for the CEO/CXO group. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection.
* **Program shaping and value ownership –** convert leadership intent into a sequenced roadmap, funding envelope and defensible business case; stay accountable for benefit realisation well beyond deployment
* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A****doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised
* A program taken through serious trouble – a failing vendor, slipped go\-live, funding freeze or organised pushback – with a candid account of the recovery
**What you will love about working here**
-----------------------------------------


* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

175734ef.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
175734ef.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

5e417996.title: Application DevOps & Modernisation Architect - VOIS
5e417996.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Application DevOps \& Modernisation Architect to lead large\-scale application discovery, assessment, migration and modernisation initiatives. You will collaborate with business owners, application owners and technical specialists to understand objectives, functional and non\-functional requirements, dependencies and constraints.
   

  

 You will define practical modernisation strategies, evaluate solution options and translate application needs into secure, scalable and resilient platform designs. The role requires extensive expertise across application architecture, DevOps, cloud platforms, containerisation, infrastructure as code and continuous delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead application discovery and assessment across architecture, integrations, dependencies, databases, infrastructure and operational requirements
* Facilitate discovery workshops, architecture reviews and technical discussions with business and technical stakeholders
* Capture business objectives, functional requirements, non\-functional requirements, constraints and expected outcomes
* Define application migration and modernisation strategies using approaches such as Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase
* Research and evaluate solution options, recommending effective development and implementation patterns with an open\-source\-first approach where appropriate
* Produce high\-level designs, low\-level designs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, dependency maps and technical recommendations
* Translate application requirements into platform requirements covering compute sizing, storage, connectivity, load balancing, DNS, databases, security, high availability, disaster recovery and observability
* Collaborate with platform, network, database, security and cloud architects to ensure infrastructure designs meet application requirements
* Support solution implementation, migration, technical troubleshooting and post\-migration stabilisation
* Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade\-offs and recommended next steps clearly to business and technical audiences
* Work independently across multiple technical workstreams while maintaining effective stakeholder collaboration


**Who You Are**
 Essential experience and capabilities
   

  

* At least eight years of relevant experience across application architecture, DevOps, cloud, migration and modernisation
* Strong experience in large\-scale application discovery and assessment
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements through discovery, option evaluation and recommendation
* Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Git and GitOps
* Extensive public cloud experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform
* Experience designing for networking, databases, identity and access management, security, secrets management, high availability, disaster recovery and observability
* Excellent communication, consulting, analytical and stakeholder\-management skills
* Strong problem\-solving capabilities and the ability to work independently across concurrent technical workstreams


 Desirable experience
   

  

* Understanding of application development using Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js or Python
* Experience with APIs, microservices and modern application integration patterns
* Hands\-on knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform and CI/CD tooling
* Experience with Amazon EKS, Azure AKS or Google GKE
* Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD
* Familiarity with evaluating open\-source technologies for maturity, scalability, security, supportability and licensing
* Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes or Terraform certifications


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* The opportunity to shape application migration and modernisation strategies for complex, large\-scale technology environments
* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, alongside Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and modern CI/CD practices
* Collaboration with specialists across application, platform, network, database, security and cloud architecture
* The opportunity to influence architecture decisions with broad organisational reach
* Experience solving complex technical challenges from initial discovery through migration and post\-migration stabilisation
* A role that combines technical leadership, consulting, stakeholder engagement and independent judgement


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced application portfolio discovery and assessment techniques
* Practical decision\-making across the Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase modernisation approaches
* Multi\-cloud architecture patterns across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform
* Container\-platform design using Kubernetes services such as EKS, AKS and GKE
* GitOps\-based delivery practices using tools such as Argo CD
* Cross\-domain architecture planning covering networking, databases, security, resilience and observability
* Evaluation of open\-source technologies based on scalability, maturity, security, licensing and operational support
* Communication of complex architecture decisions, risks and trade\-offs to varied stakeholder groups


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**Alert**
 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA
   

  

**Follow us on social media**
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/voisglobal
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

a804f478.title: Data Architect
a804f478.description:
About Trantor
 



  





 Trantor is a global technology services and engineering company specializing in delivering high\-impact Professional Services, Customer Success, and Engineering solutions for leading enterprise software companies. Our consultants partner with some of the world's most innovative technology organizations to help customers successfully deploy, adopt, and maximize the value of their platforms.
 



  





 We are looking for a highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our team. This is a customer\-facing consulting role where you will deploy and optimize enterprise database environments, implement AI\-powered solutions, and act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, configure, and optimize managed and self\-managed database clusters across cloud and on\-premises environments.
 



  





 You will also lead the implementation of AI\-powered conversational analytics solutions that transform plain\-English questions into precise SQL queries.
 



  





 This role combines technical implementation, architecture consulting, customer engagement, and AI adoption. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading executive discussions, conducting technical workshops, and performing hands\-on deployments.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Customer Deployment \& Implementation
 



 Deploy, configure, and optimize enterprise database environments for customers.
 



 Install, configure, and support self\-managed database clusters across cloud and on\-premises infrastructure.
 



 Perform cluster sizing, architecture design, upgrades, migrations, and production readiness assessments.
 



 Configure high availability, disaster recovery, backup, security, and performance optimization.
 



 Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, database, and deployment issues.
 



 AI Solution Implementation
 



 Deploy and configure AI\-powered analytics solutions for enterprise customers.
 



 Integrate AI solutions with customer datasets and enterprise workflows.
 



 Enable customers to leverage natural language queries and AI\-powered analytics.
 



 Validate AI outputs, optimize prompts, and support customer adoption.
 



 Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams by providing implementation feedback and product improvement recommendations.
 



 Technical Consulting
 



 Serve as the primary technical advisor during customer implementations.
 



 Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, and architecture reviews.
 



 Translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions.
 



 Recommend best practices for deployment, performance, scalability, and security.
 



 Produce high\-quality technical documentation and implementation guides.
 



 AI \& Automation
 



 Leverage AI tools to accelerate deployments, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
 



 Develop automation scripts to simplify repetitive deployment and operational tasks.
 



 Utilize modern AI coding assistants and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency.
 



 Stay current with advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and enterprise AI technologies.
 



 Customer Success
 



 Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.
 



 Drive successful implementations while ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
 



 Mentor customer teams through knowledge transfer sessions and operational best practices.
 



 Collaborate with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure seamless project handoffs.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 8\+ years of experience in Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Consulting.
 



 Experience deploying enterprise software solutions in customer environments.
 



 Experience with distributed SQL or relational databases such as PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, MySQL, or similar technologies.
 



 Database administration and performance tuning experience.
 



 Data ingestion and ETL pipelines.
 



 Monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog.
 



 Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible.
 



 CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
 



 Strong Linux system administration skills.
 



 Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
 



 Strong networking fundamentals, including DNS, TLS/SSL, firewalls, and load balancing.
 



 Experience with Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
 



 Familiarity with REST APIs and enterprise integrations.
 



 Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
