9288a56f.title: Project Manager / Delivery Lead
9288a56f.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an experienced Delivery Lead / Senior Project Manager to lead and manage the delivery operations across our Product and Software Engineering divisions. The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end delivery ownership, project planning and governance, customer engagement, resource management, quality, timelines, budgets, and successful execution of multiple projects. The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, Architecture, Business Development, HR, and senior leadership teams to ensure predictable and high\-quality project delivery. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in managing software/product engineering projects, leading cross\-functional technical teams, handling multiple customers/projects, and driving delivery excellence.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* 1\. Delivery \& Project Management
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple Product and Software Engineering projects.
* Define project objectives, scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, schedule, quality, and budget.
* Establish project governance, review mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting structures.
* Track project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and drive timely corrective actions.
* Manage project priorities and ensure effective allocation of technical resources.
* Drive Agile/Scrum or appropriate project delivery methodologies based on project requirements.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog management, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Monitor project KPIs, delivery metrics, productivity, utilization, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* 2\. Product \& Software Engineering Leadership
* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, Tech Leads, Developers, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.
* Provide delivery leadership across software/product development lifecycle.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical architecture, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Facilitate resolution of technical and operational blockers affecting project delivery.
* Ensure engineering teams follow defined development, testing, documentation, security, and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement in development and delivery processes.
* Support adoption of automation, DevOps, CI/CD, Agile practices, and engineering best practices.
* 3\. Customer \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as a senior point of contact for key customers and strategic accounts.
* Understand customer requirements, expectations, priorities, and business objectives.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate delivery status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Build strong and long\-term relationships with customers and stakeholders.
* Participate in customer meetings, requirement discussions, project kick\-offs, reviews, and steering committee meetings.
* Identify opportunities for expanding existing engagements in coordination with Business Development/Account Management teams.
* 4\. Resource \& People Management
* Plan and forecast manpower requirements based on project pipeline and business priorities.
* Ensure optimum utilization of engineering resources across Product and Software divisions.
* Work closely with HR and recruitment teams for hiring and onboarding requirements.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend appropriate training and development initiatives.
* Mentor Project Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and other delivery team members.
* Drive performance management and ensure clear ownership and accountability within teams.
* Develop a strong delivery leadership pipeline and succession plan.
* 5\. Project Financial \& Commercial Management
* Monitor project budgets, costs, resource utilization, and profitability.
* Work with Finance and Business teams on project billing, invoicing, milestones, and commercial commitments.
* Track project profitability and identify cost optimization opportunities.
* Support preparation of project estimates, resource plans, proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and commercial inputs.
* Ensure delivery commitments are aligned with contractual and commercial requirements.
* 6\. Risk, Quality \& Compliance
* Establish proactive project risk and issue management processes.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure mitigation plans are implemented.
* Identify delivery risks related to resources, technology, dependencies, scope, timelines, and customer commitments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational processes, information security requirements, and quality standards.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for major delivery issues.
* Ensure appropriate project documentation and audit readiness.
* 7\. Business \& Strategic Contribution
* Work with senior leadership to develop and execute delivery strategies for Product and Software Engineering.
* Contribute to annual and quarterly business planning.
* Support technology and capability development initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, automation, scalability, and margins.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, solution discussions, estimations, technical presentations, and customer proposals when required.
* Support new business opportunities by providing delivery feasibility, effort estimates, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Build delivery capabilities aligned with the organization's future product and technology roadmap.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* On\-time project delivery
* Project profitability and budget adherence
* Customer satisfaction and retention
* Resource utilization
* Project quality and defect levels
* Delivery productivity
* Schedule and milestone adherence
* Project risk and issue closure
* Employee retention and team engagement
* Successful project ramp\-up/ramp\-down
* Revenue and margin contribution
* Process improvement and automation initiatives
**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM or relevant project/program management qualification will be an advantage.
* 5–10\+ years of relevant experience in software/product engineering and project/program delivery.
* Strong experience managing multiple projects and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Proven experience in customer\-facing delivery management roles.
* Strong understanding of software/product development lifecycle.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, estimation, resource management, risk management, and delivery governance.
* Preferred Technical/Domain Exposure
* Experience in one or more of the following areas would be preferred:
* Product Engineering
* Embedded Software / Firmware
* IoT
* Cloud Applications
* Web \& Mobile Applications
* Enterprise Software
* API / Microservices
* DevOps \& CI/CD
* QA \& Test Automation
* System Integration
* Hardware–Software integrated products
* Desired Skills
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills
* Excellent customer and stakeholder management
* Strong project planning and execution capabilities
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills
* Business and commercial acumen
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced engineering environment
* Strong decision\-making and ownership mindset
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority
* Tools \& Methodologies
* Exposure to tools such as:
* Jira / Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* MS Project / Smartsheet
* Microsoft Teams
* Power BI / project dashboards
* Git / GitHub / GitLab
* CI/CD tools
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies is preferred.
* Ideal Candidate Profile
* The ideal candidate is a delivery\-focused technology leader who can operate at both strategic and execution levels. The person should be capable of managing customer expectations and business priorities while ensuring engineering teams have the right direction, resources, and support to deliver successfully.
* The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple projects, large cross\-functional teams, senior customers, project financials, escalations, and delivery governance, while continuously improving engineering and delivery processes.
* Key expectation: The role should not be limited to traditional project tracking. The incumbent will be expected to take overall ownership of Product and Software delivery, drive accountability across teams, and contribute to customer growth, operational efficiency, and business profitability.

3dc25409.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Search Platforms
3dc25409.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience leading technical program management initiatives and delivering infrastructure solutions.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of dedicated experience in a technical program manager role.
* Deep domain expertise in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, evaluation systems, or testing frameworks.
* Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI/ML capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to modernize Technical Program Manager (TPM) functions (e.g., automated dependency tracking, predictive risk modeling, and operational streamlining).
* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional alignment, managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, and prioritizing complex workstreams amidst ambiguity.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The Search Serving Infrastructure (SSI) team is at the heart of Google Search. Our mission is to provide a reliable, highly efficient, and performant serving framework that powers the Search ecosystem handling billions of queries a day. We address massive\-scale engineering challenges, from reducing latency and CPU/TPU capacity footprints to driving large\-scale architectural simplification efforts (like deprecating legacy monolithic servers in favor of modern, scalable services).
   

  

 In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Scope, shape, and lead large\-scale programs spanning multiple engineering tracks. Co\-develop strategies, goals, and success metrics for the broader organization.
* Perform technical assessments to evaluate engineering scope, establish milestones, define timeframes, and assess resourcing needs. Demonstrate technical judgment equivalent to a practicing Software Engineer in the infrastructure domain.
* Identify, anticipate, and manage risks, deliverables, and interdependencies across different Search Platforms and partner teams. Build mechanisms to optimize governance and information flow.
* Drive continuous optimizations in operational cadence, tooling, and communication, minimizing process friction while fostering development velocity and quality.
* Advocate alignment across disparate teams with differing objectives. Guide and influence cross\-functional peers, driving consensus for technical directions and prioritizing features against constraints.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to drive the strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale, cross\-functional programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and other org partners. In this role, you'll lead cross\-functional projects, and partner closely with engineering, product, data science, and design to deliver high\-impact initiatives that shape how LinkedIn members and enterprise customers experience career mobility.
   

  





 At the Staff level, you are expected to independently own ambiguous, complex programs, influence technical and product direction, and raise the bar for program management practices across the org.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  




* Lead and drive end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent, high\-complexity AI\-driven engineering programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and LinkedIn — from scoping and roadmap planning through launch and post\-launch measurement.
* Champion AI\-native program management by using AI/LLM\-based tools — for status synthesis, risk detection, meeting summarization, and roadmap drafting — to run leaner, faster program operations, and model this behavior for other TPMs in the org.
* Partner with engineering on AI system design trade\-offs — model selection, latency/cost/accuracy balance, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate those decisions into program risk and timeline impact.
* Own AI\-specific program rigor, including responsible\-AI review checkpoints, model evaluation and testing cycles, and compliance/privacy review gates that fall outside standard software launch checklists.
* Own the delivery of large, highly cross\-functional programs by developing detailed plans with clear milestones and goals, leveraging technical depth to identify and mitigate risks, resolve dependencies, remove impediments, and ensure timely, smooth launches.
* Partner with engineering leads, architects, and product leaders to identify technical dependencies, risks, and critical path, and drive resolution across teams.
* Define and own program operating rhythms: planning cadences, milestone tracking, cross\-team sync structures, and executive reporting.
* Drive bi\-annual roadmap and resource planning, and lead teams through execution of roadmaps, releases, and backlogs.
* Drive alignment across orgs and stakeholders on scope, priorities, timelines, and trade\-offs, and keep everyone informed on status, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Anticipate and proactively mitigate risks; surface gaps, unblock issues, and escalate blockers with clear, actionable recommendations.
* Foster a collaborative environment built on transparency, shared understanding, autonomy, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Coach and mentor others in modern technical program planning and execution best practices.
* Bring business\-strategy understanding and strong product intuition to program decisions.


**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  




* 6\+ years of full time technical program management experience within an engineering or technical team
* B.S degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4\+ years of hands\-on software engineering development experience



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* 8\+ years of full time technical program management experience
* Demonstrated success managing multiple major and concurrent projects/programs
* Demonstrated success driving the development program of world\-class online products
* Significant experience working with software engineering leadership, technical teams, individual contributors and external clients
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and adequate technical depth
* Ability to build collaborations and create a community of leadership
* Be a thought leader; someone who can help advance strategy and challenge others in the organization to make important improvements
* Demonstrated conflict resolution skills combined with strong negotiation ability delivered with a high level of influence and professionalism
* Agile coaching and practitioner experience (Scrum, Kanban) with multiple teams.
* Experience in managing all phases of end\-to\-end product development
* Knowledge of Internet client/server social networking applications and systems
* Hands\-on software development experience
* Experience working on ATS integrations



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* Program Management

a1577d4e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
a1577d4e.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What You’ll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of CCaaS\-wide programs: scoping, milestone planning, dependency and risk tracking, and crisp status reporting to senior leadership
* Drive cross\-team initiatives spanning product modules, platform and cloud engineering, security, and SRE, including alignment where teams have competing priorities on shared production infrastructure
* Run operational cadences: weekly reviews, incident and RCA follow\-through, action item closure, launch and rollout readiness
* Build lightweight utilities, scripts, and AI agents that pull data from source systems (Jira, cloud billing, monitoring, Git) to automate tracking, dashboards, and reporting
* Translate engineering detail into executive\-ready narratives: dollar impact, risk, and timelines
* Maintain a single source of truth for program state so progress and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
* 3\+ years in technical program management, or a mix of engineering and program roles, in cloud infrastructure, platform, or SaaS product environments
* Working knowledge of cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) fundamentals: compute and instance families, autoscaling, storage tiers, and cost levers; able to follow an infra design review or RCA discussion and ask the right questions
* Scripting ability (Python or similar) and comfort with APIs; you have built your own tools to collect data or automate reporting, not just configured off\-the\-shelf dashboards
* Strong stakeholder management: a track record of driving outcomes across teams you don't control, including navigating disagreement and escalating with judgment
* Structured tracking discipline: dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items don't fall through the cracks on your programs
* Clear written communication that works for both engineers and executives
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale distributed systems or real\-time data infrastructure
* Experience running FinOps or cloud cost\-optimization programs
* Experience applying LLM tooling or agents to workflow automation
* Background in contact center, CPaaS, or other real\-time communication platforms


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

c9d9a75d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
c9d9a75d.description:
**Aliases** 
**:** 
 Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
   

  

**About Truveta**
 Truveta is the world's first health provider\-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
   

  

**This opportunity**
 Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high\-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
   

  

 You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data\-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands\-off\-the\-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
   

  

**Who We Need**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross\-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data\-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
   

  

 You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow\-through.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 In this role you will:
   

  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post\-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data\-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data\-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root\-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross\-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade\-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post\-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.


**Required Qualifications**
 The experience requirement is 11\+ years in total, composed of 7\+ years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor technical role and 4\+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
   

  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade\-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 The following skill sets would be good to have:
   

  

* SQL or equivalent data\-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands\-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

**Who are we?**
 Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.
   

  

 In this role, you will own and drive strategic technical programs assigned by the Engineering organization. Program assignments will shift over time based on where the business requires delivery leadership — you may lead a single large, multi\-quarter initiative or a portfolio of smaller related efforts. In all cases, the programs you own will be funded, executive\-sponsored initiatives that advance our technology strategy, architectural direction, and/or company strategic plan. You will be expected to ramp quickly on new domains, establish the operating cadence and reporting for the programs you inherit, and transition mature programs into a sustainable business\-as\-usual state.
   

  

**How will you contribute?**
**How will you contribute?**
* Understands the system architecture within program domain. Knows how to make sure dependencies are not broken by development changes and that program systems are not broken by upstream changes.
* Able to consider the larger picture (e.g., efficiency, availability, operability, scalability, business goals, customer experience, etc.) and balance it against the needs of engineering teams who have to build, maintain and extend features for the life of the technology. Incorporates these requirements into project plans.

* Can convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering team(s) (Q. Why did we build X? What business goal does it solve?).
* Knows how to assess engineering practices for testing, triage and maintenance and work with manager(s) to establish the right methods for effective project delivery.
* Multi\-disciplinary organizational skills with strong people and conflict management abilities.
* Analytical, design, problem solving skills towards customer success.
* Communication and collaboration skills.


**What will you bring?**
* As part of your project and program ownership, you know the larger business picture (i.e., customer experience, organization goals, opportunities, and/or problems) and you deeply understand the technical requirements of the solutions being built (i.e., architecture, dependency impacts, efficiency, performance, availability, operability, etc.).
* You also take the time to understand the needs of engineers (who have to build, maintain, and extend features for the life of the system) to make appropriate trade\-offs.
* You remove blockers and impediments that impact the team. Organize the team to provide productive, consistent and steady output.
* You partner effectively with technical managers to secure resources, scope engineering efforts, set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery.
* You provide status reporting to senior leadership and C\-staff on your program.
* You help teams determine where to iterate to make improvements.
* You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them.
* Bachelors/Masters or equivalent.

 Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

421374db.description:
**Job Purpose:**  

Working with the companys Sales Team, the Presales Consultant is responsible for providing presales technical support to the Sales team and presenting tailored demonstrations or qualification discussions to customers and or prospects. The Presales Consultant also assists the Sales Team with qualifying opportunities – in or out and helping expand existing opportunities through solid questioning. The Presales Consultant will be responsible on conducting Technical Proof of Concept, Demonstration and Presentation on the supported products and solution.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Assist Account and Product Managers with qualification of opportunities by providing presales technical support. e.g. assist and support complicated brands and or take self\-ownership on simple brands.
* Provides pre\-sales technical support and deliver product demonstrations to customers and business partners.
* Assist senior to deliver training to partners on products solution.
* Contribute to and refine technical RFP and RFI responses.
* Support customer demonstrations and presentations
* Coordinating and managing technical validation events (POC)
* Coordinating and managing POC assets
* Solely or partnering with other Pre\-sales consultant to support PM setting regular BOM (Bill of Materials)
* Participating in conferences, shows, exhibitions when appropriate and requested.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**  

* 1 to 3 Years of relevant work experience is required.
* Required Education: Associate Degree in IT related programs
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to perform basic mathematical calculations.
* Able to communicate clearly and convey necessary information.
* Able to adjust readily to change and adapt as needed.
* Able to quickly learn/adapt to new systems and technology.

002f9dd0.title: Solution Architect - Presales
002f9dd0.description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
**Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.**
**Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This role shapes that decision.**
**The role**
**Lyzr’s largest enterprise deals are won on business cases, not feature lists. As Solution Architect \- Pre\-sales , you will partner with our sales and solution teams on major enterprise opportunities — building the value case, quantifying business impact, and working directly with CFOs, COOs, and other business leaders to shape how AI agents fit their strategy. You will carry real influence over enterprise strategy, go\-to\-market, and how customers structure delivery and cost around AI.**
* Team: Presales
* Level: Senior
* Work mode: Hybrid


**What Will Make You Win This Role**
**These are the core requirements — the substance of the job.**
* 8\+ years of strong business solutioning background. You turn a customer’s business problem into a structured, quantified solution narrative.
* Executive\-level communication. You have worked with and reported to CTOs/ CIOs and business leaders and you are credible in that room.
* Value engineering and business transformation. Value generation, business consulting, and transformation work are your core toolkit, not adjacent skills.
* Strategy and go\-to\-market shaping. You have contributed to enterprise strategy, investor communications, and go\-to\-market decisions.
* Delivery and cost optimisation. You have optimised cross\-functional delivery and cost structures, and can bring that lens to customer conversations.


**Life at Lyzr**
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


**Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers and partner teams, mapping use cases to Lyzr Solutions
   

  

 Design reference architectures for customer VPC, multi\-cloud and air\-gapped on\-prem deployments, including integration with existing data, identity and security stacks.**
**Build and deliver tailored demos and scoped POCs that prove value within a fixed timeline.**
**Own the technical response on RFPs, security questionnaires and architecture reviews**

**Desirable**

**Key Competencies:\-**

 Understands and anticipates customer needs; builds credibility in presales engagements.

 Able to connect prospect requirements to platform capability in a compelling way.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Works effectively across Sales, Practice, Product, and R\&D teams.
   

  

**Commercial Awareness**
 Understands the sales cycle and contributes actively to pipeline progression.
   

  

**Adaptability**
 Comfortable operating across multiple geographies, cultures, and prospect contexts.

 Sapiens International Corporation is a leading global provider of software solutions for the insurance industry. **Location: India (Remote)**

**Senior FP\&A Consultant**  

  

Limelight is a **fast\-growing FP\&A software company** transforming how finance teams plan, forecast, and report. We empower CFOs, controllers, and analysts with **dynamic, connected, and scalable financial models**—all in a platform that feels as familiar as Excel, but without the risks.


Our clients span industries and rely on us to simplify financial planning and unlock insights faster. Now, we’re looking for an **FP\&A Consultant** in **Mumbai** to help deliver those solutions

As a Senior FP\&A Consultant, you’ll work hand\-in\-hand with our **Project Managers** to design and deliver the financial models, templates, and reports our customers depend on. You’ll be more than an implementer—you’ll be a problem\-solver, a trusted advisor, and a partner in helping finance teams do their best work.


This is a **client\-facing, hands\-on role** where your finance knowledge, modeling skills, and knack for clean, intuitive design will shine.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Design and configure **financial models, planning templates, dashboards, and reports** that clients actually want to use.

* Support budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, allocations, and reporting requirements.
* Ensure projects stay on track—managing timelines, deliverables, and client expectations.
* Train finance teams, share best practices, and make sure they get value from Limelight.
* Partner with internal teams (Product, Success, Sales) to continuously improve outcomes for clients.

### **Qualifications:**

* **5\+ years’ experience** in FP\&A, financial consulting, or financial software implementation.
* Strong knowledge of **financial planning cycles** (budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, reporting).
* Advanced **Excel and financial modeling skills**—you know how to structure and present numbers that tell a story.
* Familiarity with tools like **NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Adaptive, Planful, or other FP\&A platforms** is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior finance leaders.
* A **problem\-solving mindset**—you don’t just deliver what’s asked, you suggest what’s needed.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to a **fast\-paced SaaS environment**.
* CPA, CFA, or PMP certification is a bonus.

### **You’ll Thrive at Limelight If You:**

* Love helping finance teams work smarter with better tools.
* Enjoy combining **finance, consulting, and technology** in your career.
* Take pride in seeing a project through from idea to impact.
* Want to be part of a modern SaaS company where your work directly helps customers succeed

At Limelight, you won’t just implement software—you’ll help finance teams transform how they work. You’ll be part of a growing company with the **best UI, best modeling, and best value** in the FP\&A space, and you’ll have the chance to grow your skills in consulting, finance, and technology.

203d4a3a.description:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.

* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
   

  

 As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre\-sales agreement shaping and post\-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long\-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise\-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code\-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real\-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer\-facing teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

8a805c46.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
8a805c46.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

* Develop rapid‑response models and scenario‑planning capabilities.

* Mentor and guide delivery teams on best practices and architectural standards.
* Ensure integration of Kinaxis with ERP, MES, and other enterprise systems.
* Drive continuous improvement and optimization of planning processes.

* Strong background in solution authoring and configuration management.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead cross‑functional delivery teams and mentor junior staff.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or related field (Master’s preferred).

**About Us**

 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.

e74ef81e.title: Solution Architect
e74ef81e.description:
**Company Description**
 Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
   

  

 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
   

  

 Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical\-first: you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical\-path features), while partnering with a global, cross\-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI\-powered development practices—including spec\-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI\-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Hands\-On)**
* Architecture \+ Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event\-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well\-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent\-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front\-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data\-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro\-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event\-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication \& Authorization: Implement end\-to\-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token\-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant\-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service\-to\-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.
* AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows—using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines—with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for regulated environments.
* Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices—spec\-driven workflows, AI\-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation—to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance.


**Patterns We Expect You to Use**
* Event\-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate)
* Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure\-mode design, consistency tradeoffs)
* Domain\-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti\-corruption layers)
* Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks.


**AI\-Enabled Delivery Expectations**
* Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support).
* Comfortable using a spec\-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices—spec\-driven development, AI\-assisted coding, and agent\-based automation—as standard ways of working.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope).
* Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross\-border considerations).
* Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud\-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI\-enabled features and agent\-based automation.
* Strong experience architecting Next.js and/or React applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience with event\-driven and distributed system design and production operations.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, spec\-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI\-assisted delivery workflows.
* Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns.
* Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates).
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics.
* Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus.
* Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e.g., using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks).
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.


**Additional Information**
* This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

913cabeb.title: Principal Technical Architect
913cabeb.description:
**About Workato**
 Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a
 **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles** 
 . We are driven by
 **innovation** 
 and looking for
 **team players** 
 who want to actively build our company.
   

  

 But, we also believe in
 **balancing productivity with self\-care** 
 . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.
   

  

 If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!
   

  

**Also, Feel Free To Check Out Why**
* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers


**About The Role**
 Workato is looking for a Principal Technical Architect, AI to join as a Field Specialist operating at the intersection of applied AI engineering and customer\-facing technical strategy. This is a dual\-mandate role with an approximately equal split:
   

  

**Mandate 1 – AI Field Specialist (Customer\-facing):** 
 You will work directly with enterprise customers and prospects in pre\-sales and post\-sales engagements to define and architect their AI strategies on Workato. This includes designing agentic automation solutions, advising on the latest approaches and best practices, scoping AI agent implementations, and helping customers move from proof\-of\-concept to production\-grade autonomous systems.
   

  

**Mandate 2 – Agentic CS Platform (Internal initiative):** 
 You will be a core architect and developer on Workato's autonomous Customer Success agent initiative, a production\-grade system that captures complete customer context to support reasoning, and compounds intelligence over time. You will own the agent and memory architecture, evals and learning loop, and autonomy framework that power this system.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who builds agentic systems to orchestrate LLMs into reliable, auditable, enterprise\-grade agent architectures, and who can articulate that vision to a customer CIO and technical leaders as fluently as they can implement it in code.
   

  

 Workato has a positive, diverse, and collaborative culture; we look for people who are curious, inventive, smart, hardworking, and who work to be a little better every day.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 AI Field Specialist
   

  

* Support as an expert AI architect in strategic enterprise engagements: roadmapping customer AI agent use cases and delivering technical deep\-dives that demonstrate Workato's agentic capabilities.
* Lead architecture workshops with enterprise customers to define their AI automation strategy, including agent design, integration patterns, and governance frameworks.
* Advise customers on applied AI best practices: prompt engineering and agent orchestration patterns, evaluation and testing strategies for agent systems, confidence calibration, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and continuous learning loops.
* Build reusable technical assets, such as reference architectures, solution blueprints, demonstration environments, and best\-practice documentation, that enable the broader field team to position AI solutions.
* Develop and deliver technical collateral: architecture white papers, webinars, blog posts, conference talks, etc. that establish Workato's thought leadership in agentic automation.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to feed field insights back into the platform roadmap, ensuring customer\-facing AI capabilities evolve based on real deployment patterns.
* Support global strategic accounts across the US, EMEA, and APAC geographies as needed for critical engagements.
* May require up to 20% global travel.


 Agentic CS Platform
   

  

* Architect and implement core subsystems of the autonomous CS agent platform, including memory layers, the agent orchestration layer, and the decision trace architecture.

510b96d7.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


**Your Role**
-------------

The role owns the end\-to\-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go\-live sign\-off.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*

* **Stakeholder leadership and CXO communication** : operate as the single point of confidence for the CEO/CXO group. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection .
* **Program shaping and value ownership –** convert leadership intent into a sequenced roadmap, funding envelope and defensible business case; stay accountable for benefit realisation well beyond deployment
* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A** **doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------

* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised
* A program taken through serious trouble – a failing vendor, slipped go\-live, funding freeze or organised pushback – with a candid account of the recovery
**What you will love about working here**
-----------------------------------------

* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs.  As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will work closely with our customers, build relationships with them, help them achieve their technical goals, and overcome technical challenges.The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Named Technical Contact**
* Serve as the dedicated technical resource for assigned customer accounts
* Partner with customer System Administrators to understand business processes, workflows, and system configurations
* Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55


**Product Expertise \& Consultation**
* Act as a product expert, providing guidance, best practices, and technical consultation
* Translate customer business needs into system configuration and optimization recommendations
* Support customers in understanding platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs


**Issue Facilitation \& Support Oversight**
* Provide oversight and coordination for customer support tickets
* Own or directly manage highly technical or complex issues as needed
* Effectively escalate critical and urgent issues, partnering with Support, Engineering, and Product teams to drive resolution
* Analyze support trends and proactively address recurring issues


**Readiness \& Enablement Management**
* Ensure customers are prepared for and leveraging new product features
* Conduct Release Readiness Reviews to prepare customers for upcoming releases, including testing, configuration changes, and process impacts
* Partner with customers to drive feature adoption aligned to their business goals


**Trusted Advisor \& Relationship Management**
* Run a regular cadence of customer meetings to review:
+ Open workstreams and initiatives
+ Support ticket status and analysis
+ New questions and technical needs
+ Open and prioritized issues
+ Action items and next steps

* Serve as a trusted consultant, ensuring alignment between customer goals and platform usage
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams


**You will do well in this role if you…**
* become a trusted advisor to customers, hyper\-focused on quality and successful adoption
* always strive to provide exceptional customer experience
* are technical\-focused with analytical and problem\-solving skills while able to describe technical configurations to non\-technical audiences
* build positive relationships with peers while working remotely with others across geographies and cultures
* listen continuously, learning from others and leveraging input
* possess unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character proactively demonstrating high moral and ethical behavior
* constantly improve your own work methods
* commit to the sustainability/scalability of Legion solutions
* work well as a self\-starter in a fluid work environment with limited resources
* are a career driven individual looking to grow in a fast paced startup


**Requirements and Qualifications**
* 3\+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Experience in managing multiple stakeholders and projects with competing priorities
* Strong root cause diagnostic capabilities to assess customer reported problems and determine whether it’s a software, configuration, or user error
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills including verbal, written presentation and listening
* Technical understanding of integration platforms such as Workato, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit,


 SnapLogic (Workato preferred)5
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**
* Workforce management (WFM) consulting and integration experience
* 3\+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Proven ability to manage changes for business growth minimizing disruption
* Experience in operating environments in retail, hospitality, restaurant or other industries to understand and identify labor challenges that Legion solves
* Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g. Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)


**ABOUT LEGION**
 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
   

  

 Our award\-winning AI\-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee\-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor\-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
   

  

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
   

  

**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig\-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
   

  

 For more information, visit https://legion.co
   

  

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**
 At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data.
   

  

 We strive to make competitive offers, allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
   

  

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch at Legion


**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

 The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. The role focuses on ensuring smooth reconciliation processes, resolving production issues, and supporting business users in financial close activities.
   

  

* Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle ARCS including Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules

* Coordinate with technical teams for system issues, enhancements, and integration fixes
* Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and issue resolution logs
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management)
* Support business users during financial close cycles and audit\-related activities

* Exposure to FDM / FDMEE / Data Management tools
* Understanding of reconciliation processes, financial close cycle, and reporting
