db7a57ad.title: Principal Program Manager
db7a57ad.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**

**Position:** Principal Program Manager— Level T4  

**Function:** Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development**. You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi\-team coordination:** Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* **Customer project ownership:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* **High\-stakes project leadership:** Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* **Structured planning:** Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* **Innovation facilitation:** Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including **AI\-assisted project management** (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* **Status reporting:** Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* **Team collaboration:** Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.

**Required Profile**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* **Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus** — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* **PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus** — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.

**What We Value**


You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

bef37080.title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
bef37080.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Strategic Mandate**
 As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership
   

  

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking


**Qualifications**
**Expertise \& Technology Stack**
* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking


**Additional Information**
**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

104684ee.title: Program Manager
104684ee.description:
**Overview**
**Program Manager – Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large\-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of program outcomes — balancing hands\-on delivery execution with strategic portfolio alignment across multiple concurrent engagements for internal stakeholders and external clients. The ideal candidate brings both program governance rigor and a
 **product engineering mindset** 
 — understanding the technical architecture underneath delivery, not just the schedule on top of it.
   

  

 Program Manager
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery across scope, schedule, cost, and quality — consistently meeting client satisfaction and business outcome targets.
* Establish and govern Agile/hybrid program frameworks, metrics, and tooling (Jira, executive dashboards, status reporting) across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Provide oversight across multi\-vendor, cross\-geography teams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and accountability.


**Product \& Technical Ownership**
* Apply a product development mindset to program delivery — thinking in terms of releases, technical debt, platform scalability, and long\-term maintainability rather than just milestone dates.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to understand system design trade\-offs (cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, integration architecture) well enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and risk calls.
* Own technical roadmap alignment — ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
* Drive quality engineering practices across programs — test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
* Guide build\-vs\-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re\-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
* Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
* Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de\-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.


**Strategic \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and clients, translating business objectives into executable, outcome\-driven program roadmaps.
* Shape enterprise\-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
* Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross\-vendor dependencies.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels — proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.


**Generative AI \& Innovation**
* Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making across delivery portfolios.
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
* Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and develop cross\-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high\-performance, accountable delivery culture.
* Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.
